text_en: Now it came to pass, after Saul was dead, that David returned from the slaughter of the Amalecites , and abode two days in Siceleg.
text_la: Factum est autem, postquam mortuus est Saul, ut David reverteretur a cæde Amalec, et maneret in Siceleg duos dies.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, depois da morte de Saul, voltando Davi da derrota dos amalequitas, ficou dois dias em Ziclague;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Σαουλ καὶ Δαυιδ ἀνέστρεψεν τύπτων τὸν Αμαληκ καὶ ἐκάθισεν Δαυιδ ἐν Σεκελακ ἡμέρας δύο

text_en: And on the third day, there appeared a man who came out of Saul's camp, with his garments rent, and dust strewed on his head: and when he came to David , he fell upon his face, and adored .
text_la: In die autem tertia apparuit homo veniens de castris Saul veste conscissa, et pulvere conspersus caput : et ut venit ad David, cecidit super faciem suam, et adoravit.
text_pt: Ao terceiro dia um homem veio do arraial de Saul, com as vestes rotas e com terra sobre a cabeça; e, chegando ele a Davi, se lançou no chão, e se inclinou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἦλθεν ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ Σαουλ καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ διερρωγότα καὶ γῆ ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτὸν πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And David said to him: Where are you coming from? And he said to him: I am fled out of the camp of Israel .
text_la: Dixitque ad eum David : Unde venis? Qui ait ad eum : De castris Israël fugi.
text_pt: E Davi lhe disse: Donde vens? E ele lhe disse: Escapei do arraial de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δαυιδ πόθεν σὺ παραγίνῃ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς Ισραηλ ἐγὼ διασέσῳσμαι

text_en: And David said unto him: What is the matter that has come to pass? Tell me: He said: The people are fled from the battle, and many of the people are fallen and dead: moreover Saul and Jonathan his son are slain.
text_la: Et dixit ad eum David : Quod est verbum quod factum est? indica mihi. Qui ait : Fugit populus ex prælio, et multi corruentes e populo mortui sunt : sed et Saul et Jonathas filius ejus interierunt.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Davi: Como foi lá isso? peço-te, dize-mo. E ele lhe respondeu: O povo fugiu da batalha, e muitos do povo caíram, e morreram; assim como também Saul e Jônatas, seu filho, foram mortos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δαυιδ τίς ὁ λόγος οὗτος ἀπάγγειλόν μοι καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι ἔφυγεν ὁ λαὸς ἐκ τοῦ πολέμου καὶ πεπτώκασι πολλοὶ ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἀπέθανον καὶ ἀπέθανεν καὶ Σαουλ καὶ Ιωναθαν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And David said to the young man that told him: How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son, are dead?
text_la: Dixitque David ad adolescentem qui nuntiabat ei : Unde scis quia mortuus est Saul, et Jonathas filius ejus?
text_pt: E disse Davi ao moço que lhe trazia as novas: Como sabes tu que Saul e Jônatas, seu filho, foram mortos?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ τῷ παιδαρίῳ τῷ ἀπαγγέλλοντι αὐτῷ πῶς οἶδας ὅτι τέθνηκεν Σαουλ καὶ Ιωναθαν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the young man that told him, said: I came by chance upon mount Gelboe, and Saul leaned upon his spear: and the chariots and horsemen drew near unto him,
text_la: Et ait adolescens qui nuntiabat ei : Casu veni in montem Gelboë, et Saul incumbebat super hastam suam : porro currus et equites appropinquabant ei,
text_pt: Então disse o moço que lhe dava a notícia: Cheguei por acaso à montanha de Gilboa, e eis que Saul estava encostado sobre a sua lança, e eis que os carros e a cavalaria apertavam-no.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τὸ παιδάριον τὸ ἀπαγγέλλον αὐτῷ περιπτώματι περιέπεσον ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Γελβουε καὶ ἰδοὺ Σαουλ ἐπεστήρικτο ἐπὶ τὸ δόρυ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰδοὺ τὰ ἅρματα καὶ οἱ ἱππάρχαι συνῆψαν αὐτῷ

text_en: and looking behind him, and seeing me, he called me. And I answered, Here am I.
text_la: et conversus post tergum suum, vidensque me, vocavit. Cui cum respondissem : Adsum:
text_pt: E, olhando ele para trás de si, viu-me, e chamou-me; e eu disse: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὰ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδέν με καὶ ἐκάλεσέν με καὶ εἶπα ἰδοὺ ἐγώ

text_en: And he said to me: Who are you? And I said to him: I am an Amalecite .
text_la: dixit mihi : Quisnam es tu? Et aio ad eum : Amalecites ego sum.
text_pt: E ele me disse: Quem és tu? E eu lhe disse: Sou amalequita.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι τίς εἶ σύ καὶ εἶπα Αμαληκίτης ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: And he said to me: Stand over me, and kill me: for anguish has come upon me, and as yet my whole life is in me.
text_la: Et locutus est mihi : Sta super me, et interfice me : quoniam tenent me angustiæ, et adhuc tota anima mea in me est.
text_pt: Então ele me disse: Peço-te, arremessa-te sobre mim, e mata-me, porque angústias me têm cercado, pois toda a minha vida está ainda em mim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με στῆθι δὴ ἐπάνω μου καὶ θανάτωσόν με ὅτι κατέσχεν με σκότος δεινόν ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: So standing over him, I killed him: for I knew that he could not live after the fall: and I took the diadem that was on his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither to you, my lord.
text_la: Stansque super eum, occidi illum : sciebam enim quod vivere non poterat post ruinam : et tuli diadema quod erat in capite ejus, et armillam de brachio illius, et attuli ad te dominum meum huc.
text_pt: Arremessei-me, pois, sobre ele, e o matei, porque bem sabia eu que não viveria depois da sua queda, e tomei a coroa que tinha na cabeça, e o bracelete que trazia no braço, e os trouxe aqui a meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστην ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐθανάτωσα αὐτόν ὅτι ᾔδειν ὅτι οὐ ζήσεται μετὰ τὸ πεσεῖν αὐτόν καὶ ἔλαβον τὸ βασίλειον τὸ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν χλιδῶνα τὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ βραχίονος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνήνοχα αὐτὰ τῷ κυρίῳ μου ὧδε

text_en: Then David took hold of his garments and rent them, and likewise all the men that were with him.
text_la: Apprehendens autem David, vestimenta sua scidit, omnesque viri qui erant cum eo,
text_pt: Então apanhou Davi as suas vestes, e as rasgou; assim fizeram todos os homens que estavam com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐκράτησεν Δαυιδ τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ καὶ διέρρηξεν αὐτά καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ διέρρηξαν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν

text_en: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until evening for Saul , and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the Lord , and for the house of Israel , because they were fallen by the sword.
text_la: et planxerunt, et fleverunt, et jejunaverunt usque ad vesperam super Saul, et super Jonathan filium ejus, et super populum Domini, et super domum Israël, eo quod corruissent gladio.
text_pt: E prantearam, e choraram, e jejuaram até à tarde por Saul, e por Jônatas, seu filho, e pelo povo do Senhor, e pela casa de Israel, porque tinham caído à espada.
text_el: καὶ ἐκόψαντο καὶ ἔκλαυσαν καὶ ἐνήστευσαν ἕως δείλης ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ ἐπὶ Ιωναθαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν Ιουδα καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ ὅτι ἐπλήγησαν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: And David said to the young man that told him: Whence are you? He answered: I am the son of a stranger of Amalec .
text_la: Dixitque David ad juvenem qui nuntiaverat ei : Unde es tu? Qui respondit : Filius hominis advenæ Amalecitæ ego sum.
text_pt: Disse então Davi ao moço que lhe trouxera a nova: Donde és tu? E disse ele: Sou filho de um estrangeiro, amalequita.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ τῷ παιδαρίῳ τῷ ἀπαγγέλλοντι αὐτῷ πόθεν εἶ σύ καὶ εἶπεν υἱὸς ἀνδρὸς παροίκου Αμαληκίτου ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: David said to him: Why did you not fear to put out your hand to kill the Lord's anointed?
text_la: Et ait ad eum David : Quare non timuisti mittere manum tuam ut occideres christum Domini?
text_pt: E Davi lhe disse: Como não temeste tu estender a mão para matares ao ungido do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δαυιδ πῶς οὐκ ἐφοβήθης ἐπενεγκεῖν χεῖρά σου διαφθεῖραι τὸν χριστὸν κυρίου

text_en: And David calling one of his servants, said: Go near and fall upon him. And he struck him so that he died.
text_la: Vocansque David unum de pueris suis, ait : Accedens irrue in eum. Qui percussit illum, et mortuus est.
text_pt: Então chamou Davi a um dos moços, e disse: Chega, e lança-te sobre ele. E ele o feriu, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Δαυιδ ἓν τῶν παιδαρίων αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν προσελθὼν ἀπάντησον αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And David said to him: Your blood be upon your own head: for your own mouth has spoken against you, saying: I have slain the Lord's anointed.
text_la: Et ait ad eum David : Sanguis tuus super caput tuum : os enim tuum locutum est adversum te, dicens : Ego interfeci christum Domini.
text_pt: Pois Davi lhe dissera: O teu sangue seja sobre a tua cabeça, porque a tua própria boca testificou contra ti, dizendo: Eu matei o ungido do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς αὐτόν τὸ αἷμά σου ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν σου ὅτι τὸ στόμα σου ἀπεκρίθη κατὰ σοῦ λέγων ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐθανάτωσα τὸν χριστὸν κυρίου

text_en: And David made this kind of lamentation over Saul , and over Jonathan his son.
text_la: Planxit autem David planctum hujuscemodi super Saul, et super Jonathan filium ejus
text_pt: E lamentou Davi a Saul e a Jônatas, seu filho, com esta lamentação
text_el: καὶ ἐθρήνησεν Δαυιδ τὸν θρῆνον τοῦτον ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ ἐπὶ Ιωναθαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: (Also he commanded that they should teach the children of Juda the use of the bow, as it is written in the book of the just.) And he said:Consider, O Israel , for them that are dead, wounded on your high places.
text_la: (et præcepit ut docerent filios Juda arcum, sicut scriptum est in libro justorum), et ait : Considera, Israël, pro his qui mortui sunt, super excelsa tua vulnerati.
text_pt: (Dizendo ele que ensinassem aos filhos de Judá o uso do arco. Eis que está escrito no livro de Jasher):
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῦ διδάξαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ιουδα ἰδοὺ γέγραπται ἐπὶ βιβλίου τοῦ εὐθοῦς

text_en: The illustrious of Israel are slain upon your mountains: how are the valiant fallen?
text_la: Inclyti Israël super montes tuos interfecti sunt : quomodo ceciderunt fortes?
text_pt: Ah, ornamento de Israel! Nos teus altos foi ferido, como caíram os poderosos!
text_el: στήλωσον Ισραηλ ὑπὲρ τῶν τεθνηκότων ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη σου τραυματιῶν πῶς ἔπεσαν δυνατοί

text_en: Tell it not in Geth, publish it not in the streets of Ascalon : lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
text_la: Nolite annuntiare in Geth, neque annuntietis in compitis Ascalonis : ne forte lætentur filiæ Philisthiim; ne exultent filiæ incircumcisorum.
text_pt: Não o noticieis em Gate, não o publiqueis nas ruas de Ascalom, para que não se alegrem as filhas dos filisteus, para que não saltem de contentamento as filhas dos incircuncisos.
text_el: μὴ ἀναγγείλητε ἐν Γεθ καὶ μὴ εὐαγγελίσησθε ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις Ἀσκαλῶνος μήποτε εὐφρανθῶσιν θυγατέρες ἀλλοφύλων μήποτε ἀγαλλιάσωνται θυγατέρες τῶν ἀπεριτμήτων

text_en: You mountains of Gelboe, let neither dew, nor rain come upon you, neither be they fields of firstfruits : for there was cast away the shield of the valiant , the shield of Saul as though he had not been anointed with oil.
text_la: Montes Gelboë, nec ros, nec pluvia veniant super vos, neque sint agri primitiarum : quia ibi abjectus est clypeus fortium : clypeus Saul, quasi non esset unctus oleo.
text_pt: Vós, montes de Gilboa, nem orvalho, nem chuva caia sobre vós, nem haja campos de ofertas alçadas, pois aí desprezivelmente foi arrojado o escudo dos poderosos, o escudo de Saul, como se não fora ungido com óleo.
text_el: ὄρη τὰ ἐν Γελβουε μὴ καταβῇ δρόσος καὶ μὴ ὑετὸς ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀγροὶ ἀπαρχῶν ὅτι ἐκεῖ προσωχθίσθη θυρεὸς δυνατῶν θυρεὸς Σαουλ οὐκ ἐχρίσθη ἐν ἐλαίῳ

text_en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the valiant , the arrow of Jonathan never turned back, and the sword of Saul did not return empty.
text_la: A sanguine interfectorum, ab adipe fortium, sagitta Jonathæ numquam rediit retrorsum, et gladius Saul non est reversus inanis.
text_pt: Do sangue dos feridos, da gordura dos valentes, nunca se retirou para trás o arco de Jônatas, nem voltou vazia a espada de Saul.
text_el: ἀφ' αἵματος τραυματιῶν ἀπὸ στέατος δυνατῶν τόξον Ιωναθαν οὐκ ἀπεστράφη κενὸν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ῥομφαία Σαουλ οὐκ ἀνέκαμψεν κενή

text_en: Saul and Jonathan , lovely, and comely in their life, even in death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, stronger than lions.
text_la: Saul et Jonathas amabiles, et decori in vita sua, in morte quoque non sunt divisi : aquilis velociores, leonibus fortiores.
text_pt: Saul e Jônatas, tão amados e queridos na sua vida, também na sua morte não se separaram; eram mais ligeiros do que as águias, mais fortes do que os leões.
text_el: Σαουλ καὶ Ιωναθαν οἱ ἠγαπημένοι καὶ ὡραῖοι οὐ διακεχωρισμένοι εὐπρεπεῖς ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτῶν οὐ διεχωρίσθησαν ὑπὲρ ἀετοὺς κοῦφοι καὶ ὑπὲρ λέοντας ἐκραταιώθησαν

text_en: You daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you with scarlet in delights, who gave ornaments of gold for your attire.
text_la: Filiæ Israël, super Saul flete, qui vestiebat vos coccino in deliciis, qui præbebat ornamenta aurea cultui vestro.
text_pt: Vós, filhas de Israel, chorai por Saul, que vos vestia de escarlata em delícias, que vos fazia trazer ornamentos de ouro sobre as vossas vestes.
text_el: θυγατέρες Ισραηλ ἐπὶ Σαουλ κλαύσατε τὸν ἐνδιδύσκοντα ὑμᾶς κόκκινα μετὰ κόσμου ὑμῶν τὸν ἀναφέροντα κόσμον χρυσοῦν ἐπὶ τὰ ἐνδύματα ὑμῶν

text_en: How are the valiant fallen in battle? Jonathan slain in the high places?
text_la: Quomodo ceciderunt fortes in prælio? Jonathas in excelsis tuis occisus est?
text_pt: Como caíram os poderosos, no meio da peleja! Jônatas nos teus altos foi morto.
text_el: πῶς ἔπεσαν δυνατοὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ πολέμου Ιωναθαν ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη σου τραυματίας

text_en: I grieve for you, my brother Jonathan : exceeding beautiful, and amiable to me above the love of women . As the mother loves her only son, so did I love you.
text_la: Doleo super te, frater mi Jonatha, decore nimis, et amabilis super amorem mulierum. Sicut mater unicum amat filium suum, ita ego te diligebam.
text_pt: Angustiado estou por ti, meu irmão Jônatas; quão amabilíssimo me eras! Mais maravilhoso me era o teu amor do que o amor das mulheres.
text_el: ἀλγῶ ἐπὶ σοί ἄδελφέ μου Ιωναθαν ὡραιώθης μοι σφόδρα ἐθαυμαστώθη ἡ ἀγάπησίς σου ἐμοὶ ὑπὲρ ἀγάπησιν γυναικῶν

text_en: How are the valiant fallen, and the weapons of war perished?
text_la: Quomodo ceciderunt robusti, et perierunt arma bellica?
text_pt: Como caíram os poderosos, e pereceram as armas de guerra!
text_el: πῶς ἔπεσαν δυνατοὶ καὶ ἀπώλοντο σκεύη πολεμικά

text_en: And after these things David consulted the Lord , saying: Shall I go up into one of the cities of Juda ? And the Lord said to him: Go up. And David said: Whither shall I go up? And he answered him: Into Hebron .
text_la: Igitur post hæc consuluit David Dominum, dicens : Num ascendam in unam de civitatibus Juda? Et ait Dominus ad eum : Ascende. Dixitque David : Quo ascendam? Et respondit ei : In Hebron.
text_pt: E sucedeu depois disto que Davi consultou ao SENHOR, dizendo: Subirei a alguma das cidades de Judá? E disse-lhe o SENHOR: Sobe. E falou Davi: Para onde subirei? E disse: Para Hebrom.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν Δαυιδ ἐν κυρίῳ λέγων εἰ ἀναβῶ εἰς μίαν τῶν πόλεων Ιουδα καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν ἀνάβηθι καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ ποῦ ἀναβῶ καὶ εἶπεν εἰς Χεβρων

text_en: So David went up, and his two wives Achinoam the Jezrahelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal of Carmel :
text_la: Ascendit ergo David, et duæ uxores ejus, Achinoam Jezraëlites, et Abigail uxor Nabal Carmeli:
text_pt: E subiu Davi para lá, e também as suas duas mulheres, Ainoã, a jizreelita, e Abigail, a mulher de Nabal, o carmelita.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ἐκεῖ Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ ἀμφότεραι αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτοῦ Αχινοομ ἡ Ιεζραηλῖτις καὶ Αβιγαια ἡ γυνὴ Ναβαλ τοῦ Καρμηλίου

text_en: And the men also that were with him, David brought up every man with his household: and they abode in the towns of Hebron .
text_la: sed et viros, qui erant cum eo, duxit David singulos cum domo sua : et manserunt in oppidis Hebron.
text_pt: Fez também Davi subir os homens que estavam com ele, cada um com a sua família; e habitaram nas cidades de Hebrom.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἕκαστος καὶ ὁ οἶκος αὐτοῦ καὶ κατῴκουν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Χεβρων

text_en: And the men of Juda came, and anointed David there, to be king over the house of Juda . And it was told David that the men of Jabes Galaad had buried Saul .
text_la: Veneruntque viri Juda, et unxerunt ibi David ut regnaret super domum Juda. Et nuntiatum est David quod viri Jabes Galaad sepelissent Saul.
text_pt: Então vieram os homens de Judá, e ungiram ali a Davi rei sobre a casa de Judá. E deram avisos a Davi, dizendo: Os homens de Jabes-Gileade foram os que sepultaram a Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχονται ἄνδρες τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ χρίουσιν τὸν Δαυιδ ἐκεῖ τοῦ βασιλεύειν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν τῷ Δαυιδ λέγοντες ὅτι οἱ ἄνδρες Ιαβις τῆς Γαλααδίτιδος ἔθαψαν τὸν Σαουλ

text_en: David therefore sent messengers to the men of Jabes Galaad, and said to them: Blessed be you to the Lord , who have shown this mercy to your master Saul , and have buried him.
text_la: Misit ergo David nuntios ad viros Jabes Galaad, dixitque ad eos : Benedicti vos Domino, qui fecistis misericordiam hanc cum domino vestro Saul, et sepelistis eum.
text_pt: Então enviou Davi mensageiros aos homens de Jabes-Gileade, para dizer-lhes: Benditos sejais vós do SENHOR, que fizestes tal beneficência a vosso senhor, a Saul, e o sepultastes!
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ ἀγγέλους πρὸς τοὺς ἡγουμένους Ιαβις τῆς Γαλααδίτιδος καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς εὐλογημένοι ὑμεῖς τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι πεποιήκατε τὸ ἔλεος τοῦτο ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ὑμῶν ἐπὶ Σαουλ τὸν χριστὸν κυρίου καὶ ἐθάψατε αὐτὸν καὶ Ιωναθαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And now the Lord surely will render you mercy and truth , and I also will requite you for this good turn, because you have done this thing.
text_la: Et nunc retribuet vobis quidem Dominus misericordiam et veritatem : sed et ego reddam gratiam, eo quod fecistis verbum istud.
text_pt: Agora, pois, o Senhor use convosco de beneficência e fidelidade; e também eu vos farei este bem, porquanto fizestes isto.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ποιήσαι κύριος μεθ' ὑμῶν ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθειαν καί γε ἐγὼ ποιήσω μεθ' ὑμῶν τὰ ἀγαθὰ ταῦτα ὅτι ἐποιήσατε τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: Let your hands be strengthened, and be men of valour: for although your master Saul be dead, yet the house of Juda has anointed me to be their king.
text_la: Confortentur manus vestræ, et estote filii fortitudinis : licet enim mortuus sit dominus vester Saul, tamen me unxit domus Juda in regem sibi.
text_pt: Esforcem-se, pois, agora as vossas mãos, e sede homens valentes, pois Saul, vosso senhor, é morto, mas também os da casa de Judá já me ungiram a mim por seu rei.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κραταιούσθωσαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν καὶ γίνεσθε εἰς υἱοὺς δυνατούς ὅτι τέθνηκεν ὁ κύριος ὑμῶν Σαουλ καί γε ἐμὲ κέχρικεν ὁ οἶκος Ιουδα ἐφ' ἑαυτοὺς εἰς βασιλέα

text_en: But Abner the son of Ner, general of Saul's army, took Isboseth the son of Saul , and led him about through the camp,
text_la: Abner autem filius Ner, princeps exercitus Saul, tulit Isboseth filium Saul, et circumduxit eum per castra,
text_pt: Porém Abner, filho de Ner, capitão do exército de Saul, tomou a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e o fez passar a Maanaim,
text_el: καὶ Αβεννηρ υἱὸς Νηρ ἀρχιστράτηγος τοῦ Σαουλ ἔλαβεν τὸν Ιεβοσθε υἱὸν Σαουλ καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς εἰς Μαναεμ

text_en: and made him king over Galaad, and over Gessuri, and over Jezrahel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin , and over all Israel .
text_la: regemque constituit super Galaad, et super Gessuri, et super Jezraël, et super Ephraim, et super Benjamin, et super Israël universum.
text_pt: E o constituiu rei sobre Gileade, e sobre os assuritas, e sobre Jizreel, e sobre Efraim, e sobre Benjamim, e sobre todo o Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν Γαλααδῖτιν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Θασιρι καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ιεζραελ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Βενιαμιν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ

text_en: Isboseth the son of Saul was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and he reigned two years; and only the house of Juda followed David .
text_la: Quadraginta annorum erat Isboseth filius Saul cum regnare cœpisset super Israël, et duobus annis regnavit : sola autem domus Juda sequebatur David.
text_pt: Da idade de quarenta anos era Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, quando começou a reinar sobre Israel, e reinou dois anos; mas os da casa de Judá seguiam a Davi.
text_el: τεσσαράκοντα ἐτῶν Ιεβοσθε υἱὸς Σαουλ ὅτε ἐβασίλευσεν ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ δύο ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν πλὴν τοῦ οἴκου Ιουδα οἳ ἦσαν ὀπίσω Δαυιδ

text_en: And the number of the days that David abode, reigning in Hebron over the house of Juda , was seven years and six months.
text_la: Et fuit numerus dierum quos commoratus est David imperans in Hebron super domum Juda, septem annorum et sex mensium.
text_pt: E foi o número dos dias que Davi reinou em Hebrom, sobre a casa de Judá, sete anos e seis meses.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο αἱ ἡμέραι ἃς Δαυιδ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Χεβρων ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἓξ μῆνας

text_en: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Isboseth the son of Saul , went out from the camp to Gabaon.
text_la: Egressusque est Abner filius Ner, et pueri Isboseth filii Saul, de castris in Gabaon.
text_pt: Então saiu Abner, filho de Ner, com os servos de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, de Maanaim a Gibeom.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Αβεννηρ υἱὸς Νηρ καὶ οἱ παῖδες Ιεβοσθε υἱοῦ Σαουλ ἐκ Μαναεμ εἰς Γαβαων

text_en: And Joab the son of Sarvia, and the servants of David went out, and met them by the pool of Gabaon. And when they had come together, they sat down over against one another: the one on the one side of the pool , and the other on the other side.
text_la: Porro Joab filius Sarviæ, et pueri David, egressi sunt, et occurrerunt eis juxta piscinam Gabaon. Et cum in unum convenissent, e regione sederunt : hi ex una parte piscinæ, et illi ex altera.
text_pt: Saíram também Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e os servos de Davi, e se encontraram uns com os outros perto do tanque de Gibeom; e pararam estes deste lado do tanque, e os outros do outro lado do tanque.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ υἱὸς Σαρουιας καὶ οἱ παῖδες Δαυιδ ἐξήλθοσαν ἐκ Χεβρων καὶ συναντῶσιν αὐτοῖς ἐπὶ τὴν κρήνην τὴν Γαβαων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό καὶ ἐκάθισαν οὗτοι ἐπὶ τὴν κρήνην τὴν Γαβαων ἐντεῦθεν καὶ οὗτοι ἐπὶ τὴν κρήνην ἐντεῦθεν

text_en: And Abner said to Joab: Let the young men rise, and play before us. And Joab answered: Let them rise.
text_la: Dixitque Abner ad Joab : Surgant pueri, et ludant coram nobis. Et respondit Joab : Surgant.
text_pt: E disse Abner a Joabe: Deixa levantar os moços, e joguem diante de nós. E disse Joabe: Levantem-se.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβεννερ πρὸς Ιωαβ ἀναστήτωσαν δὴ τὰ παιδάρια καὶ παιξάτωσαν ἐνώπιον ἡμῶν καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ ἀναστήτωσαν

text_en: Then there arose and went over twelve in number of Benjamin , of the part of Isboseth the son of Saul , and twelve of the servants of David .
text_la: Surrexerunt ergo, et transierunt numero duodecim de Benjamin, ex parte Isboseth filii Saul, et duodecim de pueris David.
text_pt: Então se levantaram, e passaram, em número de doze de Benjamim, da parte de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e doze dos servos de Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησαν καὶ παρῆλθον ἐν ἀριθμῷ τῶν παίδων Βενιαμιν δώδεκα τῶν Ιεβοσθε υἱοῦ Σαουλ καὶ δώδεκα ἐκ τῶν παίδων Δαυιδ

text_en: And every one catching his fellow by the head, thrust his sword into the side of his adversary, and they fell down together: and the name of the place was called: The field of the valiant , in Gabaon.
text_la: Apprehensoque unusquisque capite comparis sui, defixit gladium in latus contrarii, et ceciderunt simul : vocatumque est nomen loci illius : Ager robustorum, in Gabaon.
text_pt: E cada um lançou mão da cabeça do outro, cravou-lhe a espada no lado, e caíram juntos, por isso se chamou àquele lugar Helcate-Hazurim, que está junto a Gibeom.
text_el: καὶ ἐκράτησαν ἕκαστος τῇ χειρὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ μάχαιρα αὐτοῦ εἰς πλευρὰν τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ πίπτουσιν κατὰ τὸ αὐτό καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου μερὶς τῶν ἐπιβούλων ἥ ἐστιν ἐν Γαβαων

text_en: And there was a very fierce battle that day: and Abner was put to flight, with the men of Israel , by the servants of David .
text_la: Et ortum est bellum durum satis in die illa: fugatusque est Abner et viri Israël a pueris David.
text_pt: E seguiu-se naquele dia uma crua peleja; porém Abner e os homens de Israel foram feridos diante dos servos de Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ πόλεμος σκληρὸς ὥστε λίαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἔπταισεν Αβεννηρ καὶ ἄνδρες Ισραηλ ἐνώπιον παίδων Δαυιδ

text_en: And there were the three sons of Sarvia there, Joab, and Abisai , and Asael: now Asael was a most swift runner, like one of the roes that abide in the woods.
text_la: Erant autem ibi tres filii Sarviæ, Joab, et Abisai, et Asaël : porro Asaël cursor velocissimus fuit, quasi unus de capreis quæ morantur in silvis.
text_pt: E estavam ali os três filhos de Zeruia, Joabe, Abisai, e Asael; e Asael era ligeiro de pés, como as gazelas do campo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο ἐκεῖ τρεῖς υἱοὶ Σαρουιας Ιωαβ καὶ Αβεσσα καὶ Ασαηλ καὶ Ασαηλ κοῦφος τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ μία δορκὰς ἐν ἀγρῷ

text_en: And Asael pursued after Abner , and turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner .
text_la: Persequebatur autem Asaël Abner, et non declinavit ad dextram neque ad sinistram omittens persequi Abner.
text_pt: E Asael perseguiu a Abner; e não se desviou de detrás de Abner, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν Ασαηλ ὀπίσω Αβεννηρ καὶ οὐκ ἐξέκλινεν τοῦ πορεύεσθαι εἰς δεξιὰ οὐδὲ εἰς ἀριστερὰ κατόπισθεν Αβεννηρ

text_en: And Abner looked behind him, and said: Are you Asael? And he answered: I am.
text_la: Respexit itaque Abner post tergum suum, et ait : Tune es Asaël? Qui respondit : Ego sum.
text_pt: E Abner, olhando para trás, perguntou: És tu Asael? E ele falou: Eu sou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν Αβεννηρ εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν εἰ σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς Ασαηλ καὶ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: And Abner said to him: Go to the right hand or to the left, and lay hold on one of the young men and take you his spoils. But Asael would not leave off following him close.
text_la: Dixitque ei Abner : Vade ad dexteram, sive ad sinistram, et apprehende unum de adolescentibus, et tolle tibi spolia ejus. Noluit autem Asaël omittere quin urgeret eum.
text_pt: Então lhe disse Abner: Desvia-te para a direita, ou para a esquerda, e lança mão de um dos moços, e toma os seus despojos. Porém Asael não quis desviar-se de detrás dele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Αβεννηρ ἔκκλινον σὺ εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ ἢ εἰς τὰ ἀριστερὰ καὶ κάτασχε σαυτῷ ἓν τῶν παιδαρίων καὶ λαβὲ σεαυτῷ τὴν πανοπλίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Ασαηλ ἐκκλῖναι ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And again Abner said to Asael: Go off, and do not follow me, lest I be obliged to stab you to the ground, and I shall not be able to hold up my face to Joab your brother.
text_la: Rursumque locutus est Abner ad Asaël : Recede, noli me sequi, ne compellar confodere te in terram, et levare non potero faciem meam ad Joab fratrem tuum.
text_pt: Então Abner tornou a dizer a Asael: Desvia-te de detrás de mim; por que hei de eu ferir-te e dar contigo em terra? E como levantaria eu o meu rosto diante de Joabe, teu irmão?
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ἔτι Αβεννηρ λέγων τῷ Ασαηλ ἀπόστηθι ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἵνα μὴ πατάξω σε εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ πῶς ἀρῶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ ποῦ ἐστιν ταῦτα ἐπίστρεφε πρὸς Ιωαβ τὸν ἀδελφόν σου

text_en: But he refused to hearken to him, and would not turn aside: wherefore Abner struck him with his spear with a back stroke in the groin, and thrust him through, and he died upon the spot: and all that came to the place where Asael fell down and died stood still.
text_la: Qui audire contempsit, et noluit declinare : percussit ergo eum Abner aversa hasta in inguine, et transfodit, et mortuus est in eodem loco : omnesque qui transibant per locum illum, in quo ceciderat Asaël et mortuus erat, subsistebant.
text_pt: Porém, não querendo ele se desviar, Abner o feriu com a ponta da lança pela quinta costela, e a lança lhe saiu por detrás, e caiu ali, e morreu naquele mesmo lugar; e sucedeu que, todos os que chegavam ao lugar onde Asael caiu e morreu, paravam.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐβούλετο τοῦ ἀποστῆναι καὶ τύπτει αὐτὸν Αβεννηρ ἐν τῷ ὀπίσω τοῦ δόρατος ἐπὶ τὴν ψόαν καὶ διεξῆλθεν τὸ δόρυ ἐκ τῶν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ πίπτει ἐκεῖ καὶ ἀποθνῄσκει ὑποκάτω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο πᾶς ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἕως τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἔπεσεν ἐκεῖ Ασαηλ καὶ ἀπέθανεν καὶ ὑφίστατο

text_en: Now while Joab and Abisai pursued after Abner , the sun went down: and they came as far as the hill of the aqueduct, that lies over against the valley by the way of the wilderness in Gabaon.
text_la: Persequentibus autem Joab et Abisai fugientem Abner, sol occubuit : et venerunt usque ad collem aquæductus, qui est ex adverso vallis itineris deserti in Gabaon.
text_pt: Porém Joabe e Abisai perseguiram a Abner; e pôs-se o sol, chegando eles ao outeiro de Amá, que está diante de Gia, junto ao caminho do deserto de Gibeão.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν Ιωαβ καὶ Αβεσσα ὀπίσω Αβεννηρ καὶ ὁ ἥλιος ἔδυνεν καὶ αὐτοὶ εἰσῆλθον ἕως τοῦ βουνοῦ Αμμαν ὅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ προσώπου γαι ὁδὸν ἔρημον Γαβαων

text_en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together to Abner : and being joined in one body, they stood on the top of a hill.
text_la: Congregatique sunt filii Benjamin ad Abner : et conglobati in unum cuneum, steterunt in summitate tumuli unius.
text_pt: E os filhos de Benjamim se ajuntaram atrás de Abner, e fizeram um batalhão, e puseram-se no cume de um outeiro.
text_el: καὶ συναθροίζονται υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν οἱ ὀπίσω Αβεννηρ καὶ ἐγενήθησαν εἰς συνάντησιν μίαν καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν βουνοῦ ἑνός

text_en: And Abner cried out to Joab, and said: Shall your sword rage unto utter destruction? Do you know not that it is dangerous to drive people to despair? How long do you defer to bid the people cease from pursuing after their brethren?
text_la: Et exclamavit Abner ad Joab, et ait : Num usque ad internecionem tuus mucro desæviet? an ignoras quod periculosa sit desperatio? usquequo non dicis populo ut omittat persequi fratres suos?
text_pt: Então Abner gritou a Joabe, e disse: Consumirá a espada para sempre? Não sabes tu que por fim haverá amargura? E até quando não hás de dizer ao povo que deixe de perseguir a seus irmãos?
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αβεννηρ Ιωαβ καὶ εἶπεν μὴ εἰς νῖκος καταφάγεται ἡ ῥομφαία ἦ οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι πικρὰ ἔσται εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα καὶ ἕως πότε οὐ μὴ εἴπῃς τῷ λαῷ ἀναστρέφειν ἀπὸ ὄπισθεν τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν

text_en: And Joab said: As the Lord lives, if you had spoke sooner, even in the morning the people should have retired from pursuing after their brethren.
text_la: Et ait Joab : Vivit Dominus, si locutus fuisses, mane recessisset populus persequens fratrem suum.
text_pt: E disse Joabe: Vive Deus, que, se não tivesses falado, só pela manhã o povo teria cessado, cada um, de perseguir a seu irmão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ ζῇ κύριος ὅτι εἰ μὴ ἐλάλησας διότι τότε ἐκ πρωίθεν ἀνέβη ὁ λαὸς ἕκαστος κατόπισθεν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and all the army stood still, and did not pursue after Israel any farther, nor fight any more.
text_la: Insonuit ergo Joab buccina, et stetit omnis exercitus, nec persecuti sunt ultra Israël, neque iniere certamen.
text_pt: Então Joabe tocou a buzina, e todo o povo parou, e não perseguiram mais a Israel; e tampouco pelejaram mais.
text_el: καὶ ἐσάλπισεν Ιωαβ τῇ σάλπιγγι καὶ ἀπέστησαν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς καὶ οὐ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ προσέθεντο ἔτι τοῦ πολεμεῖν

text_en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plains: and they passed the Jordan , and having gone through all Beth-horon, came to the camp.
text_la: Abner autem et viri ejus abierunt per campestria, tota nocte illa : et transierunt Jordanem, et lustrata omni Beth-horon, venerunt ad castra.
text_pt: E caminharam Abner e os seus homens toda aquela noite pela planície; e, passando o Jordão, caminharam por todo o Bitrom, e chegaram a Maanaim.
text_el: καὶ Αβεννηρ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον εἰς δυσμὰς ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην καὶ διέβαιναν τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὅλην τὴν παρατείνουσαν καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν

text_en: And Joab returning, after he had left Abner , assembled all the people: and there were wanting of David's servants nineteen men , beside Asael.
text_la: Porro Joab reversus, omisso Abner, congregavit omnem populum : et defuerunt de pueris David decem et novem viri, excepto Asaële.
text_pt: Também Joabe voltou de perseguir a Abner, e ajuntou todo o povo; e dos servos de Davi faltaram dezenove homens, e Asael.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ ἀνέστρεψεν ὄπισθεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Αβεννηρ καὶ συνήθροισεν πάντα τὸν λαόν καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν τῶν παίδων Δαυιδ ἐννεακαίδεκα ἄνδρες καὶ Ασαηλ

text_en: But the servants of David had killed of Benjamin , and of the men that were with Abner , three hundred and sixty, who all died.
text_la: Servi autem David percusserunt de Benjamin, et de viris qui erant cum Abner, trecentos sexaginta, qui et mortui sunt.
text_pt: Porém os servos de Davi feriram dentre os de Benjamim, e dentre os homens de Abner, a trezentos e sessenta homens, que ali ficaram mortos.
text_el: καὶ οἱ παῖδες Δαυιδ ἐπάταξαν τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν τῶν ἀνδρῶν Αβεννηρ τριακοσίους ἑξήκοντα ἄνδρας παρ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they took Asael, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father in Bethlehem and Joab, and the men that were with him, marched all the night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
text_la: Tuleruntque Asaël, et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro patris sui in Bethlehem : et ambulaverunt tota nocte Joab et viri qui erant cum eo, et in ipso crepusculo pervenerunt in Hebron.
text_pt: E levantaram a Asael, e sepultaram-no na sepultura de seu pai, que estava em Belém; e Joabe e seus homens caminharam toda aquela noite, e amanheceu-lhes o dia em Hebrom.
text_el: καὶ αἴρουσιν τὸν Ασαηλ καὶ θάπτουσιν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ τάφῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐν Βαιθλεεμ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ιωαβ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα καὶ διέφαυσεν αὐτοῖς ἐν Χεβρων

text_en: Now there was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : David prospering and growing always stronger and stronger, but the house of Saul decaying daily.
text_la: Facta est ergo longa concertatio inter domum Saul et inter domum David : David proficiscens, et semper seipso robustior, domus autem Saul decrescens quotidie.
text_pt: E houve uma longa guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi; porém Davi ia se fortalecendo, mas os da casa de Saul se iam enfraquecendo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ πόλεμος ἐπὶ πολὺ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οἴκου Σαουλ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οἴκου Δαυιδ καὶ ὁ οἶκος Δαυιδ ἐπορεύετο καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο καὶ ὁ οἶκος Σαουλ ἐπορεύετο καὶ ἠσθένει

text_en: And sons were born to David in Hebron : and his firstborn was Ammon of Achinoam the Jezrahelitess:
text_la: Natique sunt filii David in Hebron : fuitque primogenitus ejus Amnon, de Achinoam Jezraëlitide.
text_pt: E a Davi nasceram filhos em Hebrom; e foi o seu primogênito Amnom, de Ainoã a jizreelita;
text_el: καὶ ἐτέχθησαν τῷ Δαυιδ υἱοὶ ἐν Χεβρων καὶ ἦν ὁ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ Αμνων τῆς Αχινοομ τῆς Ιεζραηλίτιδος

text_en: And his second Cheleab of Abigail the wife of Nabal of Carmel : and the third Absalom the son of Maacha the daughter of Tholmai king of Gessur:
text_la: Et post eum Cheleab, de Abigail uxore Nabal Carmeli : porro tertius Absalom, filius Maacha filiæ Tholmai regis Gessur.
text_pt: E seu segundo, Quileabe, de Abigail, mulher de Nabal, o carmelita; e o terceiro Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur;
text_el: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος αὐτοῦ Δαλουια τῆς Αβιγαιας τῆς Καρμηλίας καὶ ὁ τρίτος Αβεσσαλωμ υἱὸς Μααχα θυγατρὸς Θολμι βασιλέως Γεσιρ

text_en: And the fourth Adonias , the son of Haggith : and the fifth Saphathia the son of Abital:
text_la: Quartus autem Adonias, filius Haggith : et quintus Saphathia, filius Abital.
text_pt: E o quarto, Adonias, filho de Hagite; e o quinto, Sefatias, filho de Abital;
text_el: καὶ ὁ τέταρτος Ορνια υἱὸς Φεγγιθ καὶ ὁ πέμπτος Σαβατια τῆς Αβιταλ

text_en: And the sixth Jethraam of Egla the wife of David : these were born to David In Hebron .
text_la: Sextus quoque Jethraam, de Egla uxore David : hi nati sunt David in Hebron.
text_pt: E o sexto, Itreão, de Eglá, também mulher de Davi; estes nasceram a Davi em Hebrom.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἕκτος Ιεθερααμ τῆς Αιγλα γυναικὸς Δαυιδ οὗτοι ἐτέχθησαν τῷ Δαυιδ ἐν Χεβρων

text_en: Now while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , Abner the son of Ner ruled the house of Saul .
text_la: Cum ergo esset prælium inter domum Saul et domum David, Abner filius Ner regebat domum Saul.
text_pt: E, havendo guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi, sucedeu que Abner se fez poderoso na casa de Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι τὸν πόλεμον ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οἴκου Σαουλ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οἴκου Δαυιδ καὶ Αβεννηρ ἦν κρατῶν τοῦ οἶκου Σαουλ

text_en: And Saul had a concubine named Respha, the daughter of Aia. And Isboseth said to Abner :
text_la: Fuerat autem Sauli concubina nomine Respha, filia Aja. Dixitque Isboseth ad Abner:
text_pt: E tinha tido Saul uma concubina, cujo nome era Rispa, filha de Aiá; e disse Is-Bosete a Abner: Por que possuíste a concubina de meu pai?
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σαουλ παλλακὴ Ρεσφα θυγάτηρ Ιαλ καὶ εἶπεν Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸς Σαουλ πρὸς Αβεννηρ τί ὅτι εἰσῆλθες πρὸς τὴν παλλακὴν τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: Why did you go in to my father's concubine ? And he was exceedingly angry for the words of Isboseth, and said: Am I a dog's head against Juda this day, who have shown mercy to the house of Saul your father, and to his brethren and friends, and have not delivered you into the hands of David , and have you sought this day against me to charge me with a matter concerning a woman ?
text_la: Quare ingressus es ad concubinam patris mei? Qui iratus nimis propter verba Isboseth, ait : Numquid caput canis ego sum adversum Judam hodie, qui fecerim misericordiam super domum Saul patris tui, et super fratres et proximos ejus, et non tradidi te in manus David, et tu requisisti in me quod argueres pro muliere hodie?
text_pt: Então se irou muito Abner pelas palavras de Is-Bosete, e disse: Sou eu cabeça de cão, que pertença a Judá? Ainda hoje faço beneficência à casa de Saul, teu pai, a seus irmãos, e a seus amigos, e não te entreguei nas mãos de Davi, e tu hoje buscas motivo para me argüires por causa da maldade de uma mulher.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη σφόδρα Αβεννηρ περὶ τοῦ λόγου Μεμφιβοσθε καὶ εἶπεν Αβεννηρ πρὸς αὐτόν μὴ κεφαλὴ κυνὸς ἐγώ εἰμι ἐποίησα ἔλεος σήμερον μετὰ τοῦ οἴκου Σαουλ τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ περὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ γνωρίμων καὶ οὐκ ηὐτομόλησα εἰς τὸν οἶκον Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπιζητεῖς ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὑπὲρ ἀδικίας γυναικὸς σήμερον

text_en: So do God to Abner , and more also, unless as the Lord has sworn to David , so I do to him,
text_la: Hæc faciat Deus Abner, et hæc addat ei, nisi quomodo juravit Dominus David, sic faciam cum eo,
text_pt: Assim faça Deus a Abner, e outro tanto, se, como o Senhor jurou a Davi, assim eu não lhe fizer,
text_el: τάδε ποιήσαι ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αβεννηρ καὶ τάδε προσθείη αὐτῷ ὅτι καθὼς ὤμοσεν κύριος τῷ Δαυιδ ὅτι οὕτως ποιήσω αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ

text_en: that the kingdom be translated from the house of Saul , and the throne of David be set up over Israel , and over Juda from Dan to Bersabee .
text_la: ut transferatur regnum de domo Saul, et elevetur thronus David super Israël et super Judam, a Dan usque Bersabee.
text_pt: Transferindo o reino da casa de Saul, e confirmando o trono de Davi sobre Israel, e sobre Judá, desde Dã até Berseba.
text_el: περιελεῖν τὴν βασιλείαν ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου Σαουλ καὶ τοῦ ἀναστῆσαι τὸν θρόνον Δαυιδ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ιουδαν ἀπὸ Δαν ἕως Βηρσαβεε

text_en: And he could not answer him a word, because he feared him.
text_la: Et non potuit respondere ei quidquam, quia metuebat illum.
text_pt: E nenhuma palavra podia ele responder a Abner, porque o temia.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθη ἔτι Μεμφιβοσθε ἀποκριθῆναι τῷ Αβεννηρ ῥῆμα ἀπὸ τοῦ φοβεῖσθαι αὐτόν

text_en: Abner therefore sent messengers to David for himself, saying: Whose is the land? And that they should say: Make a league with me, and my hand shall be with you: and I will bring all Israel to you.
text_la: Misit ergo Abner nuntios ad David pro se dicentes : Cujus est terra? et ut loquerentur : Fac mecum amicitias, et erit manus mea tecum, et reducam ad te universum Israël.
text_pt: Então enviou Abner da sua parte mensageiros a Davi, dizendo: De quem é a terra? E disse mais: Comigo faze o teu acordo, e eis que a minha mão será contigo, para tornar a ti todo o Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Αβεννηρ ἀγγέλους πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς Θαιλαμ οὗ ἦν παραχρῆμα λέγων διάθου διαθήκην σου μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ χείρ μου μετὰ σοῦ τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι πρὸς σὲ πάντα τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ

text_en: And he said: Very well: I will make a league with you: but one thing I require of you, saying: You shall not see my face before you bring Michol the daughter of Saul : and so you shall come, and see me.
text_la: Qui ait : Optime : ego faciam tecum amicitias : sed unam rem peto a te, dicens : Non videbis faciem meam antequam adduxeris Michol filiam Saul : et sic venies, et videbis me.
text_pt: E disse Davi: Bem, eu farei contigo acordo, porém uma coisa te peço: não verás a minha face, se primeiro não me trouxeres a Mical, filha de Saul, quando vieres ver a minha face.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ ἐγὼ καλῶς διαθήσομαι πρὸς σὲ διαθήκην πλὴν λόγον ἕνα ἐγὼ αἰτοῦμαι παρὰ σοῦ λέγων οὐκ ὄψει τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐὰν μὴ ἀγάγῃς τὴν Μελχολ θυγατέρα Σαουλ παραγινομένου σου ἰδεῖν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: And David sent messengers to Isboseth the son of Saul , saying: Restore my wife Michol, whom I espoused to me for a hundred foreskins of the Philistines .
text_la: Misit autem David nuntios ad Isboseth filium Saul, dicens : Redde uxorem meam Michol, quam despondi mihi centum præputiis Philisthiim.
text_pt: Também enviou Davi mensageiros a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, dizendo: Dá-me minha mulher Mical, que eu desposei por cem prepúcios de filisteus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸν Σαουλ ἀγγέλους λέγων ἀπόδος μοι τὴν γυναῖκά μου τὴν Μελχολ ἣν ἔλαβον ἐν ἑκατὸν ἀκροβυστίαις ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And Isboseth sent, and took her from her husband Phaltiel, the son of Lais.
text_la: Misit ergo Isboseth, et tulit eam a viro suo Phaltiel filio Lais.
text_pt: E enviou Is-Bosete, e tirou-a de seu marido, a Paltiel, filho de Laís.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Μεμφιβοσθε καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν παρὰ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς παρὰ Φαλτιηλ υἱοῦ Σελλης

text_en: And her husband followed her, weeping as far as Bahurim: and Abner said to him: Go and return. And he returned.
text_la: Sequebaturque eam vir suus, plorans usque Bahurim : et dixit ad eum Abner : Vade, et revertere. Qui reversus est.
text_pt: E ia com ela seu marido, caminhando, e chorando atrás dela, até Baurim. Então lhe disse Abner: Vai-te, agora volta. E ele voltou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύετο ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς μετ' αὐτῆς κλαίων ὀπίσω αὐτῆς ἕως Βαρακιμ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Αβεννηρ πορεύου ἀνάστρεφε καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν

text_en: Abner also spoke to the ancients of Israel , saying: Both yesterday and the day before you sought for David that he might reign over you.
text_la: Sermonem quoque intulit Abner ad seniores Israël, dicens : Tam heri quam nudiustertius quærebatis David ut regnaret super vos.
text_pt: E falou Abner com os anciãos de Israel, dizendo: Já há muito tempo que procuráveis que Davi reinasse sobre vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβεννηρ πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους Ισραηλ λέγων ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἐζητεῖτε τὸν Δαυιδ βασιλεύειν ἐφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: Now then do it: because the Lord has spoken to David , saying: By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel from the hands of the Philistines , and of all their enemies.
text_la: Nunc ergo facite : quoniam Dominus locutus est ad David, dicens : In manu servi mei David salvabo populum meum Israël de manu Philisthiim, et omnium inimicorum ejus.
text_pt: Fazei-o, pois, agora, porque o Senhor falou a Davi, dizendo: Pela mão de Davi meu servo livrarei o meu povo das mãos dos filisteus e das mãos de todos os seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ποιήσατε ὅτι κύριος ἐλάλησεν περὶ Δαυιδ λέγων ἐν χειρὶ τοῦ δούλου μου Δαυιδ σώσω τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκ χειρὸς ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And Abner spoke also to Benjamin . And he went to speak to David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel , and to all Benjamin .
text_la: Locutus est autem Abner etiam ad Benjamin. Et abiit ut loqueretur ad David in Hebron omnia quæ placuerant Israëli et universo Benjamin.
text_pt: E falou também Abner aos de Benjamim; e foi também Abner dizer aos de Davi, em Hebrom, tudo o que era bom aos olhos de Israel e aos olhos de toda a casa de Benjamim.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Αβεννηρ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν Βενιαμιν καὶ ἐπορεύθη Αβεννηρ τοῦ λαλῆσαι εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων πάντα ὅσα ἤρεσεν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς παντὸς οἴκου Βενιαμιν

text_en: And he came to David in Hebron with twenty men : and David made a feast for Abner , and his men that came with him.
text_la: Venitque ad David in Hebron cum viginti viris : et fecit David Abner, et viris ejus qui venerant cum eo, convivium.
text_pt: E foi Abner a Davi, em Hebrom, e vinte homens com ele; e Davi fez um banquete a Abner e aos homens que com ele estavam.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Αβεννηρ πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἴκοσι ἄνδρες καὶ ἐποίησεν Δαυιδ τῷ Αβεννηρ καὶ τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ πότον

text_en: And Abner said to David : I will rise, that I may gather all Israel unto you my lord the king, and may enter into a league with you, and that you may reign over all as your soul desires. Now when David had brought Abner on his way, and he had gone in peace,
text_la: Et dixit Abner ad David : Surgam, ut congregem ad te dominum meum regem omnem Israël, et ineam tecum fœdus, et imperes omnibus, sicut desiderat anima tua. Cum ergo deduxisset David Abner, et ille isset in pace,
text_pt: Então disse Abner a Davi: Eu me levantarei, e irei, e ajuntarei ao rei meu senhor todo o Israel, para fazer acordo contigo; e tu reinarás sobre tudo o que desejar a tua alma. Assim despediu Davi a Abner, e ele foi em paz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβεννηρ πρὸς Δαυιδ ἀναστήσομαι δὴ καὶ πορεύσομαι καὶ συναθροίσω πρὸς κύριόν μου τὸν βασιλέα πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ διαθήσομαι μετὰ σοῦ διαθήκην καὶ βασιλεύσεις ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπιθυμεῖ ἡ ψυχή σου καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ τὸν Αβεννηρ καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: immediately, David's servants and Joab came, after having slain the robbers, with an exceeding great booty. And Abner was not with David in Hebron , for he had now sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
text_la: statim pueri David et Joab venerunt, cæsis latronibus, cum præda magna nimis : Abner autem non erat cum David in Hebron, quia jam dimiserat eum, et profectus fuerat in pace.
text_pt: E eis que os servos de Davi e Joabe vieram de uma batalha, e traziam consigo grande despojo; e já Abner não estava com Davi em Hebrom, porque o tinha despedido, e se tinha ido em paz.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ παῖδες Δαυιδ καὶ Ιωαβ παρεγίνοντο ἐκ τῆς ἐξοδίας καὶ σκῦλα πολλὰ ἔφερον μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ Αβεννηρ οὐκ ἦν μετὰ Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων ὅτι ἀπεστάλκει αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπεληλύθει ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: And Joab and all the army that was with him, came afterwards: and it was told Joab, that Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.
text_la: Et Joab, et omnis exercitus qui erat cum eo, postea venerunt : nuntiatum est itaque Joab a narrantibus : Venit Abner filius Ner ad regem, et dimisit eum, et abiit in pace.
text_pt: Chegando, pois, Joabe, e todo o exército que vinha com ele, deram aviso a Joabe, dizendo: Abner, filho de Ner, veio ao rei, e o despediu, e foi em paz.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ στρατιὰ αὐτοῦ ἤχθησαν καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Ιωαβ λέγοντες ἥκει Αβεννηρ υἱὸς Νηρ πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέσταλκεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: And Joab went in to the king, and said: What have you done? Behold Abner came to you: Why did you send him away, and he has gone and departed?
text_la: Et ingressus est Joab ad regem, et ait : Quid fecisti? Ecce venit Abner ad te : quare dimisisti eum, et abiit et recessit?
text_pt: Então Joabe foi ao rei, e disse: Que fizeste? Eis que Abner veio ter contigo; por que pois o despediste, de maneira que se fosse assim livremente?
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ιωαβ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπεν τί τοῦτο ἐποίησας ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν Αβεννηρ πρὸς σέ καὶ ἵνα τί ἐξαπέσταλκας αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπελήλυθεν ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: Do you not know Abner the son of Ner, that to this end he came to you, that he might deceive you, and to know your going out, and your coming in, and to know all you do?
text_la: ignoras Abner filium Ner, quoniam ad hoc venit ad te ut deciperet te, et sciret exitum tuum et introitum tuum, et nosset omnia quæ agis?
text_pt: Bem conheces a Abner, filho de Ner, que te veio enganar, e saber a tua saída e a tua entrada, e entender tudo quanto fazes.
text_el: ἦ οὐκ οἶδας τὴν κακίαν Αβεννηρ υἱοῦ Νηρ ὅτι ἀπατῆσαί σε παρεγένετο καὶ γνῶναι τὴν ἔξοδόν σου καὶ τὴν εἴσοδόν σου καὶ γνῶναι ἅπαντα ὅσα σὺ ποιεῖς

text_en: Then Joab going out from David , sent messengers after Abner , and brought him back from the cistern of Sira, David knowing nothing of it.
text_la: Egressus itaque Joab a David, misit nuntios post Abner, et reduxit eum a cisterna Sira, ignorante David.
text_pt: E Joabe, retirando-se de Davi, enviou mensageiros atrás de Abner, e o fizeram voltar desde o poço de Sirá, sem que Davi o soubesse.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Ιωαβ ἀπὸ τοῦ Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους ὀπίσω Αβεννηρ καὶ ἐπιστρέφουσιν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ φρέατος τοῦ Σεϊραμ καὶ Δαυιδ οὐκ ᾔδει

text_en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside to the middle of the gate, to speak to him treacherously: and he stabbed him there in the groin, and he died, in revenge of the blood of Asael his brother.
text_la: Cumque rediisset Abner in Hebron, seorsum adduxit eum Joab ad medium portæ ut loqueretur ei, in dolo : et percussit illum ibi in inguine, et mortuus est in ultionem sanguinis Asaël fratris ejus.
text_pt: Voltando, pois, Abner a Hebrom, Joabe o levou à parte, à entrada da porta, para lhe falar em segredo; e feriu-o ali pela quinta costela, e morreu, por causa do sangue de Asael seu irmão.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Αβεννηρ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ ἐξέκλινεν αὐτὸν Ιωαβ ἐκ πλαγίων τῆς πύλης λαλῆσαι πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐνεδρεύων καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ ἐπὶ τὴν ψόαν καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐν τῷ αἵματι Ασαηλ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ Ιωαβ

text_en: And when David heard of it, after the thing was now done, he said: I, and my kingdom are innocent before the Lord for ever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
text_la: Quod cum audisset David rem jam gestam, ait : Mundus ego sum, et regnum meum apud Dominum usque in sempiternum, a sanguine Abner filii Ner:
text_pt: O que Davi depois ouvindo, disse: Inocente sou eu, e o meu reino, para com o Senhor, para sempre, do sangue de Abner, filho de Ner.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Δαυιδ μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ εἶπεν ἀθῷός εἰμι ἐγὼ καὶ ἡ βασιλεία μου ἀπὸ κυρίου ἕως αἰῶνος ἀπὸ τῶν αἱμάτων Αβεννηρ υἱοῦ Νηρ

text_en: And may it come upon the head of Joab, and upon all his father's house: and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that has an issue of seed, or that is a leper , or that holds the distaff, or that falls by the sword, or that wants bread.
text_la: et veniat super caput Joab, et super omnem domum patris ejus : nec deficiat de domo Joab fluxum seminis sustinens, et leprosus, et tenens fusum, et cadens gladio, et indigens pane.
text_pt: Caia sobre a cabeça de Joabe e sobre toda a casa de seu pai, e nunca na casa de Joabe falte quem tenha fluxo, ou quem seja leproso, ou quem se atenha a bordão, ou quem caia à espada, ou quem necessite de pão.
text_el: καταντησάτωσαν ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν Ιωαβ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἐκλίποι ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Ιωαβ γονορρυὴς καὶ λεπρὸς καὶ κρατῶν σκυτάλης καὶ πίπτων ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐλασσούμενος ἄρτοις

text_en: So Joab and Abisai his brother slew Abner , because he had killed their brother Asael at Gabaon in the battle.
text_la: Igitur Joab et Abisai frater ejus interfecerunt Abner, eo quod occidisset Asaël fratrem eorum in Gabaon in prælio.
text_pt: Joabe, pois, e Abisai, seu irmão, mataram a Abner, por ter morto a Asael, seu irmão, na peleja em Gibeão.
text_el: Ιωαβ δὲ καὶ Αβεσσα ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ διεπαρετηροῦντο τὸν Αβεννηρ ἀνθ' ὧν ἐθανάτωσεν τὸν Ασαηλ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτῶν ἐν Γαβαων ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ

text_en: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him: Rend your garments, and gird yourselves with sackcloths , and mourn before the funeral of Abner . And King David himself followed the bier.
text_la: Dixit autem David ad Joab, et ad omnem populum qui erat cum eo : Scindite vestimenta vestra, et accingimini saccis, et plangite ante exequias Abner. Porro rex David sequebatur feretrum.
text_pt: Disse, pois, Davi a Joabe, e a todo o povo que com ele estava: Rasgai as vossas vestes; e cingi-vos de sacos e ide pranteando diante de Abner. E o rei Davi ia seguindo o féretro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ πρὸς πάντα τὸν λαὸν τὸν μετ' αὐτοῦ διαρρήξατε τὰ ἱμάτια ὑμῶν καὶ περιζώσασθε σάκκους καὶ κόπτεσθε ἔμπροσθεν Αβεννηρ καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ ἐπορεύετο ὀπίσω τῆς κλίνης

text_en: And when they had buried Abner in Hebron , King David lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner : and all the people also wept.
text_la: Cumque sepelissent Abner in Hebron, levavit rex David vocem suam, et flevit super tumulum Abner : flevit autem et omnis populus.
text_pt: E, sepultando a Abner em Hebrom, o rei levantou a sua voz, e chorou junto da sepultura de Abner; e chorou todo o povo.
text_el: καὶ θάπτουσιν τὸν Αβεννηρ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ ἦρεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔκλαυσεν ἐπὶ τοῦ τάφου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔκλαυσεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐπὶ Αβεννηρ

text_en: And the king mourning and lamenting over Abner , said:Not as cowards are wont to die, has Abner died.
text_la: Plangensque rex, et lugens Abner, ait : Nequaquam ut mori solent ignavi, mortuus est Abner.
text_pt: E o rei, pranteando Abner, disse: Havia de morrer Abner como morre o vilão?
text_el: καὶ ἐθρήνησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ Αβεννηρ καὶ εἶπεν εἰ κατὰ τὸν θάνατον Ναβαλ ἀποθανεῖται Αβεννηρ

text_en: Your hands were not bound, nor your feet laden with fetters: but as men fall before the children of iniquity , so did you fall. And all the people repeating it wept over him.
text_la: Manus tuæ ligatæ non sunt, et pedes tui non sunt compedibus aggravati : sed sicut solent cadere coram filiis iniquitatis, sic corruisti. Congeminansque omnis populus flevit super eum.
text_pt: As tuas mãos não estavam atadas, nem os teus pés carregados de grilhões, mas caíste como os que caem diante dos filhos da maldade! Então todo o povo chorou muito mais por ele.
text_el: αἱ χεῖρές σου οὐκ ἐδέθησαν οἱ πόδες σου οὐκ ἐν πέδαις οὐ προσήγαγεν ὡς Ναβαλ ἐνώπιον υἱῶν ἀδικίας ἔπεσας καὶ συνήχθη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τοῦ κλαῦσαι αὐτόν

text_en: And when all the people came to take meat with David , while it was yet broad day, David swore , saying: So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else before sunset.
text_la: Cumque venisset universa multitudo cibum capere cum David, clara adhuc die juravit David, dicens : Hæc faciat mihi Deus, et hæc addat, si ante occasum solis gustavero panem vel aliud quidquam.
text_pt: Depois todo o povo veio fazer com que Davi comesse pão, sendo ainda dia; porém Davi jurou, dizendo: Assim Deus me faça, e outro tanto, se, antes que o sol se ponha, eu provar pão ou alguma coisa.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς περιδειπνῆσαι τὸν Δαυιδ ἄρτοις ἔτι οὔσης ἡμέρας καὶ ὤμοσεν Δαυιδ λέγων τάδε ποιήσαι μοι ὁ θεὸς καὶ τάδε προσθείη ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ δύῃ ὁ ἥλιος οὐ μὴ γεύσωμαι ἄρτου ἢ ἀπὸ παντός τινος

text_en: And all the people heard, and they were pleased, and all that the king did seemed good in the sight of all the people.
text_la: Omnisque populus audivit, et placuerunt eis cuncta quæ fecit rex in conspectu totius populi.
text_pt: O que todo o povo entendendo, pareceu bem aos seus olhos; assim como tudo quanto o rei fez pareceu bem aos olhos de todo o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω πᾶς ὁ λαός καὶ ἤρεσεν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐνώπιον τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And all the people, and all Israel understood that day that it was not the king's doing, that Abner the son of Ner was slain.
text_la: Et cognovit omne vulgus et universus Israël in die illa, quoniam non actum fuisset a rege ut occideretur Abner filius Ner.
text_pt: E todo o povo e todo o Israel entenderam naquele mesmo dia que não procedera do rei que matasse a Abner, filho de Ner.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω πᾶς ὁ λαὸς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὅτι οὐκ ἐγένετο παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως θανατῶσαι τὸν Αβεννηρ υἱὸν Νηρ

text_en: The king also said to his servants: Do you not know that a prince and a great man is slain this day in Israel ?
text_la: Dixit quoque rex ad servos suos : Num ignoratis quoniam princeps et maximus cecidit hodie in Israël?
text_pt: Então disse o rei aos seus servos: Não sabeis que hoje caiu em Israel um príncipe e um grande?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἡγούμενος μέγας πέπτωκεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: But I as yet am tender, though anointed king. And these men the sons of Sarvia are too hard for me: the Lord reward him that does evil according to his wickedness .
text_la: Ego autem adhuc delicatus, et unctus rex : porro viri isti filii Sarviæ duri sunt mihi : retribuat Dominus facienti malum juxta malitiam suam.
text_pt: Que eu hoje estou fraco, ainda que ungido rei; estes homens, filhos de Zeruia, são mais duros do que eu; o Senhor pagará ao malfeitor, conforme a sua maldade.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι σήμερον συγγενὴς καὶ καθεσταμένος ὑπὸ βασιλέως οἱ δὲ ἄνδρες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σαρουιας σκληρότεροί μού εἰσιν ἀνταποδῷ κύριος τῷ ποιοῦντι πονηρὰ κατὰ τὴν κακίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Isboseth the son of Saul heard that Abner was slain in Hebron : and his hands were weakened, and all Israel was troubled.
text_la: Audivit autem Isboseth filius Saul quod cecidisset Abner in Hebron : et dissolutæ sunt manus ejus, omnisque Israël perturbatus est.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, o filho de Saul, que Abner morrera em Hebrom, as mãos se lhe afrouxaram; e todo o Israel pasmou.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸς Σαουλ ὅτι τέθνηκεν Αβεννηρ ἐν Χεβρων καὶ ἐξελύθησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες Ισραηλ παρείθησαν

text_en: Now the son of Saul had two men captains of his bands, the name of the one was Baana, and the name of the other Rechab , the sons of Remmon a Berothite of the children of Benjamin : for Beroth also was reckoned in Benjamin .
text_la: Duo autem viri principes latronum erant filio Saul, nomen uni Baana, et nomen alteri Rechab, filii Remmon Berothitæ de filiis Benjamin : siquidem et Beroth reputata est in Benjamin.
text_pt: E tinha o filho de Saul dois homens capitães de tropas; e era o nome de um Baaná, e o nome do outro Recabe, filhos de Rimom, o beerotita, dos filhos de Benjamim, porque também Beerote se reputava de Benjamim.
text_el: καὶ δύο ἄνδρες ἡγούμενοι συστρεμμάτων τῷ Μεμφιβοσθε υἱῷ Σαουλ ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ Βαανα καὶ ὄνομα τῷ δευτέρῳ Ρηχαβ υἱοὶ Ρεμμων τοῦ Βηρωθαίου ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν ὅτι Βηρωθ ἐλογίζετο τοῖς υἱοῖς Βενιαμιν

text_en: And the Berothites fled into Gethaim, and were sojourners there until that time.
text_la: Et fugerunt Berothitæ in Gethaim, fueruntque ibi advenæ usque ad tempus illud.
text_pt: E tinham fugido os beerotitas para Gitaim, e ali têm peregrinado até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέδρασαν οἱ Βηρωθαῖοι εἰς Γεθθαιμ καὶ ἦσαν ἐκεῖ παροικοῦντες ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And Jonathan the son of Saul had a son that was lame of his feet: for he was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan from Jezrahel. And his nurse took him up and fled: and as she made haste to flee, he fell and became lame: and his name was Miphiboseth.
text_la: Erat autem Jonathæ filio Saul filius debilis pedibus : quinquennis enim fuit, quando venit nuntius de Saul et Jonatha ex Jezrahel. Tollens itaque eum nutrix sua, fugit : cumque festinaret ut fugeret, cecidit, et claudus effectus est : habuitque vocabulum Miphiboseth.
text_pt: E Jônatas, filho de Saul, tinha um filho aleijado de ambos os pés; era da idade de cinco anos quando as novas de Saul e Jônatas vieram de Jizreel, e sua ama o tomou, e fugiu; e sucedeu que, apressando-se ela a fugir, ele caiu, e ficou coxo; e o seu nome era Mefibosete.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ιωναθαν υἱῷ Σαουλ υἱὸς πεπληγὼς τοὺς πόδας υἱὸς ἐτῶν πέντε οὗτος ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν τὴν ἀγγελίαν Σαουλ καὶ Ιωναθαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐξ Ιεζραελ καὶ ἦρεν αὐτὸν ἡ τιθηνὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφυγεν καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ σπεύδειν αὐτὴν καὶ ἀναχωρεῖν καὶ ἔπεσεν καὶ ἐχωλάνθη καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Μεμφιβοσθε

text_en: And the sons of Remmon the Berothite , Rechab and Baana coming, went into the house of Isboseth in the heat of the day: and he was sleeping upon his bed at noon. And the doorkeeper of the house, who was cleansing wheat, was fallen asleep.
text_la: Venientes igitur filii Remmon Berothitæ, Rechab et Baana, ingressi sunt fervente die domum Isboseth : qui dormiebat super stratum suum meridie. Et ostiaria domus purgans triticum, obdormivit.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Rimom, o beerotita, Recabe e Baaná, e entraram em casa de Is-Bosete no maior calor do dia, estando ele deitado a dormir, ao meio-dia.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν υἱοὶ Ρεμμων τοῦ Βηρωθαίου Ρεκχα καὶ Βαανα καὶ εἰσῆλθον ἐν τῷ καύματι τῆς ἡμέρας εἰς οἶκον Μεμφιβοσθε καὶ αὐτὸς ἐκάθευδεν ἐν τῇ κοίτῃ τῆς μεσημβρίας

text_en: And they entered into the house secretly taking ears of corn, and Rechab and Baana his brother stabbed him in the groin, and fled away.
text_la: Ingressi sunt autem domum latenter assumentes spicas tritici, et percusserunt eum in inguine Rechab, et Baana frater ejus, et fugerunt.
text_pt: E ali entraram até ao meio da casa, como que vindo buscar trigo, e o feriram na quinta costela; e Recabe e Baaná, seu irmão, escaparam.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ θυρωρὸς τοῦ οἴκου ἐκάθαιρεν πυροὺς καὶ ἐνύσταξεν καὶ ἐκάθευδεν καὶ Ρεκχα καὶ Βαανα οἱ ἀδελφοὶ διέλαθον

text_en: For when they came into the house, he was sleeping upon his bed in a parlour, and they struck him and killed him and taking away his head they went off by the way of the wilderness , walking all night.
text_la: Cum autem ingressi fuissent domum, ille dormiebat super lectum suum in conclavi, et percutientes interfecerunt eum : sublatoque capite ejus, abierunt per viam deserti tota nocte,
text_pt: Porque entraram na sua casa, estando ele na cama deitado, no seu quarto, e o feriram, e o mataram, e lhe cortaram a cabeça; e, tomando a sua cabeça, andaram toda a noite caminhando pela planície.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ Μεμφιβοσθε ἐκάθευδεν ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κοιτῶνι αὐτοῦ καὶ τύπτουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ θανατοῦσιν καὶ ἀφαιροῦσιν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβον τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπῆλθον ὁδὸν τὴν κατὰ δυσμὰς ὅλην τὴν νύκτα

text_en: And they brought the head of Isboseth to David to Hebron : and they said to the king: Behold the head of Isboseth the son of Saul your enemy who sought your life: and the Lord has revenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed.
text_la: et attulerunt caput Isboseth ad David in Hebron : dixeruntque ad regem : Ecce caput Isboseth filii Saul inimici tui, qui quærebat animam tuam : et dedit Dominus domino meo regi ultionem hodie de Saul, et de semine ejus.
text_pt: E trouxeram a cabeça de Is-Bosete a Davi, a Hebrom, e disseram ao rei: Eis aqui a cabeça de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, teu inimigo, que procurava a tua morte; assim o SENHOR vingou hoje ao rei meu senhor, de Saul e da sua descendência.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκαν τὴν κεφαλὴν Μεμφιβοσθε τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ἰδοὺ ἡ κεφαλὴ Μεμφιβοσθε υἱοῦ Σαουλ τοῦ ἐχθροῦ σου ὃς ἐζήτει τὴν ψυχήν σου καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ βασιλεῖ ἐκδίκησιν τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ἐκ Σαουλ τοῦ ἐχθροῦ σου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: But David answered Rechab , and Baana his brother, the sons of Remmon the Berothite , and said to them: As the Lord lives, who has delivered my soul out of all distress,
text_la: Respondens autem David Rechab, et Baana fratri ejus, filiis Remmon Berothitæ, dixit ad eos : Vivit Dominus, qui eruit animam meam de omni angustia,
text_pt: Porém Davi, respondendo a Recabe e a Baaná, seu irmão, filhos de Rimom, o beerotita, disse-lhes: Vive o Senhor, que remiu a minha alma de toda a angústia,
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Δαυιδ τῷ Ρεκχα καὶ τῷ Βαανα ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ υἱοῖς Ρεμμων τοῦ Βηρωθαίου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ζῇ κύριος ὃς ἐλυτρώσατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ πάσης θλίψεως

text_en: the man that told me, and said: Saul is dead, who thought he brought good tidings, I apprehended, and slew him in Siceleg, who should have been rewarded for his news.
text_la: quoniam eum qui annuntiaverat mihi, et dixerat : Mortuus est Saul : qui putabat se prospera nuntiare, tenui, et occidi eum in Siceleg, cui oportebat mercedem dare pro nuntio.
text_pt: Se aquele que me trouxe novas, dizendo: Eis que Saul é morto, parecendo-lhe, porém, aos olhos que era como quem trazia boas novas, eu logo lancei mão dele, e o matei em Ziclague, cuidando ele que eu por isso lhe desse recompensa.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ ἀπαγγείλας μοι ὅτι τέθνηκεν Σαουλ καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ὡς εὐαγγελιζόμενος ἐνώπιόν μου καὶ κατέσχον αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέκτεινα ἐν Σεκελακ ᾧ ἔδει με δοῦναι εὐαγγέλια

text_en: How much more now when wicked men have slain an innocent man in his own house, upon his bed, shall I not require his blood at your hand, and take you away from the earth?
text_la: Quanto magis nunc cum homines impii interfecerunt virum innoxium in domo sua, super lectum suum, non quæram sanguinem ejus de manu vestra, et auferam vos de terra?
text_pt: Quanto mais a ímpios homens, que mataram um homem justo em sua casa, sobre a sua cama; agora, pois, não requereria eu o seu sangue de vossas mãos, e não vos exterminaria da terra?
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἄνδρες πονηροὶ ἀπεκτάγκασιν ἄνδρα δίκαιον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς κοίτης αὐτοῦ καὶ νῦν ἐκζητήσω τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And David commanded his servants and they slew them: and cutting off their hands and feet, hanged them up over the pool in Hebron : but the head of Isboseth they took and buried in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron .
text_la: Præcepit itaque David pueris suis, et interfecerunt eos : præcidentesque manus et pedes eorum, suspenderunt eos super piscinam in Hebron : caput autem Isboseth tulerunt, et sepelierunt in sepulchro Abner in Hebron.
text_pt: E deu Davi ordem aos seus moços que os matassem; e cortaram-lhes os pés e as mãos, e os penduraram sobre o tanque de Hebrom; tomaram, porém, a cabeça de Is-Bosete, e a sepultaram na sepultura de Abner, em Hebrom.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Δαυιδ τοῖς παιδαρίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀποκτέννουσιν αὐτοὺς καὶ κολοβοῦσιν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκρέμασαν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῆς κρήνης ἐν Χεβρων καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Μεμφιβοσθε ἔθαψαν ἐν τῷ τάφῳ Αβεννηρ υἱοῦ Νηρ

text_en: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David in Hebron , saying: Behold we are your bone and your flesh.
text_la: Et venerunt universæ tribus Israël ad David in Hebron, dicentes : Ecce nos os tuum et caro tua sumus.
text_pt: Então todas as tribos de Israel vieram a Davi, em Hebrom, e falaram, dizendo: Eis-nos aqui, somos teus ossos e tua carne.
text_el: καὶ παραγίνονται πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ ἰδοὺ ὀστᾶ σου καὶ σάρκες σου ἡμεῖς

text_en: Moreover yesterday also and the day before, when Saul was king over us, you were he that did lead out and bring in Israel : and the Lord said to you: You shall feed my people Israel , and you shall be prince over Israel .
text_la: Sed et heri et nudiustertius cum esset Saul rex super nos, tu eras educens et reducens Israël : dixit autem Dominus ad te : Tu pasces populum meum Israël, et tu eris dux super Israël.
text_pt: E também outrora, sendo Saul ainda rei sobre nós, eras tu o que saías e entravas com Israel; e também o Senhor te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo de Israel, e tu serás príncipe sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ὄντος Σαουλ βασιλέως ἐφ' ἡμῖν σὺ ἦσθα ὁ ἐξάγων καὶ εἰσάγων τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς σέ σὺ ποιμανεῖς τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ σὺ ἔσει εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: The ancients also of Israel came to the king of Hebron , and King David made a league with them in Hebron before the Lord : and they anointed David to be king over Israel .
text_la: Venerunt quoque et seniores Israël ad regem in Hebron, et percussit cum eis rex David fœdus in Hebron coram Domino : unxeruntque David in regem super Israël.
text_pt: Assim, pois, todos os anciãos de Israel vieram ao rei, em Hebrom; e o rei Davi fez com eles acordo em Hebrom, perante o Senhor; e ungiram a Davi rei sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχονται πάντες οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα εἰς Χεβρων καὶ διέθετο αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ διαθήκην ἐν Χεβρων ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ χρίουσιν τὸν Δαυιδ εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ

text_en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
text_la: Filius triginta annorum erat David cum regnare cœpisset, et quadraginta annis regnavit.
text_pt: Da idade de trinta anos era Davi quando começou a reinar; quarenta anos reinou.
text_el: υἱὸς τριάκοντα ἐτῶν Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτὸν καὶ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν

text_en: In Hebron he reigned over Juda seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned three and thirty years over all Israel and Juda .
text_la: In Hebron regnavit super Judam septem annis et sex mensibus : in Jerusalem autem regnavit triginta tribus annis super omnem Israël et Judam.
text_pt: Em Hebrom reinou sobre Judá sete anos e seis meses, e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos sobre todo o Israel e Judá.
text_el: ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἓξ μῆνας ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Χεβρων ἐπὶ τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ τριάκοντα τρία ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And the king and all the men that were with him went to Jerusalem to the Jebusites the inhabitants of the land: and they said to David : You shall not come in hither unless you take away the blind and the lame that say: David shall not come in hither.
text_la: Et abiit rex, et omnes viri qui erant cum eo, in Jerusalem, ad Jebusæum habitatorem terræ : dictumque est David ab eis : Non ingredieris huc, nisi abstuleris cæcos et claudos dicentes : Non ingredietur David huc.
text_pt: E partiu o rei com os seus homens a Jerusalém, contra os jebuseus que habitavam naquela terra; e falaram a Davi, dizendo: Não entrarás aqui, pois os cegos e os coxos te repelirão, querendo dizer: Não entrará Davi aqui.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ πρὸς τὸν Ιεβουσαῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐρρέθη τῷ Δαυιδ οὐκ εἰσελεύσει ὧδε ὅτι ἀντέστησαν οἱ τυφλοὶ καὶ οἱ χωλοί λέγοντες ὅτι οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται Δαυιδ ὧδε

text_en: But David took the castle of Sion, the same is the city of David.
text_la: Cepit autem David arcem Sion : hæc est civitas David.
text_pt: Porém Davi tomou a fortaleza de Sião; esta é a cidade de Davi.
text_el: καὶ κατελάβετο Δαυιδ τὴν περιοχὴν Σιων αὕτη ἡ πόλις τοῦ Δαυιδ

text_en: For David had offered that day a reward to whosoever should strike the Jebusites and get up to the gutters of the tops of the houses, and take away the blind and the lame that hated the soul of David : therefore it is said in the proverb: The blind and the lame shall not come into the temple .
text_la: Proposuerat enim David in die illa præmium, qui percussisset Jebusæum, et tetigisset domatum fistulas, et abstulisset cæcos et claudos odientes animam David. Idcirco dicitur in proverbio : Cæcus et claudus non intrabunt in templum.
text_pt: Porque Davi disse naquele dia: Qualquer que ferir aos jebuseus, suba ao canal e fira aos coxos e aos cegos, a quem a alma de Davi odeia. Por isso se diz: Nem cego nem coxo entrará nesta casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ πᾶς τύπτων Ιεβουσαῖον ἁπτέσθω ἐν παραξιφίδι καὶ τοὺς χωλοὺς καὶ τοὺς τυφλοὺς καὶ τοὺς μισοῦντας τὴν ψυχὴν Δαυιδ διὰ τοῦτο ἐροῦσιν τυφλοὶ καὶ χωλοὶ οὐκ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: And David dwelt in the castle, and called it, The city of David: and built round about from Mello and inwards.
text_la: Habitavit autem David in arce, et vocavit eam civitatem David : et ædificavit per gyrum a Mello et intrinsecus.
text_pt: Assim habitou Davi na fortaleza, e a chamou a cidade de Davi; e Davi foi edificando em redor, desde Milo para dentro.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Δαυιδ ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ καὶ ἐκλήθη αὕτη ἡ πόλις Δαυιδ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν πόλιν κύκλῳ ἀπὸ τῆς ἄκρας καὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he went on prospering and growing up, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.
text_la: Et ingrediebatur proficiens atque succrescens, et Dominus Deus exercituum erat cum eo.
text_pt: E Davi ia, cada vez mais, aumentando e crescendo, porque o Senhor Deus dos Exércitos era com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύετο Δαυιδ πορευόμενος καὶ μεγαλυνόμενος καὶ κύριος παντοκράτωρ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Hiram the king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters, and masons for walls: and they built a house for David .
text_la: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri nuntios ad David, et ligna cedrina, et artifices lignorum, artificesque lapidum ad parietes : et ædificaverunt domum David.
text_pt: E Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou mensageiros a Davi, e madeira de cedro, e carpinteiros, e pedreiros que edificaram a Davi uma casa.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Χιραμ βασιλεὺς Τύρου ἀγγέλους πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ξύλα κέδρινα καὶ τέκτονας ξύλων καὶ τέκτονας λίθων καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν οἶκον τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: And David knew that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom over his people Israel .
text_la: Et cognovit David quoniam confirmasset eum Dominus regem super Israël, et quoniam exaltasset regnum ejus super populum suum Israël.
text_pt: E entendeu Davi que o Senhor o confirmara rei sobre Israel, e que exaltara o seu reino por amor do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Δαυιδ ὅτι ἡτοίμασεν αὐτὸν κύριος εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ὅτι ἐπήρθη ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And David took more concubines and wives of Jerusalem , after he had come from Hebron : and there were born to David other sons also and daughters:
text_la: Accepit ergo David adhuc concubinas et uxores de Jerusalem, postquam venerat de Hebron : natique sunt David et alii filii et filiæ:
text_pt: E tomou Davi mais concubinas e mulheres de Jerusalém, depois que viera de Hebrom; e nasceram a Davi mais filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ ἔτι γυναῖκας καὶ παλλακὰς ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ μετὰ τὸ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐκ Χεβρων καὶ ἐγένοντο τῷ Δαυιδ ἔτι υἱοὶ καὶ θυγατέρες

text_en: And these are the names of them, that were born to him in Jerusalem , Samua, and Sobab, and Nathan , and Solomon ,
text_la: et hæc nomina eorum, qui nati sunt ei in Jerusalem : Samua, et Sobab, et Nathan, et Salomon,
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos que lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Samua, e Sobabe, e Natã, e Salomão,
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν γεννηθέντων αὐτῷ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ Σαμμους καὶ Σωβαβ καὶ Ναθαν καὶ Σαλωμων

text_en: and Jebahar, and Elisua, and Nepheg,
text_la: et Jebahar, et Elisua, et Nepheg,
text_pt: E Ibar, e Elisua, e Nefegue, e Jafia,
text_el: καὶ Εβεαρ καὶ Ελισους καὶ Ναφεκ καὶ Ιεφιες

text_en: and Japhia, and Elisama, and Elioda, and Eliphaleth.
text_la: et Japhia, et Elisama, et Elioda, et Eliphaleth.
text_pt: E Elisama, e Eliada, e Elifelete.
text_el: καὶ Ελισαμα καὶ Ελιδαε καὶ Ελιφαλαθ

text_en: And the Philistines heard that they had anointed David to be king over Israel : and they all came to seek David : and when David heard of it, he went down to a strong hold.
text_la: Audierunt ergo Philisthiim quod unxissent David in regem super Israël, et ascenderunt universi ut quærerent David : quod cum audisset David, descendit in præsidium.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, os filisteus que haviam ungido a Davi rei sobre Israel, todos os filisteus subiram em busca de Davi; o que ouvindo Davi, desceu à fortaleza.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν ἀλλόφυλοι ὅτι κέχρισται Δαυιδ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνέβησαν πάντες οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ζητεῖν τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ ἤκουσεν Δαυιδ καὶ κατέβη εἰς τὴν περιοχήν

text_en: And the Philistines coming spread themselves in the valley of Raphaim.
text_la: Philisthiim autem venientes diffusi sunt in valle Raphaim.
text_pt: E os filisteus vieram, e se estenderam pelo vale de Refaim.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι παραγίνονται καὶ συνέπεσαν εἰς τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν τιτάνων

text_en: And David consulted the Lord , Saying: Shall I go up to the Philistines ? And will you deliver them into my hand? And the Lord said to David : Go up, for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hand.
text_la: Et consuluit David Dominum, dicens : Si ascendam ad Philisthiim? et si dabis eos in manu mea? Et dixit Dominus ad David : Ascende, quia tradens dabo Philisthiim in manu tua.
text_pt: E Davi consultou ao Senhor, dizendo: Subirei contra os filisteus? Entregar-mos-ás nas minhas mãos? E disse o Senhor a Davi: Sobe, porque certamente entregarei os filisteus nas tuas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησεν Δαυιδ διὰ κυρίου λέγων εἰ ἀναβῶ πρὸς τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ παραδώσεις αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Δαυιδ ἀνάβαινε ὅτι παραδιδοὺς παραδώσω τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου

text_en: And David came to Baal Pharisim: and defeated them there, and he said, The Lord has divided my enemies before me, as waters are divided. Therefore the name of the place was called Baal Pharisim.
text_la: Venit ergo David in Baal Pharasim : et percussit eos ibi, et dixit : Divisit Dominus inimicos meos coram me, sicut dividuntur aquæ. Propterea vocatum est nomen loci illius, Baal Pharasim.
text_pt: Então foi Davi a Baal-Perazim; e feriu-os ali Davi, e disse: Rompeu o Senhor a meus inimigos diante de mim, como quem rompe águas. Por isso chamou o nome daquele lugar Baal-Perazim.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Δαυιδ ἐκ τῶν ἐπάνω διακοπῶν καὶ ἔκοψεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ἐκεῖ καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ διέκοψεν κύριος τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ὡς διακόπτεται ὕδατα διὰ τοῦτο ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου ἐπάνω διακοπῶν

text_en: And they left there their idols: which David and his men took away.
text_la: Et reliquerunt ibi sculptilia sua, quæ tulit David et viri ejus.
text_pt: E deixaram ali os seus ídolos; e Davi e os seus homens os tomaram.
text_el: καὶ καταλιμπάνουσιν ἐκεῖ τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλάβοσαν αὐτοὺς Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Philistines came up again and spread themselves into the valley of Raphaim.
text_la: Et addiderunt adhuc Philisthiim ut ascenderent, et diffusi sunt in valle Raphaim.
text_pt: E os filisteus tornaram a subir, e se estenderam pelo vale de Refaim.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι ἀλλόφυλοι τοῦ ἀναβῆναι καὶ συνέπεσαν ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῶν τιτάνων

text_en: And David consulted the Lord : Shall I go up against the Philistines , and will you deliver them into my hands? He answered: Go not up against them but fetch a compass behind them, and you shall come upon them over against the pear trees.
text_la: Consuluit autem David Dominum : Si ascendam contra Philisthæos, et tradas eos in manus meas? Qui respondit : Non ascendas contra eos, sed gyra post tergum eorum, et venies ad eos ex adverso pyrorum.
text_pt: E Davi consultou ao Senhor, o qual disse: Não subirás; mas rodeia por detrás deles, e virás a eles por defronte das amoreiras.
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν Δαυιδ διὰ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν κύριος οὐκ ἀναβήσει εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῶν ἀποστρέφου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ παρέσει αὐτοῖς πλησίον τοῦ κλαυθμῶνος
