text_en: And when you shall hear the sound of one going in the tops of the pear trees, then shall you join battle: for then will the Lord go out before your face to strike the army of the Philistines .
text_la: Et cum audieris sonitum gradientis in cacumine pyrorum, tunc inibis prælium : quia tunc egredietur Dominus ante faciem tuam, ut percutiat castra Philisthiim.
text_pt: E há de ser que, ouvindo tu um estrondo de marcha pelas copas das amoreiras, então te apressarás; porque o Senhor saiu então diante de ti, a ferir o arraial dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαί σε τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ συγκλεισμοῦ τοῦ ἄλσους τοῦ κλαυθμῶνος τότε καταβήσει πρὸς αὐτούς ὅτι τότε ἐξελεύσεται κύριος ἔμπροσθέν σου κόπτειν ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And David did as the Lord had commanded him, and he smote the Philistines from Gabaa until you come to Gezer.
text_la: Fecit itaque David sicut præceperat ei Dominus, et percussit Philisthiim de Gabaa usque dum venias Gezer.
text_pt: E fez Davi assim como o Senhor lhe tinha ordenado; e feriu os filisteus desde Geba, até chegar a Gezer.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Δαυιδ καθὼς ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ἀπὸ Γαβαων ἕως τῆς γῆς Γαζηρα

text_en: And David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand.
text_la: Congregavit autem rursum David omnes electos ex Israël, triginta millia.
text_pt: E tornou Davi a ajuntar todos os escolhidos de Israel, em número de trinta mil.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν ἔτι Δαυιδ πάντα νεανίαν ἐξ Ισραηλ ὡς ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδας

text_en: And David arose and went, with all the people that were with him of the men of Juda to fetch the ark of God , upon which the name of the Lord of Hosts is invoked, who sits over it upon the cherubims .
text_la: Surrexitque David, et abiit, et universus populus qui erat cum eo de viris Juda, ut adducerent arcam Dei, super quam invocatum est nomen Domini exercituum, sedentis in cherubim super eam.
text_pt: E levantou-se Davi, e partiu, com todo o povo que tinha consigo, para Baalim de Judá, para levarem dali para cima a arca de Deus, sobre a qual se invoca o nome, o nome do Senhor dos Exércitos, que se assenta entre os querubins.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἐπορεύθη Δαυιδ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρχόντων Ιουδα ἐν ἀναβάσει τοῦ ἀναγαγεῖν ἐκεῖθεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐφ' ἣν ἐπεκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων καθημένου ἐπὶ τῶν Χερουβιν ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: And they laid the ark of God upon a new cart: and took it out of the house of Abinadab, who was in Gabaa, and Oza and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
text_la: Et imposuerunt arcam Dei super plaustrum novum : tuleruntque eam de domo Abinadab, qui erat in Gabaa : Oza autem et Ahio, filii Abinadab, minabant plaustrum novum.
text_pt: E puseram a arca de Deus em um carro novo, e a levaram da casa de Abinadabe, que está em Gibeá; e Uzá e Aiô, filhos de Abinadabe, guiavam o carro novo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεβίβασεν τὴν κιβωτὸν κυρίου ἐφ' ἅμαξαν καινὴν καὶ ἦρεν αὐτὴν ἐξ οἴκου Αμιναδαβ τοῦ ἐν τῷ βουνῷ καὶ Οζα καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ Αμιναδαβ ἦγον τὴν ἅμαξαν

text_en: And when they had taken it out of the house of Abinadab, who was in Gabaa, Ahio having care of the ark of God went before the ark .
text_la: Cumque tulissent eam de domo Abinadab, qui erat in Gabaa, custodiens arcam Dei Ahio præcedebat arcam.
text_pt: E levando-o da casa de Abinadabe, que está em Gibeá, com a arca de Deus, Aiô ia adiante da arca.
text_el: σὺν τῇ κιβωτῷ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπορεύοντο ἔμπροσθεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ

text_en: But David and all Israel played before the Lord on all manner of instruments made of wood, on harps and lutes and timbrels and cornets and cymbals.
text_la: David autem et omnis Israël ludebant coram Domino in omnibus lignis fabrefactis, et citharis et lyris et tympanis et sistris et cymbalis.
text_pt: E Davi, e toda a casa de Israel, festejavam perante o Senhor, com toda a sorte de instrumentos de pau de faia, como também com harpas, e com saltérios, e com tamboris, e com pandeiros, e com címbalos.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ παίζοντες ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἐν ὀργάνοις ἡρμοσμένοις ἐν ἰσχύι καὶ ἐν ᾠδαῖς καὶ ἐν κινύραις καὶ ἐν νάβλαις καὶ ἐν τυμπάνοις καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις καὶ ἐν αὐλοῖς

text_en: And when they came to the floor of Nachon, Oza put forth his hand to the ark of God , and took hold of it: because the oxen kicked and made it lean aside.
text_la: Postquam autem venerunt ad aream Nachon, extendit Oza manum ad arcam Dei, et tenuit eam : quoniam calcitrabant boves, et declinaverunt eam.
text_pt: E, chegando à eira de Nacom, estendeu Uzá a mão à arca de Deus, e pegou nela; porque os bois a deixavam pender.
text_el: καὶ παραγίνονται ἕως ἅλω Νωδαβ καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Οζα τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ κατασχεῖν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐκράτησεν αὐτήν ὅτι περιέσπασεν αὐτὴν ὁ μόσχος τοῦ κατασχεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: And the indignation of the Lord was enkindled against Oza, and he struck him for his rashness: and he died there before the ark of God .
text_la: Iratusque est indignatione Dominus contra Ozam, et percussit eum super temeritate : qui mortuus est ibi juxta arcam Dei.
text_pt: Então a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra Uzá, e Deus o feriu ali por esta imprudência; e morreu ali junto à arca de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη κύριος τῷ Οζα καὶ ἔπαισεν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ ὁ θεός καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ παρὰ τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ κυρίου ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And David was grieved because the Lord had struck Oza, and the name of that place was called: The striking of Oza, to this day.
text_la: Contristatus est autem David, eo quod percussisset Dominus Ozam, et vocatum est nomen loci illius : Percussio Ozæ, usque in diem hanc.
text_pt: E Davi se contristou, porque o Senhor abrira rotura em Uzá; e chamou àquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἠθύμησεν Δαυιδ ὑπὲρ οὗ διέκοψεν κύριος διακοπὴν ἐν τῷ Οζα καὶ ἐκλήθη ὁ τόπος ἐκεῖνος διακοπὴ Οζα ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And David was afraid of the Lord that day, saying: How shall the ark of the Lord come to me?
text_la: Et extimuit David Dominum in die illa, dicens : Quomodo ingredietur ad me arca Domini?
text_pt: E temeu Davi ao Senhor naquele dia; e disse: Como virá a mim a arca do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη Δαυιδ τὸν κύριον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγων πῶς εἰσελεύσεται πρός με ἡ κιβωτὸς κυρίου

text_en: And he would not have the ark of the Lord brought in to himself into the city of David: but he caused it to be carried into the house of Obededom the Gethite.
text_la: Et noluit divertere ad se arcam Domini in civitatem David : sed divertit eam in domum Obededom Gethæi.
text_pt: E não quis Davi retirar para junto de si a arca do Senhor, à cidade de Davi; mas Davi a fez levar à casa de Obede-Edom, o giteu.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐβούλετο Δαυιδ τοῦ ἐκκλῖναι πρὸς αὑτὸν τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης κυρίου εἰς τὴν πόλιν Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέκλινεν αὐτὴν Δαυιδ εἰς οἶκον Αβεδδαρα τοῦ Γεθθαίου

text_en: And the ark of the Lord abode in the house of Obededom the Gethite three months: and the Lord blessed Obededom, and all his household.
text_la: Et habitavit arca Domini in domo Obededom Gethæi tribus mensibus : et benedixit Dominus Obededom, et omnem domum ejus.
text_pt: E ficou a arca do Senhor em casa de Obede-Edom, o giteu, três meses; e abençoou o Senhor a Obede-Edom, e a toda a sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἡ κιβωτὸς τοῦ κυρίου εἰς οἶκον Αβεδδαρα τοῦ Γεθθαίου μῆνας τρεῖς καὶ εὐλόγησεν κύριος ὅλον τὸν οἶκον Αβεδδαρα καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it was told King David , that the Lord had blessed Obededom, and all that he had, because of the ark of God . So David went, and brought away the ark of God out of the house of Obededom into the city of David with joy . And there were with David seven choirs, and calves for victims.
text_la: Nuntiatumque est regi David quod benedixisset Dominus Obededom, et omnia ejus, propter arcam Dei. Abiit ergo David, et adduxit arcam Dei de domo Obededom in civitatem David cum gaudio : et erant cum David septem chori, et victima vituli.
text_pt: Então avisaram a Davi, dizendo: Abençoou o Senhor a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo quanto tem, por causa da arca de Deus; foi pois Davi, e trouxe a arca de Deus para cima, da casa de Obede-Edom, à cidade de Davi, com alegria.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ βασιλεῖ Δαυιδ λέγοντες ηὐλόγησεν κύριος τὸν οἶκον Αβεδδαρα καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Δαυιδ καὶ ἀνήγαγεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Αβεδδαρα εἰς τὴν πόλιν Δαυιδ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ

text_en: And when they that carried the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, he sacrificed and ox and a ram:
text_la: Cumque transcendissent qui portabant arcam Domini sex passus, immolabat bovem et arietem,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, quando os que levavam a arca do Senhor tinham dado seis passos, sacrificava bois e carneiros cevados.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν μετ' αὐτῶν αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν ἑπτὰ χοροὶ καὶ θῦμα μόσχος καὶ ἄρνα

text_en: And David danced with all his might before the Lord : and David was girded with a linen ephod .
text_la: et David saltabat totis viribus ante Dominum : porro David erat accinctus ephod lineo.
text_pt: E Davi saltava com todas as suas forças diante do Senhor; e estava Davi cingido de um éfode de linho.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ ἀνεκρούετο ἐν ὀργάνοις ἡρμοσμένοις ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ ὁ Δαυιδ ἐνδεδυκὼς στολὴν ἔξαλλον

text_en: And David and all the louse of Israel brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord with joyful shouting, and with sound of trumpet.
text_la: Et David et omnis domus Israël ducebant arcam testamenti Domini in jubilo, et in clangore buccinæ.
text_pt: Assim subindo, levavam Davi e todo o Israel a arca do Senhor, com júbilo, e ao som das trombetas.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Ισραηλ ἀνήγαγον τὴν κιβωτὸν κυρίου μετὰ κραυγῆς καὶ μετὰ φωνῆς σάλπιγγος

text_en: And when the ark of the Lord had come into the city of David, Michol the daughter of Saul , looking out through a window, saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord : and she despised him in her heart.
text_la: Cumque intrasset arca Domini in civitatem David, Michol filia Saul, prospiciens per fenestram, vidit regem David subsilientem atque saltantem coram Domino : et despexit eum in corde suo.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, entrando a arca do Senhor na cidade de Davi, Mical, a filha de Saul, estava olhando pela janela; e, vendo ao rei Davi, que ia bailando e saltando diante do Senhor, o desprezou no seu coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῆς κιβωτοῦ παραγινομένης ἕως πόλεως Δαυιδ καὶ Μελχολ ἡ θυγάτηρ Σαουλ διέκυπτεν διὰ τῆς θυρίδος καὶ εἶδεν τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ ὀρχούμενον καὶ ἀνακρουόμενον ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ ἐξουδένωσεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς

text_en: And they brought the ark of the Lord , and set it in its place in the midst of the tabernacle , which David had pitched for it: and David offered holocausts , and peace offerings before the Lord .
text_la: Et introduxerunt arcam Domini, et imposuerunt eam in loco suo in medio tabernaculi, quod tetenderat ei David : et obtulit David holocausta et pacifica coram Domino.
text_pt: E introduzindo a arca do Senhor, a puseram no seu lugar, na tenda que Davi lhe armara; e ofereceu Davi holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ φέρουσιν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀνέθηκαν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς εἰς μέσον τῆς σκηνῆς ἧς ἔπηξεν αὐτῇ Δαυιδ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν Δαυιδ ὁλοκαυτώματα ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ εἰρηνικάς

text_en: And when he had made an end of offering holocausts and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Cumque complesset offerens holocausta et pacifica, benedixit populo in nomine Domini exercituum.
text_pt: E acabando Davi de oferecer os holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas, abençoou o povo em nome do Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ συνετέλεσεν Δαυιδ συναναφέρων τὰς ὁλοκαυτώσεις καὶ τὰς εἰρηνικὰς καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν λαὸν ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων

text_en: And he distributed to all the multitude of Israel , both men and women , to every one, a cake of bread, and a piece of roasted beef, and fine flour fried with oil: and all the people departed every one to his own house.
text_la: Et partitus est universæ multitudini Israël tam viro quam mulieri singulis collyridam panis unam, et assaturam bubulæ carnis unam, et similam frixam oleo : et abiit omnis populus, unusquisque in domum suam.
text_pt: E repartiu a todo o povo, e a toda a multidão de Israel, desde os homens até às mulheres, a cada um, um bolo de pão, e um bom pedaço de carne, e um frasco de vinho; então retirou-se todo o povo, cada um para sua casa,
text_el: καὶ διεμέρισεν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ Δαν ἕως Βηρσαβεε ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἕως γυναικὸς ἑκάστῳ κολλυρίδα ἄρτου καὶ ἐσχαρίτην καὶ λάγανον ἀπὸ τηγάνου καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And David returned to bless his own house: and Michol the daughter of Saul coming out to meet David , said: How glorious was the king of Israel to day, uncovering himself before the handmaids of his servants, and was naked, as if one of the buffoons should be naked.
text_la: Reversusque est David ut benediceret domui suæ : et egressa Michol filia Saul in occursum David, ait : Quam gloriosus fuit hodie rex Israël discooperiens se ante ancillas servorum suorum, et nudatus est, quasi si nudetur unus de scurris.
text_pt: E, voltando Davi para abençoar a sua casa, Mical, a filha de Saul, saiu a encontrar-se com Davi, e disse: Quão honrado foi o rei de Israel, descobrindo-se hoje aos olhos das servas de seus servos, como sem pejo se descobre qualquer dos vadios.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Δαυιδ εὐλογῆσαι τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Μελχολ ἡ θυγάτηρ Σαουλ εἰς ἀπάντησιν Δαυιδ καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν τί δεδόξασται σήμερον ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ὃς ἀπεκαλύφθη σήμερον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς παιδισκῶν τῶν δούλων ἑαυτοῦ καθὼς ἀποκαλύπτεται ἀποκαλυφθεὶς εἷς τῶν ὀρχουμένων

text_en: And David said to Michol: Before the Lord , who chose me rather than your father, and than all his house, and commanded me to be ruler over the people of the Lord in Israel ,
text_la: Dixitque David ad Michol : Ante Dominum, qui elegit me potius quam patrem tuum et quam omnem domum ejus, et præcepit mihi ut essem dux super populum Domini in Israël
text_pt: Disse, porém, Davi a Mical: Perante o Senhor, que me escolheu preferindo-me a teu pai, e a toda a sua casa, mandando-me que fosse soberano sobre o povo do Senhor, sobre Israel, perante o Senhor tenho me alegrado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Μελχολ ἐνώπιον κυρίου ὀρχήσομαι εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὃς ἐξελέξατό με ὑπὲρ τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ ὑπὲρ πάντα τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ τοῦ καταστῆσαί με εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ παίξομαι καὶ ὀρχήσομαι ἐνώπιον κυρίου

text_en: I will both play and make myself meaner than I have done: and I will be little in my own eyes: and with the handmaids of whom you speak, I shall appear more glorious .
text_la: et Iudam, et vilior fiam plus quam factus sum : et ero humilis in oculis meis, et cum ancillis de quibus locuta es, gloriosior apparebo.
text_pt: E ainda mais do que isto me envilecerei, e me humilharei aos meus olhos; mas das servas, de quem falaste, delas serei honrado.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκαλυφθήσομαι ἔτι οὕτως καὶ ἔσομαι ἀχρεῖος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου καὶ μετὰ τῶν παιδισκῶν ὧν εἶπάς με δοξασθῆναι

text_en: Therefore Michol the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
text_la: Igitur Michol filiæ Saul non est natus filius usque in diem mortis suæ.
text_pt: E Mical, a filha de Saul, não teve filhos, até o dia da sua morte.
text_el: καὶ τῇ Μελχολ θυγατρὶ Σαουλ οὐκ ἐγένετο παιδίον ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: And it came to pass when the king sat in his house, and the Lord had given him rest on every side from all his enemies,
text_la: Factum est autem cum sedisset rex in domo sua, et Dominus dedisset ei requiem undique ab universis inimicis suis,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, estando o rei Davi em sua casa, e tendo o SENHOR lhe dado descanso de todos os seus inimigos em redor,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐκάθισεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ κύριος κατεκληρονόμησεν αὐτὸν κύκλῳ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν κύκλῳ

text_en: he said to Nathan the prophet : Do you see that I dwell in a house of cedar , and the ark of God is lodged within skins?
text_la: dixit ad Nathan prophetam : Videsne quod ego habitem in domo cedrina, et arca Dei posita sit in medio pellium?
text_pt: Disse o rei ao profeta Natã: Eis que eu moro em casa de cedro, e a arca de Deus mora dentro de cortinas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Ναθαν τὸν προφήτην ἰδοὺ δὴ ἐγὼ κατοικῶ ἐν οἴκῳ κεδρίνῳ καὶ ἡ κιβωτὸς τοῦ θεοῦ κάθηται ἐν μέσῳ τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And Nathan said to the king: Go, do all that is in they heart: because the Lord is with you.
text_la: Dixitque Nathan ad regem : Omne quod est in corde tuo, vade, fac : quia Dominus tecum est.
text_pt: E disse Natã ao rei: Vai, e faze tudo quanto está no teu coração; porque o Senhor é contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ναθαν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου βάδιζε καὶ ποίει ὅτι κύριος μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: But it came to pass that night, that the word of the Lord came to Nathan , saying:
text_la: Factum est autem in illa nocte : et ecce sermo Domini ad Nathan, dicens:
text_pt: Porém sucedeu naquela mesma noite, que a palavra do Senhor veio a Natã, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἐγένετο ῥῆμα κυρίου πρὸς Ναθαν λέγων

text_en: Go, and say to my servant David : Thus says the Lord : Shall you build me a house to dwell in?
text_la: Vade, et loquere ad servum meum David : Hæc dicit Dominus : Numquid tu ædificabis mihi domum ad habitandum?
text_pt: Vai, e dize a meu servo Davi: Assim diz o Senhor: Edificar-me-ás tu uma casa para minha habitação?
text_el: πορεύου καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς τὸν δοῦλόν μου Δαυιδ τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐ σὺ οἰκοδομήσεις μοι οἶκον τοῦ κατοικῆσαί με

text_en: Whereas I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt even to this day: but have walked in a tabernacle , and in a tent.
text_la: Neque enim habitavi in domo ex die illa, qua eduxi filios Israël de terra Ægypti, usque in diem hanc : sed ambulabam in tabernaculo, et in tentorio.
text_pt: Porque em casa nenhuma habitei desde o dia em que fiz subir os filhos de Israel do Egito até ao dia de hoje; mas andei em tenda e em tabernáculo.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ κατῴκηκα ἐν οἴκῳ ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἀνήγαγον ἐξ Αἰγύπτου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ἤμην ἐμπεριπατῶν ἐν καταλύματι καὶ ἐν σκηνῇ

text_en: In all the places that I have gone through with all the children of Israel , did ever I speak a word to any one of the tribes of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people Israel , saying: Why have you not built me a house of cedar ?
text_la: Per cuncta loca quæ transivi cum omnibus filiis Israël, numquid loquens locutus sum ad unam de tribubus Israël, cui præcepi ut pasceret populum meum Israël, dicens : Quare non ædificastis mihi domum cedrinam?
text_pt: E em todo o lugar em que andei com todos os filhos de Israel, falei porventura alguma palavra a alguma das tribos de Israel, a quem mandei apascentar o meu povo de Israel, dizendo: Por que não me edificais uma casa de cedro?
text_el: ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς διῆλθον ἐν παντὶ Ισραηλ εἰ λαλῶν ἐλάλησα πρὸς μίαν φυλὴν τοῦ Ισραηλ ᾧ ἐνετειλάμην ποιμαίνειν τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ λέγων τί ὅτι οὐκ ᾠκοδομήκατέ μοι οἶκον κέδρινον

text_en: And now thus shall you speak to my servant David : Thus says the Lord of hosts : I took you out of the pastures from following the sheep to be ruler over my people Israel :
text_la: Et nunc hæc dices servo meo David : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ego tuli te de pascuis sequentem greges, ut esses dux super populum meum Israël:
text_pt: Agora, pois, assim dirás ao meu servo Davi: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eu te tomei da malhada, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses o soberano sobre o meu povo, sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ νῦν τάδε ἐρεῖς τῷ δούλῳ μου Δαυιδ τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἔλαβόν σε ἐκ τῆς μάνδρας τῶν προβάτων τοῦ εἶναί σε εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And I have been with you wheresoever you have walked, and have slain all your enemies from before your face: and I have made you a great man , like unto the name of the great ones that are on the earth.
text_la: et fui tecum in omnibus ubicumque ambulasti, et interfeci universos inimicos tuos a facie tua : fecique tibi nomen grande, juxta nomen magnorum qui sunt in terra.
text_pt: E fui contigo, por onde quer que foste, e destruí a teus inimigos diante de ti; e fiz grande o teu nome, como o nome dos grandes que há na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἤμην μετὰ σοῦ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύου καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσα πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἐποίησά σε ὀνομαστὸν κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα τῶν μεγάλων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel , and I will plant them, and they shall dwell therein, and shall be disturbed no more: neither shall the children of iniquity afflict them any more as they did before,
text_la: Et ponam locum populo meo Israël, et plantabo eum, et habitabit sub eo, et non turbabitur amplius : nec addent filii iniquitatis ut affligant eum sicut prius,
text_pt: E prepararei lugar para o meu povo, para Israel, e o plantarei, para que habite no seu lugar, e não mais seja removido, e nunca mais os filhos da perversidade o aflijam, como dantes,
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι τόπον τῷ λαῷ μου τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ καταφυτεύσω αὐτόν καὶ κατασκηνώσει καθ' ἑαυτὸν καὶ οὐ μεριμνήσει οὐκέτι καὶ οὐ προσθήσει υἱὸς ἀδικίας τοῦ ταπεινῶσαι αὐτὸν καθὼς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς

text_en: from the day that I appointed judges over my people Israel : and I will give you rest g all your enemies. And the Lord foretells to you, that the Lord will make you a house.
text_la: ex die qua constitui judices super populum meum Israël : et requiem dabo tibi ab omnibus inimicis tuis : prædicitque tibi Dominus quod domum faciat tibi Dominus.
text_pt: E desde o dia em que mandei que houvesse juízes sobre o meu povo Israel; a ti, porém, te dei descanso de todos os teus inimigos; também o Senhor te faz saber que te fará casa.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν ἡμερῶν ὧν ἔταξα κριτὰς ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ καὶ ἀναπαύσω σε ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου καὶ ἀπαγγελεῖ σοι κύριος ὅτι οἶκον οἰκοδομήσεις αὐτῷ

text_en: And when your days shall be fulfilled, and you shall sleep with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, which shall proceed out of the bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
text_la: Cumque completi fuerint dies tui, et dormieris cum patribus tuis, suscitabo semen tuum post te, quod egredietur de utero tuo, et firmabo regnum ejus.
text_pt: Quando teus dias forem completos, e vieres a dormir com teus pais, então farei levantar depois de ti um dentre a tua descendência, o qual sairá das tuas entranhas, e estabelecerei o seu reino.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ ἡμέραι σου καὶ κοιμηθήσῃ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων σου καὶ ἀναστήσω τὸ σπέρμα σου μετὰ σέ ὃς ἔσται ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall build a house to my name , and I will establish the throne of his kingdom fore ever.
text_la: Ipse ædificabit domum nomini meo, et stabiliam thronum regni ejus usque in sempiternum.
text_pt: Este edificará uma casa ao meu nome, e confirmarei o trono do seu reino para sempre.
text_el: αὐτὸς οἰκοδομήσει μοι οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματί μου καὶ ἀνορθώσω τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ἕως εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son: and if he commit any iniquity , I will correct him with the rod of men , and with the stripes of the children of men .
text_la: Ego ero ei in patrem, et ipse erit mihi in filium : qui si inique aliquid gesserit, arguam eum in virga virorum, et in plagis filiorum hominum.
text_pt: Eu lhe serei por pai, e ele me será por filho; e, se vier a transgredir, castigá-lo-ei com vara de homens, e com açoites de filhos de homens.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν καὶ ἐὰν ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀδικία αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλέγξω αὐτὸν ἐν ῥάβδῳ ἀνδρῶν καὶ ἐν ἁφαῖς υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: But my mercy I will not take away from him, as I took it from Saul , whom I removed from before my face.
text_la: Misericordiam autem meam non auferam ab eo, sicut abstuli a Saul, quem amovi a facie mea.
text_pt: Mas a minha benignidade não se apartará dele; como a tirei de Saul, a quem tirei de diante de ti.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἔλεός μου οὐκ ἀποστήσω ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καθὼς ἀπέστησα ἀφ' ὧν ἀπέστησα ἐκ προσώπου μου

text_en: And your house shall be faithful , and your kingdom for ever before your face, and your throne shall be firm for ever.
text_la: Et fidelis erit domus tua, et regnum tuum usque in æternum ante faciem tuam, et thronus tuus erit firmus jugiter.
text_pt: Porém a tua casa e o teu reino serão firmados para sempre diante de ti; teu trono será firme para sempre.
text_el: καὶ πιστωθήσεται ὁ οἶκος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ ἔσται ἀνωρθωμένος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: According to all these words and according to all this vision so did Nathan speak to David .
text_la: Secundum omnia verba hæc, et juxta universam visionem istam, sic locutus est Nathan ad David.
text_pt: Conforme a todas estas palavras, e conforme a toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.
text_el: κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ὅρασιν ταύτην οὕτως ἐλάλησεν Ναθαν πρὸς Δαυιδ

text_en: And David went in, and sat before the Lord , and said: Who am I, O Lord God , and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
text_la: Ingressus est autem rex David, et sedit coram Domino, et dixit : Quis ego sum, Domine Deus, et quæ domus mea, quia adduxisti me hucusque?
text_pt: Então entrou o rei Davi, e ficou perante o SENHOR, e disse: Quem sou eu, Senhor DEUS, e qual é a minha casa, para que me tenhas trazido até aqui?
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν τίς εἰμι ἐγώ κύριέ μου κύριε καὶ τίς ὁ οἶκός μου ὅτι ἠγάπηκάς με ἕως τούτων

text_en: But yet this has seemed little in your sight, O Lord God , unless you also spoke of the house of your servant for a long time to come: for this is the law of Adam , O Lord God :
text_la: Sed et hoc parum visum est in conspectu tuo, Domine Deus, nisi loquereris etiam de domo servi tui in longinquum : ista est enim lex Adam, Domine Deus.
text_pt: E ainda foi isto pouco aos teus olhos, Senhor DEUS, senão que também falaste da casa de teu servo para tempos distantes; é este o procedimento dos homens, ó Senhor DEUS?
text_el: καὶ κατεσμικρύνθη μικρὸν ἐνώπιόν σου κύριέ μου κύριε καὶ ἐλάλησας ὑπὲρ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ δούλου σου εἰς μακράν οὗτος δὲ ὁ νόμος τοῦ ἀνθρώπου κύριέ μου κύριε

text_en: And what can David say more unto you? For you know your servant, O Lord God :
text_la: Quid ergo addere poterit adhuc David, ut loquatur ad te? tu enim scis servum tuum, Domine Deus.
text_pt: E que mais te pode dizer ainda Davi? Pois tu conheces bem a teu servo, ó Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ τί προσθήσει Δαυιδ ἔτι τοῦ λαλῆσαι πρὸς σέ καὶ νῦν σὺ οἶδας τὸν δοῦλόν σου κύριέ μου κύριε

text_en: For your word's sake, and according to your own heart you have done all these great things, so that you would make it known to your servant.
text_la: Propter verbum tuum, et secundum cor tuum, fecisti omnia magnalia hæc, ita ut notum faceres servo tuo.
text_pt: Por causa da tua palavra, e segundo o teu coração, fizeste toda esta grandeza; fazendo-a saber a teu servo.
text_el: διὰ τὸν λόγον σου πεποίηκας καὶ κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν σου ἐποίησας πᾶσαν τὴν μεγαλωσύνην ταύτην γνωρίσαι τῷ δούλῳ σου

text_en: Therefore you are magnified, O Lord God , because there is none like to you, neither is there any God besides you, in all the things that we have heard with our ears.
text_la: Idcirco magnificatus es, Domine Deus, quia non est similis tui, neque est deus extra te, in omnibus quæ audivimus auribus nostris.
text_pt: Portanto, grandioso és, ó Senhor Deus, porque não há semelhante a ti, e não há outro Deus senão tu só, segundo tudo o que temos ouvido com os nossos ouvidos.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τοῦ μεγαλῦναί σε κύριέ μου κύριε ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς σὺ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν θεὸς πλὴν σοῦ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἠκούσαμεν ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ἡμῶν

text_en: And what nation is there upon earth, as your people Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name , and to do for them great and terrible things, upon the earth, before the face of your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt , from the nations and their gods.
text_la: Quæ est autem ut populus tuus Israël gens in terra, propter quam ivit Deus ut redimeret eam sibi in populum, et poneret sibi nomen, faceretque eis magnalia et horribilia super terram a facie populi tui quem redemisti tibi ex Ægypto, gentem, et deum ejus.
text_pt: E quem há como o teu povo, como Israel, gente única na terra, a quem Deus foi resgatar para seu povo, para fazer-te nome, e para fazer-vos estas grandes e terríveis coisas à tua terra, diante do teu povo, que tu resgataste do Egito, desterrando as nações e a seus deuses?
text_el: καὶ τίς ὡς ὁ λαός σου Ισραηλ ἔθνος ἄλλο ἐν τῇ γῇ ὡς ὡδήγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς τοῦ λυτρώσασθαι αὐτῷ λαὸν τοῦ θέσθαι σε ὄνομα τοῦ ποιῆσαι μεγαλωσύνην καὶ ἐπιφάνειαν τοῦ ἐκβαλεῖν σε ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ λαοῦ σου οὗ ἐλυτρώσω σεαυτῷ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἔθνη καὶ σκηνώματα

text_en: For you have confirmed to yourself your people Israel to be an everlasting people: and you, O Lord God , have become their God .
text_la: Firmasti enim tibi populum tuum Israël in populum sempiternum : et tu, Domine Deus, factus es eis in Deum.
text_pt: E confirmaste a teu povo Israel por teu povo para sempre, e tu, Senhor, te fizeste o seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἡτοίμασας σεαυτῷ τὸν λαόν σου Ισραηλ λαὸν ἕως αἰῶνος καὶ σύ κύριε ἐγένου αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν

text_en: And now, O Lord God , raise up for ever the word that you have spoken, concerning your servant and concerning his house: and do as you have spoken,
text_la: Nunc ergo Domine Deus, verbum quod locutus es super servum tuum, et super domum ejus, suscita in sempiternum : et fac sicut locutus es,
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor Deus, esta palavra que falaste acerca de teu servo e acerca da sua casa, confirma-a para sempre, e faze como tens falado.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριέ μου κύριε τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησας περὶ τοῦ δούλου σου καὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ πίστωσον ἕως αἰῶνος κύριε παντοκράτωρ θεὲ τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ νῦν καθὼς ἐλάλησας

text_en: that your name may be magnified for ever, and it may be said: The Lord of hosts is God over Israel . And the house of your servant David shall be established before the Lord .
text_la: ut magnificetur nomen tuum usque in sempiternum, atque dicatur : Dominus exercituum, Deus super Israël. Et domus servi tui David erit stabilita coram Domino,
text_pt: E engrandeça-se o teu nome para sempre, para que se diga: O Senhor dos Exércitos é Deus sobre Israel; e a casa de teu servo será confirmada diante de ti.
text_el: μεγαλυνθείη τὸ ὄνομά σου ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Because you, O Lord of hosts , God of Israel , have revealed to the ear of your servant, saying: I will build you a house: therefore has your servant found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
text_la: quia tu, Domine exercituum Deus Israël, revelasti aurem servi tui, dicens : Domum ædificabo tibi : propterea invenit servus tuus cor suum ut oraret te oratione hac.
text_pt: Pois tu, Senhor dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, revelaste aos ouvidos de teu servo, dizendo: Edificar-te-ei uma casa. Portanto o teu servo se animou para fazer-te esta oração.
text_el: κύριε παντοκράτωρ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἀπεκάλυψας τὸ ὠτίον τοῦ δούλου σου λέγων οἶκον οἰκοδομήσω σοι διὰ τοῦτο εὗρεν ὁ δοῦλός σου τὴν καρδίαν ἑαυτοῦ τοῦ προσεύξασθαι πρὸς σὲ τὴν προσευχὴν ταύτην

text_en: And now, O Lord God , you are God , and your words shall be true : for you have spoken to your servant these good things.
text_la: Nunc ergo Domine Deus, tu es Deus, et verba tua erunt vera : locutus es enim ad servum tuum bona hæc.
text_pt: Agora, pois, Senhor DEUS, tu és o mesmo Deus, e as tuas palavras são verdade, e tens falado a teu servo este bem.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριέ μου κύριε σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός καὶ οἱ λόγοι σου ἔσονται ἀληθινοί καὶ ἐλάλησας ὑπὲρ τοῦ δούλου σου τὰ ἀγαθὰ ταῦτα

text_en: And now begin, and bless the house of your servant, that it may endure for ever before you: because you, O Lord God , have spoken it, and with your blessing let the house of your servant be blessed for ever.
text_la: Incipe ergo, et benedic domui servi tui, ut sit in sempiternum coram te : quia tu, Domine Deus, locutus es, et benedictione tua benedicetur domus servi tui in sempiternum.
text_pt: Sê, pois, agora servido de abençoar a casa de teu servo, para permanecer para sempre diante de ti, pois tu, ó Senhor DEUS, o disseste; e com a tua bênção será para sempre bendita a casa de teu servo.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἄρξαι καὶ εὐλόγησον τὸν οἶκον τοῦ δούλου σου τοῦ εἶναι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐνώπιόν σου ὅτι σὺ εἶ κύριέ μου κύριε ἐλάλησας καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς εὐλογίας σου εὐλογηθήσεται ὁ οἶκος τοῦ δούλου σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And it came to pass after this that David defeated the Philistines , and brought them down, and David took the bridle of tribute out of the hand of the Philistines ,
text_la: Factum est autem post hæc, percussit David Philisthiim, et humiliavit eos, et tulit David frenum tributi de manu Philisthiim.
text_pt: E sucedeu depois disto que Davi feriu os filisteus, e os sujeitou; e Davi tomou a Metegue-Ama das mãos dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ ἐτροπώσατο αὐτούς καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ τὴν ἀφωρισμένην ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: and he defeated Moab , and measured them with a line, casting them down to the earth: and he measured with two lines, one to put to death, and one to save alive: and Moab was made to serve David under tribute.
text_la: Et percussit Moab, et mensus est eos funiculo, coæquans terræ : mensus est autem duos funiculos, unum ad occidendum, et unum ad vivificandum : factusque est Moab David serviens sub tributo.
text_pt: Também derrotou os moabitas, e os mediu com cordel, fazendo-os deitar por terra; e os mediu com dois cordéis para os matar, e com um cordel inteiro para os deixar com vida. Ficaram assim os moabitas por servos de Davi, pagando-lhe tributos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ τὴν Μωαβ καὶ διεμέτρησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν σχοινίοις κοιμίσας αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ δύο σχοινίσματα τοῦ θανατῶσαι καὶ τὰ δύο σχοινίσματα ἐζώγρησεν καὶ ἐγένετο Μωαβ τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς δούλους φέροντας ξένια

text_en: David defeated also Adarezer the son of Rohob king of Soba, when he went to extend his dominion over the river Euphrates.
text_la: Et percussit David Adarezer filium Rohob regem Soba, quando profectus est ut dominaretur super flumen Euphraten.
text_pt: Feriu também Davi a Hadadezer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá, quando ele ia recuperar o seu domínio sobre o rio Eufrates.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ τὸν Αδρααζαρ υἱὸν Ρααβ βασιλέα Σουβα πορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐπιστῆσαι τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν Εὐφράτην

text_en: And David took from him a thousand and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen, and houghed all the chariot horses: and only reserved of them for one hundred chariots.
text_la: Et captis David ex parte ejus mille septingentis equitibus, et viginti millibus peditum, subnervavit omnes jugales curruum : dereliquit autem ex eis centum currus.
text_pt: E tomou-lhe Davi mil carros e setecentos cavaleiros e vinte mil homens de pé; e Davi jarretou a todos os cavalos dos carros, e reservou deles cem carros.
text_el: καὶ προκατελάβετο Δαυιδ τῶν αὐτοῦ χίλια ἅρματα καὶ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδας ἱππέων καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν πεζῶν καὶ παρέλυσεν Δαυιδ πάντα τὰ ἅρματα καὶ ὑπελίπετο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἑκατὸν ἅρματα

text_en: And the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Adarezer the king of Soba: and David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
text_la: Venit quoque Syria Damasci, ut præsidium ferret Adarezer regi Soba : et percussit David de Syria viginti duo millia virorum.
text_pt: E vieram os sírios de Damasco a socorrer a Hadadezer, rei de Zobá; porém Davi feriu dos sírios vinte e dois mil homens.
text_el: καὶ παραγίνεται Συρία Δαμασκοῦ βοηθῆσαι τῷ Αδρααζαρ βασιλεῖ Σουβα καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ Σύρῳ εἴκοσι δύο χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus : and Syria served David under tribute, and the Lord preserved David in all his enterprises, wherever he went.
text_la: Et posuit David præsidium in Syria Damasci : factaque est Syria David serviens sub tributo : servavitque Dominus David in omnibus ad quæcumque profectus est.
text_pt: E Davi pôs guarnições na Síria de Damasco, e os sírios ficaram por servos de Davi, pagando-lhe tributos; e o Senhor guardou a Davi por onde quer que ia.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο Δαυιδ φρουρὰν ἐν Συρίᾳ τῇ κατὰ Δαμασκόν καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ Σύρος τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς δούλους φέροντας ξένια καὶ ἔσωσεν κύριος τὸν Δαυιδ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύετο

text_en: And David took the arms of gold, which the servants of Adarezer wore and brought them to Jerusalem .
text_la: Et tulit David arma aurea quæ habebant servi Adarezer, et detulit ea in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E Davi tomou os escudos de ouro que havia com os servos de Hadadezer, e os trouxe a Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ τοὺς χλιδῶνας τοὺς χρυσοῦς οἳ ἦσαν ἐπὶ τῶν παίδων τῶν Αδρααζαρ βασιλέως Σουβα καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτὰ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὰ Σουσακιμ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου ἐν τῷ ἀναβῆναι αὐτὸν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ἡμέραις Ροβοαμ υἱοῦ Σολομῶντος

text_en: And out of Bete, and out of Beroth , cities of Adarezer, King David took and exceeding great quantity of brass.
text_la: Et de Bete et de Beroth, civitatibus Adarezer, tulit rex David æs multum nimis.
text_pt: Tomou mais o rei Davi uma quantidade muito grande de bronze de Betá e de Berotai, cidades de Hadadezer.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς Μασβακ ἐκ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν πόλεων τοῦ Αδρααζαρ ἔλαβεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ χαλκὸν πολὺν σφόδρα ἐν αὐτῷ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμων τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν χαλκῆν καὶ τοὺς στύλους καὶ τοὺς λουτῆρας καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη

text_en: And you the king of Emath heard that David had defeated all the forces of Adarezer.
text_la: Audivit autem Thou rex Emath quod percussisset David omne robur Adarezer,
text_pt: Então ouvindo Toí, rei de Hamate, que Davi ferira a todo o exército de Hadadezer,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Θοου ὁ βασιλεὺς Ημαθ ὅτι ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν Αδρααζαρ

text_en: And you sent Joram his son to King David , to salute him, and to congratulate with him, and to return him thanks: because he had fought against Adarezer, and had defeated him. For you were an enemy to Adarezer, and in his hand were vessels of gold, and vessels of silver, and vessels of brass:
text_la: et misit Thou Joram filium suum ad regem David, ut salutaret eum congratulans, et gratias ageret : eo quod expugnasset Adarezer, et percussisset eum. Hostis quippe erat Thou Adarezer, et in manu ejus erant vasa aurea, et vasa argentea, et vasa ærea:
text_pt: Mandou Toí, seu filho Jorão, ao rei Davi, para lhe perguntar como estava, e para lhe dar os parabéns por haver pelejado contra Hadadezer, e por o haver ferido (porque Hadadezer de contínuo fazia guerra a Toí); e na sua mão trazia vasos de prata, e vasos de ouro, e vasos de bronze,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Θοου Ιεδδουραν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ πρὸς βασιλέα Δαυιδ ἐρωτῆσαι αὐτὸν τὰ εἰς εἰρήνην καὶ εὐλογῆσαι αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐπολέμησεν τὸν Αδρααζαρ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτόν ὅτι ἀντικείμενος ἦν τῷ Αδρααζαρ καὶ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ ἦσαν σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ καὶ σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ σκεύη χαλκᾶ

text_en: And King David dedicated them to the Lord , together with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all the nations, which he had subdued:
text_la: quæ et ipsa sanctificavit rex David Domino cum argento et auro quæ sanctificaverat de universis gentibus quas subegerat,
text_pt: Os quais também o rei Davi consagrou ao Senhor, juntamente com a prata e ouro que já havia consagrado de todas as nações que sujeitara.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα ἡγίασεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ τῷ κυρίῳ μετὰ τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ μετὰ τοῦ χρυσίου οὗ ἡγίασεν ἐκ πασῶν τῶν πόλεων ὧν κατεδυνάστευσεν

text_en: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalec , and of the spoils of Adarezer the son of Rohob king of Soba.
text_la: de Syria, et Moab, et filiis Ammon, et Philisthiim, et Amalec, et de manubiis Adarezer filii Rohob regis Soba.
text_pt: Da Síria, e de Moabe, e dos filhos de Amom, e dos filisteus, e de Amaleque, e dos despojos de Hadadezer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá.
text_el: ἐκ τῆς Ιδουμαίας καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς Μωαβ καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐξ Αμαληκ καὶ ἐκ τῶν σκύλων Αδρααζαρ υἱοῦ Ρααβ βασιλέως Σουβα

text_en: David also made himself a name , when he returned after taking Syria in the valley of the saltpits, killing eighteen thousand:
text_la: Fecit quoque sibi David nomen cum reverteretur capta Syria in valle Salinarum, cæsis decem et octo millibus:
text_pt: Também Davi ganhou nome, voltando ele de ferir os sírios no vale do Sal, a saber, a dezoito mil.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Δαυιδ ὄνομα καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀνακάμπτειν αὐτὸν ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ιδουμαίαν ἐν Γαιμελε εἰς ὀκτωκαίδεκα χιλιάδας

text_en: And he put guards in Edom , and placed there a garrison: and all Edom was made to serve David : and the Lord preserved David in all enterprises he went about.
text_la: et posuit in Idumæa custodes, statuitque præsidium : et facta est universa Idumæa serviens David, et servavit Dominus David in omnibus ad quæcumque profectus est.
text_pt: E pôs guarnições, em Edom, em todo o Edom pôs guarnições, e todos os edomeus ficaram por servos de Davi; e o Senhor ajudava a Davi por onde quer que ia.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ Ιδουμαίᾳ φρουράν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ιδουμαίᾳ καὶ ἐγένοντο πάντες οἱ Ιδουμαῖοι δοῦλοι τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἔσωσεν κύριος τὸν Δαυιδ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύετο

text_en: And David reigned over all Israel : and David did judgment and justice to all his people.
text_la: Et regnavit David super omnem Israël : faciebat quoque David judicium et justitiam omni populo suo.
text_pt: Reinou, pois, Davi sobre todo o Israel; e Davi fazia direito e justiça a todo o seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Δαυιδ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἦν Δαυιδ ποιῶν κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joab the son Sarvia was over the army: and Josaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
text_la: Joab autem filius Sarviæ erat super exercitum : porro Josaphat filius Ahilud erat a commentariis:
text_pt: E Joabe, filho de Zeruia, era sobre o exército; e Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, era cronista.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ υἱὸς Σαρουιας ἐπὶ τῆς στρατιᾶς καὶ Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς Αχια ἐπὶ τῶν ὑπομνημάτων

text_en: And Sadoc the son of Achitob, and Achimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests : and Saraias was the scribe:
text_la: et Sadoc filius Achitob, et Achimelech filius Abiathar, erant sacerdotes : et Saraias, scriba:
text_pt: E Zadoque, filho de Aitube, e Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes, e Seraías escrivão.
text_el: καὶ Σαδδουκ υἱὸς Αχιτωβ καὶ Αχιμελεχ υἱὸς Αβιαθαρ ἱερεῖς καὶ Ασα ὁ γραμματεύς

text_en: And Banaias the son of Joiada was over the Cerethi and Phelethi: and the sons of David were the princes.
text_la: Banaias autem filius Jojadæ super Cerethi et Phelethi : filii autem David sacerdotes erant.
text_pt: Também Benaia, filho de Jeoiada, estava sobre os quereteus e peleteus; porém os filhos de Davi eram ministros.
text_el: καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε σύμβουλος καὶ ὁ Χελεθθι καὶ ὁ Φελεττι καὶ υἱοὶ Δαυιδ αὐλάρχαι ἦσαν

text_en: And David said: Is there any one, think you, left of the house of Saul , that I may show kindness to him for Jonathan's sake?
text_la: Et dixit David : Putasne est aliquis qui remanserit de domo Saul, ut faciam cum eo misericordiam propter Jonathan?
text_pt: E disse Davi: Há ainda alguém que tenha ficado da casa de Saul, para que lhe faça benevolência por amor de Jônatas?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ εἰ ἔστιν ἔτι ὑπολελειμμένος τῷ οἴκῳ Σαουλ καὶ ποιήσω μετ' αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἕνεκεν Ιωναθαν

text_en: Now there was of the house of Saul , a servant named Siba: and when the king had called him to him, he said to him: Are you Siba? And he answered: I am Siba your servant.
text_la: Erat autem de domo Saul servus nomine Siba : quem cum vocasset rex ad se, dixit ei : Tune es Siba? Et ille respondit : Ego sum servus tuus.
text_pt: E havia um servo na casa de Saul cujo nome era Ziba; e o chamaram à presença de Davi. Disse-lhe o rei: És tu Ziba? E ele disse: Servo teu.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Σαουλ παῖς ἦν καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Σιβα καὶ καλοῦσιν αὐτὸν πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλεύς εἰ σὺ εἶ Σιβα καὶ εἶπεν ἐγὼ δοῦλος σός

text_en: And the king said: Is there any one left of the house of Saul , that I may show the mercy of God unto Him? And Siba said to the king: There is a son of Jonathan left, who is lame of his feet.
text_la: Et ait rex : Numquid superest aliquis de domo Saul, ut faciam cum eo misericordiam Dei? Dixitque Siba regi : Superest filius Jonathæ, debilis pedibus.
text_pt: E disse o rei: Não há ainda alguém da casa de Saul para que eu use com ele da benevolência de Deus? Então disse Ziba ao rei: Ainda há um filho de Jônatas, aleijado de ambos os pés.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς εἰ ὑπολέλειπται ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Σαουλ ἔτι ἀνὴρ καὶ ποιήσω μετ' αὐτοῦ ἔλεος θεοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Σιβα πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ἔτι ἔστιν υἱὸς τῷ Ιωναθαν πεπληγὼς τοὺς πόδας

text_en: Where is he? Said he. And Siba said to the king: Behold he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel in Lodabar.
text_la: Ubi, inquit, est? Et Siba ad regem : Ecce, ait, in domo est Machir filii Ammiel, in Lodabar.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o rei: Onde está? E disse Ziba ao rei: Eis que está em casa de Maquir, filho de Amiel, em Lo-Debar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς ποῦ οὗτος καὶ εἶπεν Σιβα πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ἰδοὺ ἐν οἴκῳ Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Αμιηλ ἐκ τῆς Λαδαβαρ

text_en: Then King David sent, and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodabar.
text_la: Misit ergo rex David, et tulit eum de domo Machir filii Ammiel, de Lodabar.
text_pt: Então mandou o rei Davi, e o tomou da casa de Maquir, filho de Amiel, de Lo-Debar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Αμιηλ ἐκ τῆς Λαδαβαρ

text_en: And when Miphiboseth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul had come to David , he fell on his face and worshipped. And David said: Miphiboseth? And he answered: Behold your servant.
text_la: Cum autem venisset Miphiboseth filius Jonathæ filii Saul ad David, corruit in faciem suam, et adoravit. Dixitque David : Miphiboseth? Qui respondit : Adsum servus tuus.
text_pt: E Mefibosete, filho de Jônatas, o filho de Saul, veio a Davi, e se prostrou com o rosto por terra e inclinou-se; e disse Davi: Mefibosete! E ele disse: Eis aqui teu servo.
text_el: καὶ παραγίνεται Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸς Ιωναθαν υἱοῦ Σαουλ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δαυιδ Μεμφιβοσθε καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ὁ δοῦλός σου

text_en: And David said to him: Fear not, for I will surely show you mercy for Jonathan your father's sake, and I will restore the lands of Saul the father, and you shall eat bread at my table always.
text_la: Et ait ei David : Ne timeas, quia faciens faciam in te misericordiam propter Jonathan patrem tuum, et restituam tibi omnes agros Saul patris tui : et tu comedes panem in mensa mea semper.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Davi: Não temas, porque decerto usarei contigo de benevolência por amor de Jônatas, teu pai, e te restituirei todas as terras de Saul, teu pai, e tu sempre comerás pão à minha mesa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δαυιδ μὴ φοβοῦ ὅτι ποιῶν ποιήσω μετὰ σοῦ ἔλεος διὰ Ιωναθαν τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω σοι πάντα ἀγρὸν Σαουλ πατρὸς τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ σὺ φάγῃ ἄρτον ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου διὰ παντός

text_en: He bowed down to him, and said: Who am I your servant, that you should look upon such a dead dog as I am?
text_la: Qui adorans eum, dixit : Quis ego sum servus tuus, quoniam respexisti super canem mortuum similem mei?
text_pt: Então se inclinou, e disse: Quem é teu servo, para teres olhado para um cão morto tal como eu?
text_el: καὶ προσεκύνησεν Μεμφιβοσθε καὶ εἶπεν τίς εἰμι ὁ δοῦλός σου ὅτι ἐπέβλεψας ἐπὶ τὸν κύνα τὸν τεθνηκότα τὸν ὅμοιον ἐμοί

text_en: Then the King called Siba the servant of Saul , and said to him: All that belonged to Saul , and all his house, I have given to your master's son.
text_la: Vocavit itaque rex Sibam puerum Saul, et dixit ei : Omnia quæcumque fuerunt Saul, et universam domum ejus, dedi filio domini tui.
text_pt: Então chamou Davi a Ziba, moço de Saul, e disse-lhe: Tudo o que pertencia a Saul, e a toda a sua casa, tenho dado ao filho de teu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σιβα τὸ παιδάριον Σαουλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν τῷ Σαουλ καὶ ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ δέδωκα τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ κυρίου σου

text_en: You therefore and the sons and your servants shall till the land for him: and you shall bring in food for your master's son, that he may be maintained: and Miphiboseth the son of your master shall always eat bread at my table. And Siba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
text_la: Operare igitur ei terram tu, et filii tui, et servi tui, et inferes filio domini tui cibos ut alatur : Miphiboseth autem filius domini tui comedet semper panem super mensam meam. Erant autem Sibæ quindecim filii, et viginti servi.
text_pt: Trabalhar-lhe-ás, pois, a terra, tu e teus filhos, e teus servos, e recolherás os frutos, para que o filho de teu senhor tenha pão para comer; mas Mefibosete, filho de teu senhor, sempre comerá pão à minha mesa. E tinha Ziba quinze filhos e vinte servos.
text_el: καὶ ἐργᾷ αὐτῷ τὴν γῆν σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ οἱ δοῦλοί σου καὶ εἰσοίσεις τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ κυρίου σου ἄρτους καὶ ἔδεται αὐτούς καὶ Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸς τοῦ κυρίου σου φάγεται διὰ παντὸς ἄρτον ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου καὶ τῷ Σιβα ἦσαν πεντεκαίδεκα υἱοὶ καὶ εἴκοσι δοῦλοι

text_en: And Siba said to the king: As you my lord the have commanded your servant, so will your servant do: and Miphiboseth shall eat at my table, as one of the sons of the King.
text_la: Dixitque Siba ad regem : Sicut jussisti, domine mi rex, servo tuo, sic faciet servus tuus : et Miphiboseth comedet super mensam meam, quasi unus de filiis regis.
text_pt: E disse Ziba ao rei: Conforme a tudo quanto meu senhor, o rei, manda a seu servo, assim fará teu servo. Quanto a Mefibosete, disse o rei, comerá à minha mesa como um dos filhos do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σιβα πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐντέταλται ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ οὕτως ποιήσει ὁ δοῦλός σου καὶ Μεμφιβοσθε ἤσθιεν ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης Δαυιδ καθὼς εἷς τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Miphiboseth had a young son whose name was Micha: and all that kindred of the house of Siba served Miphiboseth.
text_la: Habebat autem Miphiboseth filium parvulum nomine Micha : omnis vero cognatio domus Sibæ serviebat Miphiboseth.
text_pt: E tinha Mefibosete um filho pequeno, cujo nome era Mica; e todos quantos moravam em casa de Ziba eram servos de Mefibosete.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸς μικρὸς καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Μιχα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ κατοίκησις τοῦ οἴκου Σιβα δοῦλοι τοῦ Μεμφιβοσθε

text_en: But Miphiboseth dwelt in Jerusalem : because he ate always of the king's table: and he was lame of both feet.
text_la: Porro Miphiboseth habitabat in Jerusalem, quia de mensa regis jugiter vescebatur : et erat claudus utroque pede.
text_pt: Morava, pois, Mefibosete em Jerusalém, porquanto sempre comia à mesa do rei, e era coxo de ambos os pés.
text_el: καὶ Μεμφιβοσθε κατῴκει ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης τοῦ βασιλέως διὰ παντὸς ἤσθιεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν χωλὸς ἀμφοτέροις τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanon his son reigned in his stead.
text_la: Factum est autem post hæc ut moreretur rex filiorum Ammon, et regnavit Hanon filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E aconteceu depois disto que morreu o rei dos filhos de Amom, e seu filho Hanum reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἀπέθανεν βασιλεὺς υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Αννων υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And David said: I will show kindness to Hanon the son of Daas, as his father showed kindness to me. So David sent his servants to comfort him for the death of his father. But when the servants of David had come into the land of the children of Ammon ,
text_la: Dixitque David : Faciam misericordiam cum Hanon filio Naas, sicut fecit pater ejus mecum misericordiam. Misit ergo David, consolans eum per servos suos super patris interitu. Cum autem venissent servi David in terram filiorum Ammon,
text_pt: Então disse Davi: Usarei de benevolência com Hanum, filho de Naás, como seu pai usou de benevolência comigo. E enviou Davi os seus servos para consolá-lo acerca de seu pai; e foram os servos de Davi à terra dos filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ ποιήσω ἔλεος μετὰ Αννων υἱοῦ Ναας ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ μετ' ἐμοῦ ἔλεος καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ παρακαλέσαι αὐτὸν ἐν χειρὶ τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ παρεγένοντο οἱ παῖδες Δαυιδ εἰς τὴν γῆν υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanon their lord: Do you think that for the honour of your father, David has sent comforters to you, and has not David rather sent his servants to you to search, and spy into the city, and overthrow it?
text_la: dixerunt principes filiorum Ammon ad Hanon dominum suum : Putas quod propter honorem patris tui miserit David ad te consolatores, et non ideo ut investigaret, et exploraret civitatem, et everteret eam, misit David servos suos ad te?
text_pt: Então disseram os príncipes dos filhos de Amom a seu senhor, Hanum: Porventura honra Davi a teu pai aos teus olhos, porque te enviou consoladores? Não te enviou antes Davi os seus servos para reconhecerem esta cidade, e para espiá-la, e para transtorná-la?
text_el: καὶ εἶπον οἱ ἄρχοντες υἱῶν Αμμων πρὸς Αννων τὸν κύριον αὐτῶν μὴ παρὰ τὸ δοξάζειν Δαυιδ τὸν πατέρα σου ἐνώπιόν σου ὅτι ἀπέστειλέν σοι παρακαλοῦντας ἀλλ' οὐχὶ ὅπως ἐρευνήσωσιν τὴν πόλιν καὶ κατασκοπήσωσιν αὐτὴν καὶ τοῦ κατασκέψασθαι αὐτὴν ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ πρὸς σέ

text_en: Wherefore Hanon took the servants of David , and shaved off the one half of their beards , and cut away half of their garments even to the buttocks, and sent them away.
text_la: Tulit itaque Hanon servos David, rasitque dimidiam partem barbæ eorum et præscidit vestes eorum medias usque ad nates, et dimisit eos.
text_pt: Então tomou Hanum os servos de Davi, e lhes raspou metade da barba, e lhes cortou metade das vestes, até às nádegas, e os despediu.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αννων τοὺς παῖδας Δαυιδ καὶ ἐξύρησεν τοὺς πώγωνας αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπέκοψεν τοὺς μανδύας αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ ἡμίσει ἕως τῶν ἰσχίων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτούς

text_en: When this was told David , he sent to meet them: for the men were sadly put to confusion, and David commanded them, saying: Stay at Jericho , till your beards be grown, and then return.
text_la: Quod cum nuntiatum esset David, misit in occursum eorum : erant enim viri confusi turpiter valde, et mandavit eis David : Manete in Jericho donec crescat barba vestra, et tunc revertimini.
text_pt: Quando isso foi informado a Davi, enviou ele mensageiros a encontrá-los, porque estavam aqueles homens sobremaneira envergonhados. Mandou o rei dizer-lhes: Deixai-vos estar em Jericó, até que vos torne a crescer a barba, e então voltai.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τῷ Δαυιδ ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀνδρῶν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτῶν ὅτι ἦσαν οἱ ἄνδρες ἠτιμασμένοι σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς καθίσατε ἐν Ιεριχω ἕως τοῦ ἀνατεῖλαι τοὺς πώγωνας ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπιστραφήσεσθε

text_en: And the children of Ammon seeing that they had done an injury to David , sent and hired the Syrians of Rohob, and the Syrians of Soba, twenty thousand footmen, and of the king of Maacha a thousand men , and of Istob twelve thousand men .
text_la: Videntes autem filii Ammon quod injuriam fecissent David, miserunt, et conduxerunt mercede Syrum Rohob, et Syrum Soba, viginti millia peditum, et a rege Maacha mille viros, et ab Istob duodecim millia virorum.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os filhos de Amom que se tinham feito abomináveis para com Davi, enviaram os filhos de Amom, e alugaram dos sírios de Bete-Reobe e dos sírios de Zobá vinte mil homens de pé, e do rei de Maaca mil homens e dos homens de Tobe doze mil homens.
text_el: καὶ εἶδαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων ὅτι κατῃσχύνθησαν ὁ λαὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων καὶ ἐμισθώσαντο τὴν Συρίαν Βαιθροωβ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας πεζῶν καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Μααχα χιλίους ἄνδρας καὶ Ιστωβ δώδεκα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And when David heard this, he sent Joab and the whole army of warriors.
text_la: Quod cum audisset David, misit Joab et omnem exercitum bellatorum.
text_pt: E ouvindo Davi, enviou a Joabe e a todo o exército dos valentes.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν Ιωαβ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν τοὺς δυνατούς

text_en: And the children of Ammon came out, and set their men in array at the entering in of the gate: but the Syrians of Soba, and of Rohob, and of Istob, and of Maacha were by themselves in the field.
text_la: Egressi sunt ergo filii Ammon, et direxerunt aciem ante ipsum introitum portæ : Syrus autem Soba, et Rohob, et Istob, et Maacha, seorsum erant in campo.
text_pt: E saíram os filhos de Amom, e ordenaram a batalha à entrada da porta; mas os sírios de Zobá e Reobe, e os homens de Tobe e Maaca estavam à parte no campo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθαν οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων καὶ παρετάξαντο πόλεμον παρὰ τῇ θύρᾳ τῆς πύλης καὶ Συρία Σουβα καὶ Ροωβ καὶ Ιστωβ καὶ Μααχα μόνοι ἐν ἀγρῷ

text_en: Then Joab seeing that the battle was prepared against him, both before and behind, chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :
text_la: Videns igitur Joab quod præparatum esset adversum se prælium et ex adverso et post tergum, elegit ex omnibus electis Israël, et instruxit aciem contra Syrum:
text_pt: Vendo, pois, Joabe que a batalha estava preparada contra ele pela frente e pela retaguarda, escolheu dentre todos os homens de Israel, e formou-os em linha contra os sírios.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιωαβ ὅτι ἐγενήθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀντιπρόσωπον τοῦ πολέμου ἐκ τοῦ κατὰ πρόσωπον ἐξ ἐναντίας καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ὄπισθεν καὶ ἐπέλεξεν ἐκ πάντων τῶν νεανίσκων Ισραηλ καὶ παρετάξαντο ἐξ ἐναντίας Συρίας

text_en: And the rest of the people he delivered to Abisai his brother, who set them in array against the children of Ammon .
text_la: reliquam autem partem populi tradidit Abisai fratri suo, qui direxit aciem adversus filios Ammon.
text_pt: E o restante do povo entregou na mão de Abisai seu irmão, o qual formou em linha contra os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ λαοῦ ἔδωκεν ἐν χειρὶ Αβεσσα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ παρετάξαντο ἐξ ἐναντίας υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And Joab said: If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me, but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
text_la: Et ait Joab : Si prævaluerint adversum me Syri, eris mihi in adjutorium : si autem filii Ammon prævaluerint adversum te, auxiliabor tibi.
text_pt: E disse: Se os sírios forem mais fortes do que eu, tu me virás em socorro; e, se os filhos de Amom forem mais fortes do que tu, irei a socorrer-te.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐὰν κραταιωθῇ Συρία ὑπὲρ ἐμέ καὶ ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν καὶ ἐὰν υἱοὶ Αμμων κραταιωθῶσιν ὑπὲρ σέ καὶ ἐσόμεθα τοῦ σῶσαί σε

text_en: Be of good courage , and let us fight for our people, and for the city of our God : and the Lord will do what is good in his sight.
text_la: Esto vir fortis, et pugnemus pro populo nostro et civitate Dei nostri : Dominus autem faciet quod bonum est in conspectu suo.
text_pt: Esforça-te, pois, e esforcemo-nos pelo nosso povo, e pelas cidades de nosso Deus; e faça o Senhor o que bem parecer aos seus olhos.
text_el: ἀνδρίζου καὶ κραταιωθῶμεν ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν πόλεων τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ κύριος ποιήσει τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joab and the people that were with him, began to fight against the Syrians : and they immediately fled before him.
text_la: Iniit itaque Joab, et populus qui erat cum eo, certamen contra Syros : qui statim fugerunt a facie ejus.
text_pt: Então se achegou Joabe, e o povo que estava com ele, à peleja contra os sírios; e fugiram de diante dele.
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθεν Ιωαβ καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς Συρίαν καὶ ἔφυγαν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the children of Ammon seeing that the Syrians were fled, they fled also before Abisai , and entered into the city: and Joab returned from the children of Ammon , and came to Jerusalem .
text_la: Filii autem Ammon videntes quia fugissent Syri, fugerunt et ipsi a facie Abisai, et ingressi sunt civitatem : reversusque est Joab a filiis Ammon, et venit Jerusalem.
text_pt: E, vendo os filhos de Amom que os sírios fugiam, também eles fugiram de diante de Abisai, e entraram na cidade; e voltou Joabe dos filhos de Amom, e veio para Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων εἶδαν ὅτι ἔφυγεν Συρία καὶ ἔφυγαν ἀπὸ προσώπου Αβεσσα καὶ εἰσῆλθαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Ιωαβ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ παρεγένοντο εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Then the Syrians seeing that they had fallen before Israel , gathered themselves together.
text_la: Videntes igitur Syri quoniam corruissent coram Israël, congregati sunt pariter.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os sírios que foram feridos diante de Israel, tornaram a refazer-se.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Συρία ὅτι ἔπταισεν ἔμπροσθεν Ισραηλ καὶ συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: And Adarezer sent and fetched the Syrians , that were beyond the river, and brought over their army: and Sobach, the captain of the host of Adarezer, was their general.
text_la: Misitque Adarezer, et eduxit Syros qui erant trans fluvium, et adduxit eorum exercitum : Sobach autem, magister militiæ Adarezer, erat princeps eorum.
text_pt: E mandou Hadadezer, e fez sair os sírios que estavam do outro lado do rio, e vieram a Helã; e Sobaque, capitão do exército de Hadadezer, marchava diante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Αδρααζαρ καὶ συνήγαγεν τὴν Συρίαν τὴν ἐκ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ Χαλαμακ καὶ παρεγένοντο Αιλαμ καὶ Σωβακ ἄρχων τῆς δυνάμεως Αδρααζαρ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν

text_en: And when this was told David , he gathered all Israel together, and passed over the Jordan , and came to Helam: and the Syrians set themselves in array against David , and fought against him.
text_la: Quod cum nuntiatum esset David, contraxit omnem Israëlem, et transivit Jordanem, venitque in Helam : et direxerunt aciem Syri ex adverso David, et pugnaverunt contra eum.
text_pt: Do que informado Davi, ajuntou a todo o Israel, e passou o Jordão, e foi a Helã; e os sírios se puseram em ordem contra Davi, e pelejaram com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ συνήγαγεν τὸν πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ διέβη τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ παρεγένοντο εἰς Αιλαμ καὶ παρετάξατο Συρία ἀπέναντι Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπολέμησαν μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Syrians fled before Israel , and David slew of the Syrians the men of seven hundred chariots, and forty thousand horsemen: and smote Sobach the captain of the army, who presently died.
text_la: Fugeruntque Syri a facie Israël, et occidit David de Syris septingentos currus, et quadraginta millia equitum : et Sobach principem militiæ percussit, qui statim mortuus est.
text_pt: Porém os sírios fugiram de diante de Israel, e Davi feriu dentre os sírios aos homens de setecentos carros, e quarenta mil homens de cavalaria; feriu também a Sobaque, capitão do exército, que morreu ali.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγεν Συρία ἀπὸ προσώπου Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνεῖλεν Δαυιδ ἐκ τῆς Συρίας ἑπτακόσια ἅρματα καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδας ἱππέων καὶ τὸν Σωβακ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ἐπάταξεν καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And all the kings that were auxiliaries of Adarezer, seeing themselves overcome by Israel , were afraid and fled away, eight and fifty thousand men before Israel . And they made peace with Israel : and served them, and all the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.
text_la: Videntes autem universi reges qui erant in præsidio Adarezer, se victos esse ab Israël, expaverunt, et fugerunt quinquaginta et octo millia coram Israël. Et fecerunt pacem cum Israël, et servierunt eis : timueruntque Syri auxilium præbere ultra filiis Ammon.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, todos os reis, servos de Hadadezer, que foram feridos diante de Israel, fizeram paz com Israel, e o serviram; e temeram os sírios de socorrer aos filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ εἶδαν πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς οἱ δοῦλοι Αδρααζαρ ὅτι ἔπταισαν ἔμπροσθεν Ισραηλ καὶ ηὐτομόλησαν μετὰ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐφοβήθη Συρία τοῦ σῶσαι ἔτι τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων

text_en: And it came to pass at the return of the year, at the time when kings go forth to war , that David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel , and they spoiled the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabba: but David remained in Jerusalem .
text_la: Factum est autem, vertente anno, eo tempore quo solent reges ad bella procedere, misit David Joab, et servos suos cum eo, et universum Israël, et vastaverunt filios Ammon, et obsederunt Rabba : David autem remansit in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, tendo decorrido um ano, no tempo em que os reis saem à guerra, enviou Davi a Joabe, e com ele os seus servos, e a todo o Israel; e eles destruíram os filhos de Amom, e cercaram a Rabá; porém Davi ficou em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπιστρέψαντος τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τῆς ἐξοδίας τῶν βασιλέων καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ τὸν Ιωαβ καὶ τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ διέφθειραν τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων καὶ διεκάθισαν ἐπὶ Ραββαθ καὶ Δαυιδ ἐκάθισεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: In the mean time it happened that David arose from his bed after noon, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: And he saw from the roof of his house a woman washing herself, over against him: and the woman was very beautiful.
text_la: Dum hæc agerentur, accidit ut surgeret David de strato suo post meridiem, et deambularet in solario domus regiæ : viditque mulierem se lavantem ex adverso super solarium suum : erat autem mulier pulchra valde.
text_pt: E aconteceu que numa tarde Davi se levantou do seu leito, e andava passeando no terraço da casa real, e viu do terraço a uma mulher que se estava lavando; e era esta mulher mui formosa à vista.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πρὸς ἑσπέραν καὶ ἀνέστη Δαυιδ ἀπὸ τῆς κοίτης αὐτοῦ καὶ περιεπάτει ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ εἶδεν γυναῖκα λουομένην ἀπὸ τοῦ δώματος καὶ ἡ γυνὴ καλὴ τῷ εἴδει σφόδρα

text_en: And the king sent, and inquired who the woman was. And it was told him, that she was Bethsabee the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Urias the Hethite .
text_la: Misit ergo rex, et requisivit quæ esset mulier. Nuntiatumque est ei quod ipsa esset Bethsabee filia Eliam, uxor Uriæ Hethæi.
text_pt: E mandou Davi indagar quem era aquela mulher; e disseram: Porventura não é esta Bate-Seba, filha de Eliã, mulher de Urias, o heteu?
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ καὶ ἐζήτησεν τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ εἶπεν οὐχὶ αὕτη Βηρσαβεε θυγάτηρ Ελιαβ γυνὴ Ουριου τοῦ Χετταίου

text_en: And David sent messengers, and took her, and she came in to him, and he slept with her: and presently she was purified from her uncleanness :
text_la: Missis itaque David nuntiis, tulit eam : quæ cum ingressa esset ad illum, dormivit cum ea : statimque sanctificata est ab immunditia sua,
text_pt: Então enviou Davi mensageiros, e mandou trazê-la; e ela veio, e ele se deitou com ela (pois já estava purificada da sua imundícia); então voltou ela para sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ ἀγγέλους καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτήν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἐκοιμήθη μετ' αὐτῆς καὶ αὐτὴ ἁγιαζομένη ἀπὸ ἀκαθαρσίας αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς

text_en: And she returned to her house having conceived. And she sent and told David , and said: I have conceived.
text_la: et reversa est domum suam concepto fœtu. Mittensque nuntiavit David, et ait : Concepi.
text_pt: E a mulher concebeu; e mandou dizer a Davi: Estou grávida.
text_el: καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβεν ἡ γυνή καὶ ἀποστείλασα ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἰμι ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχω

text_en: And David sent to Joab, saying: Send me Urias the Hethite . And Joab sent Urias to David .
text_la: Misit autem David ad Joab, dicens : Mitte ad me Uriam Hethæum. Misitque Joab Uriam ad David.
text_pt: Então Davi mandou dizer a Joabe: Envia-me Urias, o heteu. E Joabe enviou Urias a Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ιωαβ λέγων ἀπόστειλον πρός με τὸν Ουριαν τὸν Χετταῖον καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ιωαβ τὸν Ουριαν πρὸς Δαυιδ

text_en: And Urias came to David . And David asked how Joab did, and the people, and how the war was carried on.
text_la: Et venit Urias ad David. Quæsivitque David quam recte ageret Joab et populus, et quomodo administraretur bellum.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, Urias a ele, perguntou Davi como passava Joabe, e como estava o povo, e como ia a guerra.
text_el: καὶ παραγίνεται Ουριας καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν Δαυιδ εἰς εἰρήνην Ιωαβ καὶ εἰς εἰρήνην τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ εἰς εἰρήνην τοῦ πολέμου

text_en: And David said to Urias: Go into your house, and wash your feet . And Urias went out from the king's house, and there went out after him a mess of meat from the king.
text_la: Et dixit David ad Uriam : Vade in domum tuam, et lava pedes tuos. Et egressus est Urias de domo regis, secutusque est eum cibus regius.
text_pt: Depois disse Davi a Urias: Desce à tua casa, e lava os teus pés. E, saindo Urias da casa real, logo lhe foi mandado um presente da mesa do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ τῷ Ουρια κατάβηθι εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου καὶ νίψαι τοὺς πόδας σου καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ουριας ἐξ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἄρσις τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: But Urias slept before the gate of the king's house, with the other servants of his lord, and went not down to his own house.
text_la: Dormivit autem Urias ante portam domus regiæ cum aliis servis domini sui, et non descendit ad domum suam.
text_pt: Porém Urias se deitou à porta da casa real, com todos os servos do seu senhor; e não desceu à sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ουριας παρὰ τῇ θύρᾳ τοῦ βασιλέως μετὰ τῶν δούλων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ κατέβη εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it was told David by some that said: Urias went not to his house. And David said to Urias: Did you not come from your journey? Why did you not go down to your house?
text_la: Nuntiatumque est David a dicentibus : Non ivit Urias in domum suam. Et ait David ad Uriam : Numquid non de via venisti? quare non descendisti in domum tuam?
text_pt: E fizeram saber isto a Davi, dizendo: Urias não desceu a sua casa. Então disse Davi à Urias: Não vens tu duma jornada? Por que não desceste à tua casa?
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τῷ Δαυιδ λέγοντες ὅτι οὐ κατέβη Ουριας εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ουριαν οὐχὶ ἐξ ὁδοῦ σὺ ἔρχῃ τί ὅτι οὐ κατέβης εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου

text_en: And Urias said to David : The ark of God and Israel and Juda dwell in tents, and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord abide upon the face of the earth: and shall I go into my house, to eat and to drink, and to sleep with my wife? By your welfare and by the welfare of your soul I will not do this thing.
text_la: Et ait Urias ad David : Arca Dei et Israël et Juda habitant in papilionibus, et dominus meus Joab et servi domini mei super faciem terræ manent : et ego ingrediar domum meam, ut comedam et bibam, et dormiam cum uxore mea? Per salutem tuam, et per salutem animæ tuæ, non faciam rem hanc.
text_pt: E disse Urias a Davi: A arca, e Israel, e Judá ficaram em tendas; e Joabe, meu senhor, e os servos de meu senhor estão acampados no campo; e hei de eu entrar na minha casa, para comer e beber, e para me deitar com minha mulher? Pela tua vida, e pela vida da tua alma, não farei tal coisa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ουριας πρὸς Δαυιδ ἡ κιβωτὸς καὶ Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδας κατοικοῦσιν ἐν σκηναῖς καὶ ὁ κύριός μου Ιωαβ καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι τοῦ κυρίου μου ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἀγροῦ παρεμβάλλουσιν καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν καὶ κοιμηθῆναι μετὰ τῆς γυναικός μου πῶς ζῇ ἡ ψυχή σου εἰ ποιήσω τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: Then David said to Urias: Tarry here to day, and tomorrow I will send you away. Urias tarried in Jerusalem that day and the next.
text_la: Ait ergo David ad Uriam : Mane hic etiam hodie, et cras dimittam te. Mansit Urias in Jerusalem in die illa et altera:
text_pt: Então disse Davi a Urias: Demora-te aqui ainda hoje, e amanhã te despedirei. Urias, pois, ficou em Jerusalém aquele dia e o seguinte.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ουριαν κάθισον ἐνταῦθα καί γε σήμερον καὶ αὔριον ἐξαποστελῶ σε καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ουριας ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ τῇ ἐπαύριον

text_en: And David called him to eat and to drink before him, and he made him drunk: and he went out in the evening, and slept on his couch with the servants of his lord, and went not down into his house.
text_la: et vocavit eum David ut comederet coram se et biberet, et inebriavit eum : qui egressus vespere, dormivit in strato suo cum servis domini sui, et in domum suam non descendit.
text_pt: E Davi o convidou, e comeu e bebeu diante dele, e o embebedou; e à tarde saiu a deitar-se na sua cama com os servos de seu senhor; porém não desceu à sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν Δαυιδ καὶ ἔφαγεν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔπιεν καὶ ἐμέθυσεν αὐτόν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἑσπέρας τοῦ κοιμηθῆναι ἐπὶ τῆς κοίτης αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν δούλων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ οὐ κατέβη

text_en: And when the morning had come, David wrote a letter to Joab: and sent it by the hand of Urias,
text_la: Factum est ergo mane, et scripsit David epistolam ad Joab : misitque per manum Uriæ,
text_pt: E sucedeu que pela manhã Davi escreveu uma carta a Joabe; e mandou-lha por mão de Urias.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πρωὶ καὶ ἔγραψεν Δαυιδ βιβλίον πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἐν χειρὶ Ουριου

text_en: writing in the letter : Set Urias in the front of the battle, where the fight is strongest: and leave him, that he may be wounded and die.
text_la: scribens in epistola : Ponite Uriam ex adverso belli, ubi fortissimum est prælium : et derelinquite eum, ut percussus intereat.
text_pt: Escreveu na carta, dizendo: Ponde a Urias na frente da maior força da peleja; e retirai-vos de detrás dele, para que seja ferido e morra.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ λέγων εἰσάγαγε τὸν Ουριαν ἐξ ἐναντίας τοῦ πολέμου τοῦ κραταιοῦ καὶ ἀποστραφήσεσθε ἀπὸ ὄπισθεν αὐτοῦ καὶ πληγήσεται καὶ ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: Wherefore as Joab was besieging the city, he put Urias in the place where he knew the bravest men were.
text_la: Igitur cum Joab obsideret urbem, posuit Uriam in loco ubi sciebat viros esse fortissimos.
text_pt: Aconteceu, pois, que, tendo Joabe observado bem a cidade, pôs a Urias no lugar onde sabia que havia homens valentes.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ φυλάσσειν Ιωαβ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸν Ουριαν εἰς τὸν τόπον οὗ ᾔδει ὅτι ἄνδρες δυνάμεως ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the men coming out of the city, fought against Joab, and there fell some of the people of the servants of David , and Urias the Hethite was killed also.
text_la: Egressique viri de civitate, bellabant adversum Joab, et ceciderunt de populo servorum David, et mortuus est etiam Urias Hethæus.
text_pt: E, saindo os homens da cidade, e pelejando com Joabe, caíram alguns do povo, dos servos de Davi; e morreu também Urias, o heteu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπολέμουν μετὰ Ιωαβ καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐκ τῶν δούλων Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέθανεν καί γε Ουριας ὁ Χετταῖος

text_en: Then Joab sent, and told David all things concerning the battle.
text_la: Misit itaque Joab, et nuntiavit David omnia verba prælii:
text_pt: Então enviou Joabe, e fez saber a Davi todo o sucesso daquela peleja.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ιωαβ καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ βασιλεῖ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ πολέμου

text_en: And he charged the messenger, saying: When you have told all the words of the battle to the king,
text_la: præcepitque nuntio, dicens : Cum compleveris universos sermones belli ad regem,
text_pt: E deu ordem ao mensageiro, dizendo: Acabando tu de contar ao rei todo o sucesso desta peleja,
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο τῷ ἀγγέλῳ λέγων ἐν τῷ συντελέσαι σε πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ πολέμου λαλῆσαι πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: if you see him to be angry , and he shall say: Why did you approach so near to the wall to fight? knew you not that many darts are thrown from above off the wall?
text_la: si eum videris indignari, et dixerit : Quare accessistis ad murum, ut præliaremini? an ignorabatis quod multa desuper ex muro tela mittantur?
text_pt: E sucedendo que o rei se encolerize, e te diga: Por que vos chegastes tão perto da cidade a pelejar? Não sabíeis vós que haviam de atirar do muro?
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἀναβῇ ὁ θυμὸς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ εἴπῃ σοι τί ὅτι ἠγγίσατε πρὸς τὴν πόλιν πολεμῆσαι οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι τοξεύσουσιν ἀπάνωθεν τοῦ τείχους

text_en: Who killed Abimelech the son of Jerobaal ? Did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall and slew him in Thebes? Why did you go near the wall? You shall say: Your servant Urias the Hethite is also slain.
text_la: Quis percussit Abimelech filium Jerobaal? nonne mulier misit super eum fragmen molæ de muro, et interfecit eum in Thebes? quare juxta murum accessistis? dices : Etiam servus tuus Urias Hethæus occubuit.
text_pt: Quem feriu a Abimeleque, filho de Jerubesete? Não lançou uma mulher sobre ele do muro um pedaço de uma mó corredora, de que morreu em Tebes? Por que vos chegastes ao muro? Então dirás: Também morreu teu servo Urias, o heteu.
text_el: τίς ἐπάταξεν τὸν Αβιμελεχ υἱὸν Ιεροβααλ οὐχὶ γυνὴ ἔρριψεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν κλάσμα μύλου ἐπάνωθεν τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐν Θαμασι ἵνα τί προσηγάγετε πρὸς τὸ τεῖχος καὶ ἐρεῖς καί γε Ουριας ὁ δοῦλός σου ὁ Χετταῖος ἀπέθανεν

text_en: So the messenger departed, and came and told David all that Joab had commanded him.
text_la: Abiit ergo nuntius, et venit, et narravit David omnia quæ ei præceperat Joab.
text_pt: E foi o mensageiro, e entrou, e fez saber a Davi tudo o que Joabe o enviara a dizer.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὁ ἄγγελος Ιωαβ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ παρεγένετο καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ Δαυιδ πάντα ὅσα ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῷ Ιωαβ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ πολέμου καὶ ἐθυμώθη Δαυιδ πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον ἵνα τί προσηγάγετε πρὸς τὴν πόλιν τοῦ πολεμῆσαι οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι πληγήσεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ τείχους τίς ἐπάταξεν τὸν Αβιμελεχ υἱὸν Ιεροβααλ οὐχὶ γυνὴ ἔρριψεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν κλάσμα μύλου ἀπὸ τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐν Θαμασι ἵνα τί προσηγάγετε πρὸς τὸ τεῖχος

text_en: And the messenger said to David : The men prevailed against us, and they came out to us into the field: and we vigorously charged and pursued them even to the gate of the city.
text_la: Et dixit nuntius ad David : Prævaluerunt adversum nos viri, et egressi sunt ad nos in agrum : nos autem facto impetu persecuti eos sumus usque ad portam civitatis.
text_pt: E disse o mensageiro a Davi: Na verdade que mais poderosos foram aqueles homens do que nós, e saíram a nós ao campo; porém nós fomos contra eles, até à entrada da porta.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος πρὸς Δαυιδ ὅτι ἐκραταίωσαν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς οἱ ἄνδρες καὶ ἐξῆλθαν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς εἰς τὸν ἀγρόν καὶ ἐγενήθημεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἕως τῆς θύρας τῆς πύλης

text_en: And the archers shot their arrows at your servants from off the wall above: and some of the king's servants are slain, and your servant Urias the Hethite is also dead.
text_la: Et direxerunt jacula sagittarii ad servos tuos ex muro desuper, mortuique sunt de servis regis : quin etiam servus tuus Urias Hethæus mortuus est.
text_pt: Então os flecheiros atiraram contra os teus servos desde o alto do muro, e morreram alguns dos servos do rei; e também morreu o teu servo Urias, o heteu.
text_el: καὶ ἐτόξευσαν οἱ τοξεύοντες πρὸς τοὺς παῖδάς σου ἀπάνωθεν τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἀπέθαναν τῶν παίδων τοῦ βασιλέως καί γε ὁ δοῦλός σου Ουριας ὁ Χετταῖος ἀπέθανεν
