text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Μεμφιβοσθε κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ ὁ δοῦλός μου παρελογίσατό με ὅτι εἶπεν ὁ παῖς σου αὐτῷ ἐπίσαξόν μοι τὴν ὄνον καὶ ἐπιβῶ ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ πορεύσομαι μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως ὅτι χωλὸς ὁ δοῦλός σου

text_en: Moreover he has also accused me your servant to you, my lord the king: but you my lord the king are as an angel of God , do what pleases you.
text_la: Insuper et accusavit me servum tuum ad te dominum meum regem : tu autem, domine mi rex, sicut angelus Dei es : fac quod placitum est tibi.
text_pt: Demais disto, falsamente acusou a teu servo diante do rei meu senhor; porém o rei meu senhor é como um anjo de Deus; faze, pois, o que parecer bem aos teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ μεθώδευσεν ἐν τῷ δούλῳ σου πρὸς τὸν κύριόν μου τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς ὡς ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ποίησον τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου

text_en: For all of my father's house were no better than worthy of death before my lord the king; and you have set me your servant among the guests of your table: what just complaint therefore have I? Or what right to cry any more to the king?
text_la: Neque enim fuit domus patris mei, nisi morti obnoxia domino meo regi : tu autem posuisti me servum tuum inter convivas mensæ tuæ : quid ergo habeo justæ querelæ? aut quid possum ultra vociferari ad regem?
text_pt: Porque toda a casa de meu pai não era senão de homens dignos de morte diante do rei meu senhor; e contudo puseste a teu servo entre os que comem à tua mesa; e que mais direito tenho eu de clamar ao rei?
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἦν πᾶς ὁ οἶκος τοῦ πατρός μου ἀλλ' ἢ ὅτι ἄνδρες θανάτου τῷ κυρίῳ μου τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἔθηκας τὸν δοῦλόν σου ἐν τοῖς ἐσθίουσιν τὴν τράπεζάν σου καὶ τί ἐστίν μοι ἔτι δικαίωμα καὶ τοῦ κεκραγέναι με ἔτι πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: Then the king said to him: Why do you speak anymore? What I have said is determined: you and Siba divide the possessions .
text_la: Ait ergo ei rex : Quid ultra loqueris? fixum est quod locutus sum : tu et Siba dividite possessiones.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o rei: Por que ainda mais falas de teus negócios? Já disse eu: Tu e Ziba reparti as terras.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ἵνα τί λαλεῖς ἔτι τοὺς λόγους σου εἶπον σὺ καὶ Σιβα διελεῖσθε τὸν ἀγρόν

text_en: And Miphiboseth answered the king: Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is returned peaceably into his house.
text_la: Responditque Miphiboseth regi : Etiam cuncta accipiat, postquam reversus est dominus meus rex pacifice in domum suam.
text_pt: E disse Mefibosete ao rei: Tome ele também tudo; pois já veio o rei meu senhor em paz à sua casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μεμφιβοσθε πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καί γε τὰ πάντα λαβέτω μετὰ τὸ παραγενέσθαι τὸν κύριόν μου τὸν βασιλέα ἐν εἰρήνῃ εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Berzellai also the Galaadite coming down from Rogelim, brought the king over the Jordan , being ready also to wait on him beyond the river.
text_la: Berzellai quoque Galaadites, descendens de Rogelim, traduxit regem Jordanem, paratus etiam ultra fluvium prosequi eum.
text_pt: Também Barzilai, o gileadita, desceu de Rogelim, e passou com o rei o Jordão, para o acompanhar ao outro lado do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ Βερζελλι ὁ Γαλααδίτης κατέβη ἐκ Ρωγελλιμ καὶ διέβη μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκπέμψαι αὐτὸν τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: Now Berzellai the Galaadite was of a great age, that is to say, fourscore years old, and he provided the king with sustenance when he abode in the camp: for he was a man exceeding rich.
text_la: Erat autem Berzellai Galaadites senex valde, id est, octogenarius, et ipse præbuit alimenta regi cum moraretur in castris : fuit quippe vir dives nimis.
text_pt: E era Barzilai muito velho, da idade de oitenta anos; e ele tinha sustentado o rei, quando tinha a sua morada em Maanaim, porque era grande homem.
text_el: καὶ Βερζελλι ἀνὴρ πρεσβύτερος σφόδρα υἱὸς ὀγδοήκοντα ἐτῶν καὶ αὐτὸς διέθρεψεν τὸν βασιλέα ἐν τῷ οἰκεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν Μαναϊμ ὅτι ἀνὴρ μέγας ἐστὶν σφόδρα

text_en: And the king said to Berzellai: Come with me that you may rest secure with me in Jerusalem .
text_la: Dixit itaque rex ad Berzellai : Veni mecum, ut requiescas securus mecum in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E disse o rei a Barzilai: Passa tu comigo, e sustentar-te-ei comigo em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Βερζελλι σὺ διαβήσῃ μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ διαθρέψω τὸ γῆράς σου μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And Berzellai said to the king: How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem ?
text_la: Et ait Berzellai ad regem : Quot sunt dies annorum vitæ meæ, ut ascendam cum rege in Jerusalem?
text_pt: Porém Barzilai disse ao rei: Quantos serão os dias dos anos da minha vida, para que suba com o rei a Jerusalém?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βερζελλι πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα πόσαι ἡμέραι ἐτῶν ζωῆς μου ὅτι ἀναβήσομαι μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: I am this day fourscore years old, are my senses quick to discern sweet and bitter? Or can meat or drink delight your servant? Or can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women ? Why should your servant be a burden to my lord, the king?
text_la: Octogenarius sum hodie : numquid vigent sensus mei ad discernendum suave aut amarum? aut delectare potest servum tuum cibus et potus? vel audire possum ultra vocem cantorum atque cantatricum? quare servus tuus sit oneri domino meo regi?
text_pt: Da idade de oitenta anos sou eu hoje; poderia eu discernir entre o bom e o mau? Poderia o teu servo ter gosto no que comer e beber? Poderia eu mais ouvir a voz dos cantores e cantoras? E por que será o teu servo ainda pesado ao rei meu senhor?
text_el: υἱὸς ὀγδοήκοντα ἐτῶν ἐγώ εἰμι σήμερον μὴ γνώσομαι ἀνὰ μέσον ἀγαθοῦ καὶ κακοῦ ἢ γεύσεται ὁ δοῦλός σου ἔτι ὃ φάγομαι ἢ πίομαι ἢ ἀκούσομαι ἔτι φωνὴν ᾀδόντων καὶ ᾀδουσῶν ἵνα τί ἔσται ἔτι ὁ δοῦλός σου εἰς φορτίον ἐπὶ τὸν κύριόν μου τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: I your servant will go on a little way from the Jordan with you: I need not this recompense.
text_la: Paululum procedam famulus tuus ab Jordane tecum : non indigeo hac vicissitudine,
text_pt: Com o rei passará teu servo ainda um pouco mais além do Jordão; e por que me recompensará o rei com tal recompensa?
text_el: ὡς βραχὺ διαβήσεται ὁ δοῦλός σου τὸν Ιορδάνην μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἵνα τί ἀνταποδίδωσίν μοι ὁ βασιλεὺς τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν ταύτην

text_en: But I beseech you let your servant return, and die in my own city, and be buried by the sepulchre of my father, and of my mother. But there is your servant Chamaam, let him go with you, my lord, the king, and do to him whatsoever seems good to you.
text_la: sed obsecro ut revertar servus tuus, et moriar in civitate mea, et sepeliar juxta sepulchrum patris mei et matris meæ. Est autem servus tuus Chamaam : ipse vadat tecum, domine mi rex, et fac ei quidquid tibi bonum videtur.
text_pt: Deixa voltar o teu servo, e morrerei na minha cidade, junto à sepultura de meu pai e de minha mãe; mas eis aí está o teu servo Quimã; passe ele com o rei meu senhor, e faze-lhe o que bem parecer aos teus olhos.
text_el: καθισάτω δὴ ὁ δοῦλός σου καὶ ἀποθανοῦμαι ἐν τῇ πόλει μου παρὰ τῷ τάφῳ τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ τῆς μητρός μου καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ δοῦλός σου Χαμααμ διαβήσεται μετὰ τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ποίησον αὐτῷ τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου

text_en: Then the king said to him: Let Chamaam go over with me, and I will do for him whatsoever shall please you, and all that you shall ask of me, you shall obtain.
text_la: Dixit itaque ei rex : Mecum transeat Chamaam, et ego faciam ei quidquid tibi placuerit : et omne quod petieris a me, impetrabis.
text_pt: Então disse o rei: Quimã passará comigo, e eu lhe farei como bem parecer aos teus olhos, e tudo quanto me pedires te farei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς μετ' ἐμοῦ διαβήτω Χαμααμ κἀγὼ ποιήσω αὐτῷ τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐκλέξῃ ἐπ' ἐμοί ποιήσω σοι

text_en: And when all the people and the king had passed over the Jordan , the king kissed Berzellai, and blessed him: and he returned to his own place.
text_la: Cumque transisset universus populus et rex Jordanem, osculatus est rex Berzellai, et benedixit ei : et ille reversus est in locum suum.
text_pt: Havendo, pois, todo o povo passado o Jordão, e passando também o rei, beijou o rei a Barzilai, e o abençoou; e ele voltou para o seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ διέβη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς διέβη καὶ κατεφίλησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Βερζελλι καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτόν καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: So the king went on to Galgal, and Chamaam with him. Now all the people of Juda had brought the king over, and only half of the people of Israel were there.
text_la: Transivit ergo rex in Galgalam, et Chamaam cum eo. Omnis autem populus Juda traduxerat regem, et media tantum pars adfuerat de populo Israël.
text_pt: E dali passou o rei a Gilgal, e Quimã passou com ele; e todo o povo de Judá conduziu o rei, como também a metade do povo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ διέβη ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς Γαλγαλα καὶ Χαμααμ διέβη μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς Ιουδα διαβαίνοντες μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καί γε τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ λαοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Therefore all the men of Israel running together to the king, said to him: Why have our brethren the men of Juda stolen you away, and have brought the king and his household over the Jordan , and all the men of David with him?
text_la: Itaque omnes viri Israël concurrentes ad regem dixerunt ei : Quare te furati sunt fratres nostri viri Juda, et traduxerunt regem et domum ejus Jordanem, omnesque viros David cum eo?
text_pt: E eis que todos os homens de Israel vieram ao rei, e disseram ao rei: Por que te furtaram nossos irmãos, os homens de Judá, e conduziram o rei e a sua casa dalém do Jordão, e todos os homens de Davi com eles?
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ παρεγένοντο πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπον πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα τί ὅτι ἔκλεψάν σε οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν ἀνὴρ Ιουδα καὶ διεβίβασαν τὸν βασιλέα καὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ πάντες ἄνδρες Δαυιδ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the men of Juda answered the men of Israel : Because the king is nearer to me: why are you angry for this matter? Have we eaten anything of the king's, or have any gifts been given us?
text_la: Et respondit omnis vir Juda ad viros Israël : Quia mihi propior est rex : cur irasceris super hac re? numquid comedimus aliquid ex rege, aut munera nobis data sunt?
text_pt: Então responderam todos os homens de Judá aos homens de Israel: Porquanto o rei é nosso parente; e por que vos irais por isso? Porventura comemos às custas do rei, ou nos deu algum presente?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ιουδα πρὸς ἄνδρα Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπαν διότι ἐγγίζει πρός με ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ ἵνα τί οὕτως ἐθυμώθης περὶ τοῦ λόγου τούτου μὴ βρώσει ἐφάγαμεν ἐκ τοῦ βασιλέως ἢ δόμα ἔδωκεν ἢ ἄρσιν ἦρεν ἡμῖν

text_en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Juda , and said: I have ten parts in the king more than you, and David belongs to me more than to you: why have you done me a wrong, and why was it not told me first, that I might bring back my king? And the men of Juda answered more harshly than the men of Israel .
text_la: Et respondit vir Israël ad viros Juda, et ait : Decem partibus major ego sum apud regem, magisque ad me pertinet David quam ad te : cur fecisti mihi injuriam, et non mihi nuntiatum est priori, ut reducerem regem meum? Durius autem responderunt viri Juda viris Israël.
text_pt: E responderam os homens de Israel aos homens de Judá, e disseram: Dez partes temos no rei, e até em Davi mais temos nós do que vós; por que, pois, não fizestes conta de nós, para que a nossa palavra não fosse a primeira, para tornar a trazer o nosso rei? Porém a palavra dos homens de Judá foi mais forte do que a palavra dos homens de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ τῷ ἀνδρὶ Ιουδα καὶ εἶπεν δέκα χεῖρές μοι ἐν τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ πρωτότοκος ἐγὼ ἢ σύ καί γε ἐν τῷ Δαυιδ εἰμὶ ὑπὲρ σέ καὶ ἵνα τί τοῦτο ὕβρισάς με καὶ οὐκ ἐλογίσθη ὁ λόγος μου πρῶτός μοι τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι τὸν βασιλέα ἐμοί καὶ ἐσκληρύνθη ὁ λόγος ἀνδρὸς Ιουδα ὑπὲρ τὸν λόγον ἀνδρὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial , whose name was Seba, the son of Bochri, a man of Jemini: and he sounded the trumpet, and said: We have no part in David , nor inheritance in the son of Isai: return to your dwellings, O Israel .
text_la: Accidit quoque ut ibi esset vir Belial, nomine Seba, filius Bochri, vir Jemineus : et cecinit buccina, et ait : Non est nobis pars in David, neque hæreditas in filio Isai : revertere in tabernacula tua, Israël.
text_pt: Então se achou ali por acaso um homem de Belial, cujo nome era Seba, filho de Bicri, homem de Benjamim, o qual tocou a buzina, e disse: Não temos parte em Davi, nem herança no filho de Jessé; cada um às suas tendas, ó Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐπικαλούμενος υἱὸς παράνομος καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Σαβεε υἱὸς Βοχορι ἀνὴρ ὁ Ιεμενι καὶ ἐσάλπισεν ἐν τῇ κερατίνῃ καὶ εἶπεν οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν μερὶς ἐν Δαυιδ οὐδὲ κληρονομία ἡμῖν ἐν τῷ υἱῷ Ιεσσαι ἀνὴρ εἰς τὰ σκηνώματά σου Ισραηλ

text_en: And all Israel departed from David , and followed Seba the son of Bochri: but the men of Juda stuck to their king from the Jordan unto Jerusalem .
text_la: Et separatus est omnis Israël a David, secutusque est Seba filium Bochri : viri autem Juda adhæserunt regi suo a Jordane usque Jerusalem.
text_pt: Então todos os homens de Israel se separaram de Davi, e seguiram Seba, filho de Bicri; porém os homens de Judá se uniram ao seu rei desde o Jordão até Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ ὄπισθεν Δαυιδ ὀπίσω Σαβεε υἱοῦ Βοχορι καὶ ἀνὴρ Ιουδα ἐκολλήθη τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἕως Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And when the king had come into his house at Jerusalem , he took the ten women his concubines , whom he had left to keep the house, and put them inward, allowing them provisions: and he went not in unto them, but they were shut up unto the day of their death living in widowhood.
text_la: Cumque venisset rex in domum suam in Jerusalem, tulit decem mulieres concubinas quas dereliquerat ad custodiendam domum, et tradidit eas in custodiam, alimenta eis præbens : et non est ingressus ad eas, sed erant clausæ usque in diem mortis suæ in viduitate viventes.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, Davi para sua casa, em Jerusalém, tomou o rei as dez mulheres, suas concubinas, que deixara para guardarem a casa, e as pôs numa casa sob guarda, e as sustentava; porém não as possuiu; e estiveram encerradas até ao dia da sua morte, vivendo como viúvas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Δαυιδ εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔλαβεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὰς δέκα γυναῖκας τὰς παλλακὰς αὐτοῦ ἃς ἀφῆκεν φυλάσσειν τὸν οἶκον καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰς ἐν οἴκῳ φυλακῆς καὶ διέθρεψεν αὐτὰς καὶ πρὸς αὐτὰς οὐκ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἦσαν συνεχόμεναι ἕως ἡμέρας θανάτου αὐτῶν χῆραι ζῶσαι

text_en: And the king said to Amasa: Assemble to me all the men of Juda against the third day, and be thou here present.
text_la: Dixit autem rex Amasæ : Convoca mihi omnes viros Juda in diem tertium, et tu adesto præsens.
text_pt: Disse mais o rei a Amasa: Convoca-me os homens de Judá para o terceiro dia; e tu então apresenta-te aqui.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Αμεσσαϊ βόησόν μοι τὸν ἄνδρα Ιουδα τρεῖς ἡμέρας σὺ δὲ αὐτοῦ στῆθι

text_en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Juda , but he tarried beyond the set time which the king had appointed him.
text_la: Abiit ergo Amasa ut convocaret Judam, et moratus est extra placitum quod ei constituerat rex.
text_pt: E foi Amasa para convocar a Judá; porém demorou-se além do tempo que lhe tinha sido designado.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Αμεσσαϊ τοῦ βοῆσαι τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ ἐχρόνισεν ἀπὸ τοῦ καιροῦ οὗ ἐτάξατο αὐτῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: And David said to Abisai : Now will Seba the son of Bochri do us more harm than did Absalom : take therefore the servants of your lord, and pursue after him, lest he find fenced cities, and escape us.
text_la: Ait autem David ad Abisai : Nunc magis afflicturus est nos Seba filius Bochri quam Absalom : tolle igitur servos domini tui, et persequere eum, ne forte inveniat civitates munitas, et effugiat nos.
text_pt: Então disse Davi a Abisai: Mais mal agora nos fará Seba, o filho de Bicri, do que Absalão; por isso toma tu os servos de teu senhor, e persegue-o, para que não ache para si cidades fortes, e escape dos nossos olhos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Αβεσσα νῦν κακοποιήσει ἡμᾶς Σαβεε υἱὸς Βοχορι ὑπὲρ Αβεσσαλωμ καὶ νῦν σὺ λαβὲ μετὰ σεαυτοῦ τοὺς παῖδας τοῦ κυρίου σου καὶ καταδίωξον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ μήποτε ἑαυτῷ εὕρῃ πόλεις ὀχυρὰς καὶ σκιάσει τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμῶν

text_en: So Joab's men went out with him, and the Cerethi and the Phelethi: and all the valiant men went out of Jerusalem to pursue after Seba the son of Bochri.
text_la: Egressi sunt ergo cum eo viri Joab, Cerethi quoque et Phelethi : et omnes robusti exierunt de Jerusalem ad persequendum Seba filium Bochri.
text_pt: Então saíram atrás dele os homens de Joabe, e os quereteus, e os peleteus, e todos os valentes; estes saíram de Jerusalém para irem atrás de Seba, filho de Bicri.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ οἱ ἄνδρες Ιωαβ καὶ ὁ Χερεθθι καὶ ὁ Φελεθθι καὶ πάντες οἱ δυνατοὶ καὶ ἐξῆλθαν ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ διῶξαι ὀπίσω Σαβεε υἱοῦ Βοχορι

text_en: And when they were at the great stone which is in Gabaon, Amasa coming met them. And Joab had on a close coat of equal length with his habit, and over it was girded with a sword hanging down to his flank, in a scabbard, made in such manner as to come out with the least motion and strike.
text_la: Cumque illi essent juxta lapidem grandem qui est in Gabaon, Amasa veniens occurrit eis. Porro Joab vestitus erat tunica stricta ad mensuram habitus sui, et desuper accinctus gladio dependente usque ad ilia, in vagina, qui fabricatus levi motu egredi poterat, et percutere.
text_pt: Chegando eles, pois, à pedra grande, que está junto a Gibeom, Amasa veio diante deles; e estava Joabe cingido da sua roupa que vestira, e sobre ela um cinto, ao qual estava presa a espada a seus lombos, na sua bainha; e, adiantando-se ele, lhe caiu a espada.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ παρὰ τῷ λίθῳ τῷ μεγάλῳ τῷ ἐν Γαβαων καὶ Αμεσσαϊ εἰσῆλθεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν καὶ Ιωαβ περιεζωσμένος μανδύαν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῷ περιεζωσμένος μάχαιραν ἐζευγμένην ἐπὶ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ ἐν κολεῷ αὐτῆς καὶ ἡ μάχαιρα ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἔπεσεν

text_en: And Joab said to Amasa: God save you, my brother. And he took Amasa by the chin with his right hand to kiss him.
text_la: Dixit itaque Joab ad Amasam : Salve mi frater. Et tenuit manu dextera mentum Amasæ, quasi osculans eum.
text_pt: E disse Joabe a Amasa: Vai bem, meu irmão? E Joabe, com a mão direita, pegou da barba de Amasa, para o beijar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ τῷ Αμεσσαϊ εἰ ὑγιαίνεις σύ ἀδελφέ καὶ ἐκράτησεν ἡ χεὶρ ἡ δεξιὰ Ιωαβ τοῦ πώγωνος Αμεσσαϊ τοῦ καταφιλῆσαι αὐτόν

text_en: But Amasa did not take notice of the sword, which Joab had, and he struck him in the side, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and gave him not a second wound, and he died. And Joab, and Abisai his brother pursued after Seba the son of Bochri.
text_la: Porro Amasa non observavit gladium quem habebat Joab : qui percussit eum in latere, et effudit intestina ejus in terram, nec secundum vulnus apposuit : et mortuus est. Joab autem, et Abisai frater ejus, persecuti sunt Seba filium Bochri.
text_pt: E Amasa não se resguardou da espada que estava na mão de Joabe, de sorte que este o feriu com ela na quinta costela, e lhe derramou por terra as entranhas, e não o feriu segunda vez, e morreu; então Joabe e Abisai, seu irmão, foram atrás de Seba, filho de Bicri.
text_el: καὶ Αμεσσαϊ οὐκ ἐφυλάξατο τὴν μάχαιραν τὴν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ Ιωαβ καὶ ἔπαισεν αὐτὸν ἐν αὐτῇ Ιωαβ εἰς τὴν ψόαν καὶ ἐξεχύθη ἡ κοιλία αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ οὐκ ἐδευτέρωσεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀπέθανεν καὶ Ιωαβ καὶ Αβεσσα ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἐδίωξεν ὀπίσω Σαβεε υἱοῦ Βοχορι

text_en: In the mean time some men of Joab's company stopping at the dead body of Amasa, said: Behold he that would have been in Joab's stead the companion of David .
text_la: Interea quidam viri, cum stetissent juxta cadaver Amasæ, de sociis Joab, dixerunt : Ecce qui esse voluit pro Joab comes David.
text_pt: Mas um dentre os homens de Joabe parou junto a ele, e disse: Quem há que queira bem a Joabe, e quem seja por Davi, siga Joabe.
text_el: καὶ ἀνὴρ ἔστη ἐπ' αὐτὸν τῶν παιδαρίων Ιωαβ καὶ εἶπεν τίς ὁ βουλόμενος Ιωαβ καὶ τίς τοῦ Δαυιδ ὀπίσω Ιωαβ

text_en: And Amasa imbrued with blood, lay in the midst of the way. A certain man saw this that all the people stood still to look upon him, so he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and covered him with a garment, that they who passed might, not stop on his account.
text_la: Amasa autem conspersus sanguine jacebat in media via. Vidit hoc quidam vir, quod subsisteret omnis populus ad videndum eum, et amovit Amasam de via in agrum, operuitque eum vestimento, ne subsisterent transeuntes propter eum.
text_pt: E Amasa estava envolto no seu sangue no meio do caminho; e, vendo aquele homem, que todo o povo parava, removeu a Amasa do caminho para o campo, e lançou sobre ele um manto; porque via que todo aquele que chegava a ele parava.
text_el: καὶ Αμεσσαϊ πεφυρμένος ἐν τῷ αἵματι ἐν μέσῳ τῆς τρίβου καὶ εἶδεν ὁ ἀνὴρ ὅτι εἱστήκει πᾶς ὁ λαός καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν τὸν Αμεσσαϊ ἐκ τῆς τρίβου εἰς ἀγρὸν καὶ ἐπέρριψεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἱμάτιον καθότι εἶδεν πάντα τὸν ἐρχόμενον ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἑστηκότα

text_en: And when he was removed out of the way, all the people went on following Joab to pursue after Seba the son of Bochri.
text_la: Amoto ergo illo de via, transibat omnis vir sequens Joab ad persequendum Seba filium Bochri.
text_pt: E, como estava removido do caminho, todos os homens seguiram a Joabe, para perseguirem a Seba, filho de Bicri.
text_el: ἡνίκα δὲ ἔφθασεν ἐκ τῆς τρίβου παρῆλθεν πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ ὀπίσω Ιωαβ τοῦ διῶξαι ὀπίσω Σαβεε υἱοῦ Βοχορι

text_en: Now he had passed through all the tribes of Israel unto Abela and Bethmaacha : and all the chosen men were gathered together unto him.
text_la: Porro ille transierat per omnes tribus Israël in Abelam et Bethmaacha : omnesque viri electi congregati fuerant ad eum.
text_pt: E ele passou por todas as tribos de Israel até Abel, e Bete-Maaca e a todos os beritas; e ajuntaram-se, e também o seguiram.
text_el: καὶ διῆλθεν ἐν πάσαις φυλαῖς Ισραηλ εἰς Αβελ καὶ εἰς Βαιθμαχα καὶ πάντες ἐν Χαρρι καὶ ἐξεκκλησιάσθησαν καὶ ἦλθον κατόπισθεν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they came, and besieged him in Abela, and in Bethmaacha, and they cast up works round the city, and the city was besieged: and all the people that were with Joab, laboured to throw down the walls.
text_la: Venerunt itaque, et oppugnabant eum in Abela et in Bethmaacha, et circumdederunt munitionibus civitatem, et obsessa est urbs : omnis autem turba quæ erat cum Joab, moliebatur destruere muros.
text_pt: E vieram, e o cercaram em Abel de Bete-Maaca, e levantaram uma barragem contra a cidade, e isto colocado na trincheira; e todo o povo que estava com Joabe batia no muro, para derrubá-lo.
text_el: καὶ παρεγενήθησαν καὶ ἐπολιόρκουν ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὴν Αβελ καὶ τὴν Βαιθμαχα καὶ ἐξέχεαν πρόσχωμα πρὸς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἔστη ἐν τῷ προτειχίσματι καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετὰ Ιωαβ ἐνοοῦσαν καταβαλεῖν τὸ τεῖχος

text_en: And a wise woman cried out from the city: Hear, hear, and say to Joab: Come near hither, and I will speak with you.
text_la: Et exclamavit mulier sapiens de civitate : Audite, audite : dicite Joab : Appropinqua huc, et loquar tecum.
text_pt: Então uma mulher sábia gritou de dentro da cidade: Ouvi, ouvi, peço-vos que digais a Joabe: Chega-te aqui, para que eu te fale.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν γυνὴ σοφὴ ἐκ τοῦ τείχους καὶ εἶπεν ἀκούσατε ἀκούσατε εἴπατε δὴ πρὸς Ιωαβ ἔγγισον ἕως ὧδε καὶ λαλήσω πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: And when he had come near to her, she said to him: Are you Joab? And he answered: I am. And she spoke thus to him: Hear the words of your handmaid. He answered: I do hear.
text_la: Qui cum accessisset ad eam, ait illi : Tu es Joab? Et ille respondit : Ego. Ad quem sic locuta est : Audi sermones ancillæ tuæ. Qui respondit : Audio.
text_pt: Chegando-se a ela, a mulher lhe disse: Tu és Joabe? E disse ele: Eu sou. E ela lhe disse: Ouve as palavras da tua serva. E disse ele: Ouço.
text_el: καὶ προσήγγισεν πρὸς αὐτήν καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνή εἰ σὺ εἶ Ιωαβ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἄκουσον τοὺς λόγους τῆς δούλης σου καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ ἀκούω ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: And she again said: A saying was used in the old proverb: They that inquire, let them inquire in Abela: and so they made an end.
text_la: Rursumque illa : Sermo, inquit, dicebatur in veteri proverbio : Qui interrogant, interrogent in Abela : et sic perficiebant.
text_pt: Então falou ela, dizendo: Antigamente costumava-se dizer: Certamente pediram conselho a Abel; e assim resolveram.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν λέγουσα λόγον ἐλάλησαν ἐν πρώτοις λέγοντες ἠρωτημένος ἠρωτήθη ἐν τῇ Αβελ καὶ ἐν Δαν εἰ ἐξέλιπον ἃ ἔθεντο οἱ πιστοὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐρωτῶντες ἐπερωτήσουσιν ἐν Αβελ καὶ οὕτως εἰ ἐξέλιπον

text_en: Am not I she that answer truth in Israel , and you seek to destroy the city, and to overthrow a mother in Israel ? Why will you throw down the inheritance of the Lord ?
text_la: Nonne ego sum quæ respondeo veritatem in Israël, et tu quæris subvertere civitatem et evertere matrem in Israël? quare præcipitas hæreditatem Domini?
text_pt: Sou eu uma das pacíficas e das fiéis em Israel; e tu procuras matar uma cidade que é mãe em Israel; por que, pois, devorarias a herança do Senhor?
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι εἰρηνικὰ τῶν στηριγμάτων Ισραηλ σὺ δὲ ζητεῖς θανατῶσαι πόλιν καὶ μητρόπολιν ἐν Ισραηλ ἵνα τί καταποντίζεις κληρονομίαν κυρίου

text_en: And Joab answering said: God forbid, God forbid that I should, I do not throw down, nor destroy.
text_la: Respondensque Joab, ait : Absit, absit hoc a me : non præcipito, neque demolior.
text_pt: Então respondeu Joabe, e disse: Longe, longe de mim que eu tal faça, que eu devore ou arruíne!
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ιωαβ καὶ εἶπεν ἵλεώς μοι ἵλεώς μοι εἰ καταποντιῶ καὶ εἰ διαφθερῶ

text_en: The matter is not so, but a man of mount Ephraim, Seba the son of Bochri by name , has lifted up his hand against King David : deliver him only, and we will depart from the city. And the woman said to Joab: Behold his head shall be thrown to you from the wall.
text_la: Non sic se habet res, sed homo de monte Ephraim, Seba filius Bochri cognomine, levavit manum suam contra regem David : tradite illum solum, et recedemus a civitate. Et ait mulier ad Joab : Ecce caput ejus mittetur ad te per murum.
text_pt: A coisa não é assim; porém um só homem do monte de Efraim, cujo nome é Seba, filho de Bicri, levantou a mão contra o rei, contra Davi; entregai-me só este, e retirar-me-ei da cidade. Então disse a mulher a Joabe: Eis que te será lançada a sua cabeça pelo muro.
text_el: οὐχ οὗτος ὁ λόγος ὅτι ἀνὴρ ἐξ ὄρους Εφραιμ Σαβεε υἱὸς Βοχορι ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπῆρεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ δότε αὐτόν μοι μόνον καὶ ἀπελεύσομαι ἀπάνωθεν τῆς πόλεως καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ πρὸς Ιωαβ ἰδοὺ ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ ῥιφήσεται πρὸς σὲ διὰ τοῦ τείχους

text_en: So she went to all the people, and spoke to them wisely: and they cut off the head of Seba the son of Bochri, and cast it out to Joab. And he sounded the trumpet, and they departed from the city, every one to their home: and Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
text_la: Ingressa est ergo ad omnem populum, et locuta est eis sapienter : qui abscissum caput Seba filii Bochri projecerunt ad Joab. Et ille cecinit tuba, et recesserunt ab urbe, unusquisque in tabernacula sua : Joab autem reversus est Jerusalem ad regem.
text_pt: E a mulher, na sua sabedoria, foi a todo o povo, e cortaram a cabeça de Seba, filho de Bicri, e a lançaram a Joabe; então este tocou a buzina, e se retiraram da cidade, cada um para a sua tenda, e Joabe voltou a Jerusalém, ao rei.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἡ γυνὴ πρὸς πάντα τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς πᾶσαν τὴν πόλιν ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὴν κεφαλὴν Σαβεε υἱοῦ Βοχορι καὶ ἔβαλεν πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ ἐσάλπισεν ἐν κερατίνῃ καὶ διεσπάρησαν ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως ἀνὴρ εἰς τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ Ιωαβ ἀπέστρεψεν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: So Joab was over all the army of Israel : and Banaias the son of Joiada was over the Cerethites and Phelethites,
text_la: Fuit ergo Joab super omnem exercitum Israël : Banaias autem filius Jojadæ super Cerethæos et Phelethæos:
text_pt: E Joabe estava sobre todo o exército de Israel; e Benaia, filho de Joiada, sobre os quereteus e sobre os peleteus;
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ πρὸς πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει Ισραηλ καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε ἐπὶ τοῦ Χερεθθι καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ Φελεθθι

text_en: but Aduram over the tributes: and Josaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder.
text_la: Aduram vero super tributa : porro Josaphat filius Ahilud, a commentariis:
text_pt: E Adorão sobre os tributos; e Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, era o cronista;
text_el: καὶ Αδωνιραμ ἐπὶ τοῦ φόρου καὶ Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς Αχιλουθ ἀναμιμνῄσκων

text_en: And Siva was scribe: and Sadoc and Abiathar , priests .
text_la: Siva autem, scriba : Sadoc vero et Abiathar, sacerdotes.
text_pt: E Seva, o escrivão; e Zadoque e Abiatar, os sacerdotes;
text_el: καὶ Σουσα γραμματεύς καὶ Σαδωκ καὶ Αβιαθαρ ἱερεῖς

text_en: And Ira the Jairite was the priest of David .
text_la: Ira autem Jairites erat sacerdos David.
text_pt: E também Ira, o jairita, era o oficial-mor de Davi.
text_el: καί γε Ιρας ὁ Ιαριν ἦν ἱερεὺς τοῦ Δαυιδ

text_en: And there was a famine in the days of David for three years successively: and David consulted the oracle of the Lord . And the Lord said: It is for Saul , and his bloody house, because he slow the Gabaonites.
text_la: Facta est quoque fames in diebus David tribus annis jugiter : et consuluit David oraculum Domini. Dixitque Dominus : Propter Saul, et domum ejus sanguinum, quia occidit Gabaonitas.
text_pt: E houve nos dias de Davi uma fome de três anos consecutivos; e Davi consultou ao SENHOR, e o SENHOR lhe disse: É por causa de Saul e da sua casa sanguinária, porque matou os gibeonitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λιμὸς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Δαυιδ τρία ἔτη ἐνιαυτὸς ἐχόμενος ἐνιαυτοῦ καὶ ἐζήτησεν Δαυιδ τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἀδικία διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν θανάτῳ αἱμάτων περὶ οὗ ἐθανάτωσεν τοὺς Γαβαωνίτας

text_en: Then the king, calling for the Gabaonites, said to them: (Now the Gabaonites were not of the children of Israel , but the remains of the Amorrhites : and the children of Israel had sworn to them, and Saul sought to slay them out of zeal, as it were for the children of Israel and Juda ):
text_la: Vocatis ergo Gabaonitis rex, dixit ad eos (porro Gabaonitæ non erant de filiis Israël, sed reliquiæ Amorrhæorum : filii quippe Israël juraverant eis, et voluit Saul percutere eos zelo, quasi pro filiis Israël et Juda),
text_pt: Então chamou o rei aos gibeonitas, e lhes falou (ora os gibeonitas não eram dos filhos de Israel, mas do restante dos amorreus, e os filhos de Israel lhes tinham jurado, porém Saul, no seu zelo à causa dos filhos de Israel e de Judá, procurou feri-los).
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ τοὺς Γαβαωνίτας καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ οἱ Γαβαωνῖται οὐχ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ εἰσίν ὅτι ἀλλ' ἢ ἐκ τοῦ λείμματος τοῦ Αμορραίου καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ὤμοσαν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐζήτησεν Σαουλ πατάξαι αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ζηλῶσαι αὐτὸν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: David therefore said to the Gabaonites: What shall I do for you? And what shall be the atonement or you, that you may bless the inheritance of the Lord ?
text_la: dixit ergo David ad Gabaonitas : Quid faciam vobis? et quod erit vestri piaculum, ut benedicatis hæreditati Domini?
text_pt: Disse, pois, Davi aos gibeonitas: Que quereis que eu vos faça? E que satisfação vos darei, para que abençoeis a herança do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς τοὺς Γαβαωνίτας τί ποιήσω ὑμῖν καὶ ἐν τίνι ἐξιλάσομαι καὶ εὐλογήσετε τὴν κληρονομίαν κυρίου

text_en: And the Gabaonites said to him: We have no contest about silver and gold, but against Saul and against his house: neither do we desire that any man be slain of Israel . And the king said to them: What will you then that I should do for you?
text_la: Dixeruntque ei Gabaonitæ : Non est nobis super argento et auro quæstio, sed contra Saul, et contra domum ejus : neque volumus ut interficiatur homo de Israël. Ad quos rex ait : Quid ergo vultis ut faciam vobis?
text_pt: Então os gibeonitas lhe disseram: Não é por prata nem ouro que temos questão com Saul e com sua casa; nem tampouco pretendemos matar pessoa alguma em Israel. E disse ele: Que é, pois, que quereis que vos faça?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ οἱ Γαβαωνῖται οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον μετὰ Σαουλ καὶ μετὰ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἀνὴρ θανατῶσαι ἐν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν τί ὑμεῖς λέγετε καὶ ποιήσω ὑμῖν

text_en: And they said to the king: The man that crushed us and oppressed us unjustly , we must destroy in such manner that there be not so much as one left of his stock in all the coasts of Israel .
text_la: Qui dixerunt regi : Virum qui attrivit nos et oppressit inique, ita delere debemus, ut ne unus quidem residuus sit de stirpe ejus in cunctis finibus Israël.
text_pt: E disseram ao rei: O homem que nos destruiu, e intentou contra nós de modo que fôssemos assolados, sem que pudéssemos subsistir em termo algum de Israel,
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ὁ ἀνὴρ συνετέλεσεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐδίωξεν ἡμᾶς ὃς παρελογίσατο ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἡμᾶς ἀφανίσωμεν αὐτὸν τοῦ μὴ ἑστάναι αὐτὸν ἐν παντὶ ὁρίῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: Let seven men of his children be delivered unto us, that we may crucify them to the Lord in Gabaa of Saul , once the chosen of the Lord . And the king said: I will give them.
text_la: Dentur nobis septem viri de filiis ejus, ut crucifigamus eos Domino in Gabaa Saul, quondam electi Domini. Et ait rex : Ego dabo.
text_pt: De seus filhos se nos dêem sete homens, para que os enforquemos ao Senhor em Gibeá de Saul, o eleito do Senhor. E disse o rei: Eu os darei.
text_el: δότω ἡμῖν ἑπτὰ ἄνδρας ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξηλιάσωμεν αὐτοὺς τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν Γαβαων Σαουλ ἐκλεκτοὺς κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς ἐγὼ δώσω

text_en: And the king spared Miphiboseth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the oath of the Lord , that had been between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .
text_la: Pepercitque rex Miphiboseth filio Jonathæ filii Saul, propter jusjurandum Domini quod fuerat inter David et inter Jonathan filium Saul.
text_pt: Porém o rei poupou a Mefibosete, filho de Jônatas, filho de Saul, por causa do juramento do Senhor, que entre eles houvera, entre Davi e Jônatas, filho de Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἐφείσατο ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ Μεμφιβοσθε υἱὸν Ιωναθαν υἱοῦ Σαουλ διὰ τὸν ὅρκον κυρίου τὸν ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν ἀνὰ μέσον Δαυιδ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Ιωναθαν υἱοῦ Σαουλ

text_en: So the king took the two sons of Respha the daughter of Aia, whom she bore to Saul , Armoni, and Miphiboseth: and the five sons of Michol the daughter of Saul , whom she bore to Hadriel the son of Berzellai, that was of Molathi:
text_la: Tulit itaque rex duos filios Respha filiæ Aja quos peperit Sauli, Armoni, et Miphiboseth : et quinque filios Michol filiæ Saul quos genuerat Hadrieli filio Berzellai, qui fuit de Molathi,
text_pt: Mas tomou o rei os dois filhos de Rispa, filha da Aiá, que tinha tido de Saul, a Armoni e a Mefibosete; como também os cinco filhos da irmã de Mical, filha de Saul, que tivera de Adriel, filho de Barzilai, meolatita,
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Ρεσφα θυγατρὸς Αια οὓς ἔτεκεν τῷ Σαουλ τὸν Ερμωνι καὶ τὸν Μεμφιβοσθε καὶ τοὺς πέντε υἱοὺς Μιχολ θυγατρὸς Σαουλ οὓς ἔτεκεν τῷ Εσριηλ υἱῷ Βερζελλι τῷ Μοουλαθι

text_en: And gave them into the hands of the Gabaonites: and they crucified them on a hill before the Lord : and these seven died together in the first days of the harvest, when the barley began to be reaped.
text_la: et dedit eos in manus Gabaonitarum : qui crucifixerunt eos in monte coram Domino : et ceciderunt hi septem simul occisi in diebus messis primis, incipiente messione hordei.
text_pt: E os entregou na mão dos gibeonitas, os quais os enforcaram no monte, perante o Senhor; e caíram estes sete juntamente; e foram mortos nos dias da sega, nos dias primeiros, no princípio da sega das cevadas.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ τῶν Γαβαωνιτῶν καὶ ἐξηλίασαν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἔπεσαν οἱ ἑπτὰ αὐτοὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό καὶ αὐτοὶ δὲ ἐθανατώθησαν ἐν ἡμέραις θερισμοῦ ἐν πρώτοις ἐν ἀρχῇ θερισμοῦ κριθῶν

text_en: And Respha the daughter of Aia took haircloth, and spread it under her upon the rock from the beginning of the harvest, till water dropped upon them out of heaven : and suffered neither the birds to tear them by day, nor the beasts by night.
text_la: Tollens autem Respha filia Aja cilicium, substravit sibi supra petram ab initio messis, donec stillaret aqua super eos de cælo : et non dimisit aves lacerare eos per diem, neque bestias per noctem.
text_pt: Então Rispa, filha de Aiá, tomou um pano de cilício, e estendeu-lho sobre uma penha, desde o princípio da sega até que a água do céu caiu sobre eles; e não deixou as aves do céu pousar sobre eles de dia, nem os animais do campo de noite.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ρεσφα θυγάτηρ Αια τὸν σάκκον καὶ ἔπηξεν αὑτῇ πρὸς τὴν πέτραν ἐν ἀρχῇ θερισμοῦ κριθῶν ἕως ἔσταξεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταπαῦσαι ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ νυκτός

text_en: And it was told David , what Respha the daughter of Aia, the concubine of Saul , had done.
text_la: Et nuntiata sunt David quæ fecerat Respha filia Aja, concubina Saul.
text_pt: E foi contado a Davi o que fizera Rispa, filha de Aiá, concubina de Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Δαυιδ ὅσα ἐποίησεν Ρεσφα θυγάτηρ Αια παλλακὴ Σαουλ καὶ ἐξελύθησαν καὶ κατέλαβεν αὐτοὺς Δαν υἱὸς Ιωα ἐκ τῶν ἀπογόνων τῶν γιγάντων

text_en: And David went, and took the bones of Saul , and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabes Galaad, who had stolen them from the street of Bethsan , where the Philistines had hanged them when they had slain Saul in Gelboe.
text_la: Et abiit David, et tulit ossa Saul, et ossa Jonathæ filii ejus, a viris Jabes Galaad, qui furati fuerant ea de platea Bethsan in qua suspenderant eos Philisthiim cum interfecissent Saul in Gelboë:
text_pt: Então foi Davi, e tomou os ossos de Saul, e os ossos de Jônatas seu filho, dos moradores de Jabes-Gileade, os quais os furtaram da rua de Bete-Sã, onde os filisteus os tinham pendurado, quando feriram a Saul em Gilboa.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Δαυιδ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ὀστᾶ Σαουλ καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ Ιωναθαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ παρὰ τῶν ἀνδρῶν υἱῶν Ιαβις Γαλααδ οἳ ἔκλεψαν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς πλατείας Βαιθσαν ὅτι ἔστησαν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐπάταξαν οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι τὸν Σαουλ ἐν Γελβουε

text_en: And he brought from thence the bones of Saul , and the bones of Jonathan his son, and they gathered up the bones of them that were crucified,
text_la: et asportavit inde ossa Saul, et ossa Jonathæ filii ejus : et colligentes ossa eorum qui affixi fuerant,
text_pt: E fez subir dali os ossos de Saul, e os ossos de Jônatas seu filho; e ajuntaram também os ossos dos enforcados.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ἐκεῖθεν τὰ ὀστᾶ Σαουλ καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ Ιωναθαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ συνήγαγεν τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν ἐξηλιασμένων

text_en: and they buried them with the bones of Saul , and of Jonathan his son in the land of Benjamin , in the side, in the sepulchre of Cis his father: and they did all that the king had commanded, and God showed mercy again to the land after these things.
text_la: sepelierunt ea cum ossibus Saul et Jonathæ filii ejus in terra Benjamin, in latere, in sepulchro Cis patris ejus : feceruntque omnia quæ præceperat rex, et repropitiatus est Deus terræ post hæc.
text_pt: Enterraram os ossos de Saul, e de Jônatas seu filho na terra de Benjamim, em Zela, na sepultura de seu pai Quis, e fizeram tudo o que o rei ordenara; e depois disto Deus se aplacou com a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔθαψαν τὰ ὀστᾶ Σαουλ καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ Ιωναθαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν ἡλιασθέντων ἐν γῇ Βενιαμιν ἐν τῇ πλευρᾷ ἐν τῷ τάφῳ Κις τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησαν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ ἐπήκουσεν ὁ θεὸς τῇ γῇ μετὰ ταῦτα

text_en: And the Philistines made war again against Israel , and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines . And David growing faint,
text_la: Factum est autem rursum prælium Philisthinorum adversum Israël, et descendit David, et servi ejus cum eo, et pugnabant contra Philisthiim. Deficiente autem David,
text_pt: Tiveram mais os filisteus uma peleja contra Israel; e desceu Davi, e com ele os seus servos; e tanto pelejaram contra os filisteus, que Davi se cansou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἔτι πόλεμος τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις μετὰ Ισραηλ καὶ κατέβη Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπολέμησαν μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐξελύθη Δαυιδ

text_en: Jesbibenob, who was of the race of Arapha, the iron of whose spear weighed three hundred ounces, being girded with a new sword, attempted to kill David .
text_la: Jesbibenob, qui fuit de genere Arapha, cujus ferrum hastæ trecentas uncias appendebat, et accinctus erat ense novo, nisus est percutere David.
text_pt: E Isbi-Benobe, que era dos filhos do gigante, cuja lança pesava trezentos siclos de cobre, e que cingia uma espada nova, intentou ferir a Davi.
text_el: καὶ Ιεσβι ὃς ἦν ἐν τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τοῦ Ραφα καὶ ὁ σταθμὸς τοῦ δόρατος αὐτοῦ τριακοσίων σίκλων ὁλκὴ χαλκοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς περιεζωσμένος κορύνην καὶ διενοεῖτο πατάξαι τὸν Δαυιδ

text_en: And Abisai the son of Sarvia rescued him, and striking the Philistine killed him. Then David's men swore unto him saying: You shall go no more out with us to battle, lest you put out the lamp of Israel .
text_la: Præsidioque ei fuit Abisai filius Sarviæ, et percussum Philisthæum interfecit. Tunc juraverunt viri David, dicentes : Jam non egredieris nobiscum in bellum, ne extinguas lucernam Israël.
text_pt: Porém, Abisai, filho de Zeruia, o socorreu, e feriu o filisteu, e o matou. Então os homens de Davi lhe juraram, dizendo: Nunca mais sairás conosco à peleja, para que não apagues a lâmpada de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐβοήθησεν αὐτῷ Αβεσσα υἱὸς Σαρουιας καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν ἀλλόφυλον καὶ ἐθανάτωσεν αὐτόν τότε ὤμοσαν οἱ ἄνδρες Δαυιδ λέγοντες οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ ἔτι μεθ' ἡμῶν εἰς πόλεμον καὶ οὐ μὴ σβέσῃς τὸν λύχνον Ισραηλ

text_en: There was also a second battle in Gob against the Philistines : then Sobochai of Husathi slew Saph of the race of Arapha of the family of the giants.
text_la: Secundum quoque bellum fuit in Gob contra Philisthæos : tunc percussit Sobochai de Husati, Saph de stirpe Arapha de genere gigantum.
text_pt: E aconteceu depois disto que houve em Gobe ainda outra peleja contra os filisteus; então Sibecai, o husatita, feriu a Safe, que era dos filhos do gigante.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη μετὰ ταῦτα ἔτι πόλεμος ἐν Γεθ μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τότε ἐπάταξεν Σεβοχα ὁ Αστατωθι τὸν Σεφ τὸν ἐν τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τοῦ Ραφα

text_en: And there was a third battle in Gob against the Philistines , in which Adeodatus the son of the Forrest an embroiderer of Bethlehem slew Goliath the Gethite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
text_la: Tertium quoque fuit bellum in Gob contra Philisthæos, in quo percussit Adeodatus filius Saltus polymitarius Bethlehemites Goliath Gethæum, cujus hastile hastæ erat quasi liciatorium texentium.
text_pt: Houve mais outra peleja contra os filisteus em Gobe; e El-Hanã, filho de Jaaré-Oregim, o belemita, feriu Golias, o giteu, de cuja lança era a haste como órgão de tecelão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ πόλεμος ἐν Γοβ μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ελεαναν υἱὸς Αριωργιμ ὁ Βαιθλεεμίτης τὸν Γολιαθ τὸν Γεθθαῖον καὶ τὸ ξύλον τοῦ δόρατος αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀντίον ὑφαινόντων

text_en: A fourth battle was in Geth: where there was a man of great stature, that had six fingers on each hand, and six toes on each foot, four and twenty in all, and he was of the race of Arapha.
text_la: Quartum bellum fuit in Geth : in quo vir fuit excelsus, qui senos in manibus pedibusque habebat digitos, id est, viginti quatuor : et erat de origine Arapha.
text_pt: Houve ainda também outra peleja em Gate, onde estava um homem de alta estatura, que tinha em cada mão seis dedos, e em cada pé outros seis, vinte e quatro ao todo, e também este nascera do gigante.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος ἐν Γεθ καὶ ἦν ἀνὴρ Μαδων καὶ οἱ δάκτυλοι τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ δάκτυλοι τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ ἓξ καὶ ἕξ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες ἀριθμῷ καί γε αὐτὸς ἐτέχθη τῷ Ραφα

text_en: And he reproached Israel : and Jonathan the son of Samae the brother of David slew him.
text_la: Et blasphemavit Israël : percussit autem eum Jonathan filius Samaa fratris David.
text_pt: E injuriava a Israel; porém Jônatas, filho de Simei, irmão de Davi, o feriu.
text_el: καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Σεμεϊ ἀδελφοῦ Δαυιδ

text_en: These four were born of Arapha in Geth, and they fell by the hand of David , and of his servants.
text_la: Hi quatuor nati sunt de Arapha in Geth, et ceciderunt in manu David et servorum ejus.
text_pt: Estes quatro nasceram ao gigante em Gate; e caíram pela mão de Davi e pela mão de seus servos.
text_el: οἱ τέσσαρες οὗτοι ἐτέχθησαν ἀπόγονοι τῶν γιγάντων ἐν Γεθ τῷ Ραφα οἶκος καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐν χειρὶ Δαυιδ καὶ ἐν χειρὶ τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And David spoke to the Lord the words of this canticle, in the day that the Lord delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul ,
text_la: Locutus est autem David Domino verba carminis hujus in die qua liberavit eum Dominus de manu omnium inimicorum suorum, et de manu Saul.
text_pt: E Falou Davi ao SENHOR as palavras deste cântico, no dia em que o SENHOR o livrou das mãos de todos os seus inimigos e das mãos de Saul.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Δαυιδ τῷ κυρίῳ τοὺς λόγους τῆς ᾠδῆς ταύτης ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν κύριος ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς Σαουλ

text_en: and he said: The Lord is my rock, and my strength, and my saviour.
text_la: Et ait : Dominus petra mea, et robur meum, et salvator meus.
text_pt: Disse pois: O Senhor é o meu rochedo, e o meu lugar forte, e o meu libertador.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριε πέτρα μου καὶ ὀχύρωμά μου καὶ ἐξαιρούμενός με ἐμοί

text_en: God is my strong one, in him will I trust: my shield, and the horn of my salvation : he lifts me up, and is my refuge: my saviour, you will deliver me from iniquity .
text_la: Deus fortis meus : sperabo in eum; scutum meum, et cornu salutis meæ : elevator meus, et refugium meum; salvator meus : de iniquitate liberabis me.
text_pt: Deus é o meu rochedo, nele confiarei; o meu escudo, e a força da minha salvação, o meu alto retiro, e o meu refúgio. Ó meu Salvador, da violência me salvas.
text_el: ὁ θεός μου φύλαξ ἔσται μου πεποιθὼς ἔσομαι ἐπ' αὐτῷ ὑπερασπιστής μου καὶ κέρας σωτηρίας μου ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου καὶ καταφυγή μου σωτηρίας μου ἐξ ἀδίκου σώσεις με

text_en: I will call on the Lord who is worthy to be praised: and I shall be saved from my enemies.
text_la: Laudabilem invocabo Dominum, et ab inimicis meis salvus ero.
text_pt: O Senhor, digno de louvor, invocarei, e de meus inimigos ficarei livre,
text_el: αἰνετὸν ἐπικαλέσομαι κύριον καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου σωθήσομαι

text_en: For the pangs of death have surrounded me: the floods of Belial have made me afraid.
text_la: Quia circumdederunt me contritiones mortis : torrentes Belial terruerunt me.
text_pt: Porque me cercaram as ondas de morte; as torrentes dos homens ímpios me assombraram.
text_el: ὅτι περιέσχον με συντριμμοὶ θανάτου χείμαρροι ἀνομίας ἐθάμβησάν με

text_en: The cords of hell compassed me: the snares of death prevented me.
text_la: Funes inferni circumdederunt me : prævenerunt me laquei mortis.
text_pt: Cordas do inferno me cingiram; encontraram-me laços de morte.
text_el: ὠδῖνες θανάτου ἐκύκλωσάν με προέφθασάν με σκληρότητες θανάτου

text_en: In my distress I will call upon the Lord , and I will cry to my God : and he will hear my voice out of his temple , and my cry shall come to his ears.
text_la: In tribulatione mea invocabo Dominum, et ad Deum meum clamabo : et exaudiet de templo suo vocem meam, et clamor meus veniet ad aures ejus.
text_pt: Estando em angústia, invoquei ao Senhor, e a meu Deus clamei; do seu templo ouviu ele a minha voz, e o meu clamor chegou aos seus ouvidos.
text_el: ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐπικαλέσομαι κύριον καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεόν μου βοήσομαι καὶ ἐπακούσεται ἐκ ναοῦ αὐτοῦ φωνῆς μου καὶ ἡ κραυγή μου ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: The earth shook and trembled, the foundations of the mountains were moved, and shaken, because he was angry with them.
text_la: Commota est et contremuit terra; fundamenta montium concussa sunt, et conquassata : quoniam iratus est eis.
text_pt: Então se abalou e tremeu a terra, os fundamentos dos céus se moveram e abalaram, porque ele se irou.
text_el: καὶ ἐταράχθη καὶ ἐσείσθη ἡ γῆ καὶ τὰ θεμέλια τοῦ οὐρανοῦ συνεταράχθησαν καὶ ἐσπαράχθησαν ὅτι ἐθυμώθη κύριος αὐτοῖς

text_en: A smoke went up from his nostrils, and a devouring fire out of his mouth: coals were kindled by it.
text_la: Ascendit fumus de naribus ejus, et ignis de ore ejus vorabit : carbones succensi sunt ab eo.
text_pt: Subiu fumaça de suas narinas, e da sua boca um fogo devorador; carvões se incenderam dele.
text_el: ἀνέβη καπνὸς ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ καὶ πῦρ ἐκ στόματος αὐτοῦ κατέδεται ἄνθρακες ἐξεκαύθησαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: He bowed the heavens , and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
text_la: Inclinavit cælos, et descendit : et caligo sub pedibus ejus.
text_pt: E abaixou os céus, e desceu; e uma escuridão havia debaixo de seus pés.
text_el: καὶ ἔκλινεν οὐρανοὺς καὶ κατέβη καὶ γνόφος ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he rode upon the cherubims , and flew: and slid upon the wings of the wind.
text_la: Et ascendit super cherubim, et volavit : et lapsus est super pennas venti.
text_pt: E subiu sobre um querubim, e voou; e foi visto sobre as asas do vento.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν ἐπὶ Χερουβιν καὶ ἐπετάσθη καὶ ὤφθη ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀνέμου

text_en: He made darkness a covering round about him: dropping waters out of the clouds of the heavens .
text_la: Posuit tenebras in circuitu suo latibulum, cribrans aquas de nubibus cælorum.
text_pt: E por tendas pôs as trevas ao redor de si; ajuntamento de águas, nuvens dos céus.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο σκότος ἀποκρυφὴν αὐτοῦ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ ἡ σκηνὴ αὐτοῦ σκότος ὑδάτων ἐπάχυνεν ἐν νεφέλαις ἀέρος

text_en: By the brightness before him, the coals of fire were kindled.
text_la: Præ fulgore in conspectu ejus, succensi sunt carbones ignis.
text_pt: Pelo resplendor da sua presença brasas de fogo se acenderam.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ φέγγους ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἐξεκαύθησαν ἄνθρακες πυρός

text_en: The Lord shall thunder from heaven : and the most high shall give forth his voice.
text_la: Tonabit de cælo Dominus, et excelsus dabit vocem suam.
text_pt: Trovejou desde os céus o Senhor; e o Altíssimo fez soar a sua voz.
text_el: ἐβρόντησεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ κύριος καὶ ὁ ὕψιστος ἔδωκεν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shot arrows and scattered them: lightning, and consumed them.
text_la: Misit sagittas et dissipavit eos; fulgur, et consumpsit eos.
text_pt: E disparou flechas, e os dissipou; raios, e os perturbou.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν βέλη καὶ ἐσκόρπισεν αὐτούς ἀστραπὴν καὶ ἐξέστησεν αὐτούς

text_en: And the overflowings of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were laid open at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of the spirit of his wrath .
text_la: Et apparuerunt effusiones maris, et revelata sunt fundamenta orbis ab increpatione Domini, ab inspiratione spiritus furoris ejus.
text_pt: E apareceram as profundezas do mar, e os fundamentos do mundo se descobriram; pela repreensão do Senhor, pelo sopro do vento das suas narinas.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθησαν ἀφέσεις θαλάσσης καὶ ἀπεκαλύφθη θεμέλια τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν τῇ ἐπιτιμήσει κυρίου ἀπὸ πνοῆς πνεύματος θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He sent from on high, and took me, and drew me out of many waters.
text_la: Misit de excelso, et assumpsit me, et extraxit me de aquis multis.
text_pt: Desde o alto enviou, e me tomou; tirou-me das muitas águas.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν ἐξ ὕψους καὶ ἔλαβέν με εἵλκυσέν με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν

text_en: He delivered me from my most mighty enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
text_la: Liberavit me ab inimico meo potentissimo, et ab his qui oderant me : quoniam robustiores me erant.
text_pt: Livrou-me do meu poderoso inimigo, e daqueles que me tinham ódio, porque eram mais fortes do que eu.
text_el: ἐρρύσατό με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου ἰσχύος ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με ὅτι ἐκραταιώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ

text_en: He prevented me in the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my stay.
text_la: Prævenit me in die afflictionis meæ, et factus est Dominus firmamentum meum.
text_pt: Encontraram-me no dia da minha calamidade; porém o Senhor se fez o meu amparo.
text_el: προέφθασάν με ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς μου καὶ ἐγένετο κύριος ἐπιστήριγμά μου

text_en: And he brought me forth into a large place, he delivered me, because I pleased him.
text_la: Et eduxit me in latitudinem : liberavit me, quia complacui ei.
text_pt: E tirou-me para um lugar espaçoso, e livrou-me, porque tinha prazer em mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγέν με εἰς πλατυσμὸν καὶ ἐξείλατό με ὅτι εὐδόκησεν ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: The Lord will reward me according to my justice : and according to the cleanness of my hands he will render to me.
text_la: Retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam : et secundum munditiam manuum mearum reddet mihi.
text_pt: Recompensou-me o Senhor conforme a minha justiça; conforme a pureza de minhas mãos me retribuiu.
text_el: καὶ ἀνταπέδωκέν μοι κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἀνταπέδωκέν μοι

text_en: Because I have kept the ways of the Lord , and have not wickedly departed from my God .
text_la: Quia custodivi vias Domini, et non egi impie a Deo meo.
text_pt: Porque guardei os caminhos do Senhor; e não me apartei impiamente do meu Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ἐφύλαξα ὁδοὺς κυρίου καὶ οὐκ ἠσέβησα ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ μου

text_en: For all his judgments are in my sight: and his precepts I have not removed from me.
text_la: Omnia enim judicia ejus in conspectu meo, et præcepta ejus non amovi a me.
text_pt: Porque todos os seus juízos estavam diante de mim; e de seus estatutos não me desviei.
text_el: ὅτι πάντα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ κατεναντίον μου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπέστην ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And I shall be perfect with him: and shall keep myself from my iniquity .
text_la: Et ero perfectus cum eo, et custodiam me ab iniquitate mea.
text_pt: Porém fui sincero perante ele; e guardei-me da minha iniqüidade.
text_el: καὶ ἔσομαι ἄμωμος αὐτῷ καὶ προφυλάξομαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας μου

text_en: And the Lord will recompense me according to my justice : and according to the cleanness of my hands in the sight of his eyes.
text_la: Et restituet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam, et secundum munditiam manuum mearum in conspectu oculorum suorum.
text_pt: E me retribuiu o Senhor conforme a minha justiça, conforme a minha pureza diante dos seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἀποδώσει μοι κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: With the holy one you will be holy : and with the valiant perfect.
text_la: Cum sancto sanctus eris, et cum robusto perfectus.
text_pt: Com o benigno te mostras benigno; com o homem íntegro te mostras perfeito.
text_el: μετὰ ὁσίου ὁσιωθήσῃ καὶ μετὰ ἀνδρὸς τελείου τελειωθήσῃ

text_en: With the elect you will be elect : and with the perverse you will be perverted.
text_la: Cum electo electus eris, et cum perverso perverteris.
text_pt: Com o puro te mostras puro; mas com o perverso te mostras rígido.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ἐκλεκτοῦ ἐκλεκτὸς ἔσῃ καὶ μετὰ στρεβλοῦ στρεβλωθήσῃ

text_en: And the poor people you will save: and with your eyes you shall humble the haughty.
text_la: Et populum pauperem salvum facies : oculisque tuis excelsos humiliabis.
text_pt: E o povo aflito livras; mas teus olhos são contra os altivos, e tu os abaterás.
text_el: καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν πτωχὸν σώσεις καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπὶ μετεώρων ταπεινώσεις

text_en: For you are my lamp O Lord : and you, O Lord , will enlighten my darkness.
text_la: Quia tu lucerna mea, Domine, et tu, Domine, illuminabis tenebras meas.
text_pt: Porque tu, Senhor, és a minha lâmpada; e o Senhor ilumina as minhas trevas.
text_el: ὅτι σὺ ὁ λύχνος μου κύριε καὶ κύριος ἐκλάμψει μοι τὸ σκότος μου

text_en: For in you I will run girded: in my God I will leap over the wall.
text_la: In te enim curram accinctus : in Deo meo transiliam murum.
text_pt: Porque contigo passo pelo meio de um esquadrão; pelo meu Deus salto um muro.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν σοὶ δραμοῦμαι μονόζωνος καὶ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μου ὑπερβήσομαι τεῖχος

text_en: God , his way is immaculate, the word of the Lord is tried by fire: he is the shield of all that trust in him.
text_la: Deus, immaculata via ejus; eloquium Domini igne examinatum : scutum est omnium sperantium in se.
text_pt: O caminho de Deus é perfeito, e a palavra do Senhor refinada; e é o escudo de todos os que nele confiam.
text_el: ὁ ἰσχυρός ἄμωμος ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου κραταιόν πεπυρωμένον ὑπερασπιστής ἐστιν πᾶσιν τοῖς πεποιθόσιν ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: Who is God but the Lord : and who is strong but our God ?
text_la: Quis est Deus præter Dominum, et quis fortis præter Deum nostrum?
text_pt: Por que, quem é Deus, senão o Senhor? E quem é rochedo, senão o nosso Deus?
text_el: τίς ἰσχυρὸς πλὴν κυρίου καὶ τίς κτίστης ἔσται πλὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: God who has girded me with strength, and made my way perfect.
text_la: Deus qui accinxit me fortitudine, et complanavit perfectam viam meam.
text_pt: Deus é a minha fortaleza e a minha força, e ele perfeitamente desembaraça o meu caminho.
text_el: ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁ κραταιῶν με δυνάμει καὶ ἐξετίναξεν ἄμωμον τὴν ὁδόν μου

text_en: Making my feet like the feet of harts, and setting me upon my high places.
text_la: Coæquans pedes meos cervis, et super excelsa mea statuens me;
text_pt: Faz ele os meus pés como os das cervas, e me põe sobre as minhas alturas.
text_el: τιθεὶς τοὺς πόδας μου ὡς ἐλάφων καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη ἱστῶν με

text_en: He teaches my hands to war : and makes my arms like a bow of brass.
text_la: docens manus meas ad prælium, et componens quasi arcum æreum brachia mea.
text_pt: Instrui as minhas mãos para a peleja, de maneira que um arco de cobre se quebra pelos meus braços.
text_el: διδάσκων χεῖράς μου εἰς πόλεμον καὶ κατάξας τόξον χαλκοῦν ἐν βραχίονί μου

text_en: You have given me the shield of my salvation : and your mildness has multiplied me.
text_la: Dedisti mihi clypeum salutis tuæ, et mansuetudo tua multiplicavit me.
text_pt: Também me deste o escudo da tua salvação, e pela tua brandura me vieste a engrandecer.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκάς μοι ὑπερασπισμὸν σωτηρίας μου καὶ ἡ ὑπακοή σου ἐπλήθυνέν με

text_en: You shall enlarge my steps under me: and my ankles shall not fail.
text_la: Dilatabis gressus meos subtus me, et non deficient tali mei.
text_pt: Alargaste os meus passos debaixo de mim, e não vacilaram os meus artelhos.
text_el: εἰς πλατυσμὸν εἰς τὰ διαβήματά μου ὑποκάτω μου καὶ οὐκ ἐσαλεύθησαν τὰ σκέλη μου

text_en: I will pursue after my enemies, and crush them: and will not return again till I consume them.
text_la: Persequar inimicos meos, et conteram, et non convertar donec consumam eos.
text_pt: Persegui os meus inimigos, e os derrotei, e nunca me tornei até que os consumisse.
text_el: διώξω ἐχθρούς μου καὶ ἀφανιῶ αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἀναστρέψω ἕως συντελέσω αὐτούς

text_en: I will consume them and break them in pieces, so that they shall not rise: they shall fall under my feet.
text_la: Consumam eos et confringam, ut non consurgant : cadent sub pedibus meis.
text_pt: E os consumi, e os atravessei, de modo que nunca mais se levantaram, mas caíram debaixo dos meus pés.
text_el: καὶ θλάσω αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἀναστήσονται καὶ πεσοῦνται ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας μου

text_en: You have girded me with strength to battle: you have made them that resisted me to bow under me.
text_la: Accinxisti me fortitudine ad prælium : incurvasti resistentes mihi subtus me.
text_pt: Porque me cingiste de força para a peleja; fizeste abater-se debaixo de mim os que se levantaram contra mim,
text_el: καὶ ἐνισχύσεις με δυνάμει εἰς πόλεμον κάμψεις τοὺς ἐπανιστανομένους μοι ὑποκάτω μου

text_en: My enemies you have made to turn their back to me: them that hated me, and I shall destroy them.
text_la: Inimicos meos dedisti mihi dorsum; odientes me, et disperdam eos.
text_pt: E deste-me o pescoço de meus inimigos, daqueles que me tinham ódio, e os destruí.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἔδωκάς μοι νῶτον τοὺς μισοῦντάς με καὶ ἐθανάτωσας αὐτούς

text_en: They shall cry, and there shall be none to save: to the Lord , and he shall not hear them.
text_la: Clamabunt, et non erit qui salvet; ad Dominum, et non exaudiet eos.
text_pt: Olharam, porém não houve libertador; sim, para o Senhor, porém não lhes respondeu.
text_el: βοήσονται καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν βοηθός πρὸς κύριον καὶ οὐχ ὑπήκουσεν αὐτῶν

text_en: I shall beat them as small as the dust of the earth: I shall crush them and spread them abroad like the mire of the streets.
text_la: Delebo eos ut pulverem terræ; quasi lutum platearum comminuam eos atque confringam.
text_pt: Então os moí como o pó da terra; como a lama das ruas os trilhei e dissipei.
text_el: καὶ ἐλέανα αὐτοὺς ὡς χοῦν γῆς ὡς πηλὸν ἐξόδων ἐλέπτυνα αὐτούς

text_en: You will save me from the contradictions of my people: you will keep me to be the head of the Gentiles : the people which I know not, shall serve me,
text_la: Salvabis me a contradictionibus populi mei; custodies me in caput gentium : populus quem ignoro serviet mihi.
text_pt: Também me livraste das contendas do meu povo; guardaste-me para cabeça das nações; o povo que não conhecia me servirá.
text_el: καὶ ῥύσῃ με ἐκ μάχης λαῶν φυλάξεις με εἰς κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν λαός ὃν οὐκ ἔγνων ἐδούλευσάν μοι

text_en: the sons of the stranger will resist me, at the hearing of the ear they will obey me.
text_la: Filii alieni resistent mihi; auditu auris obedient mihi.
text_pt: Os filhos de estranhos se me sujeitaram; ouvindo a minha voz, me obedeceram.
text_el: υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἐψεύσαντό μοι εἰς ἀκοὴν ὠτίου ἤκουσάν μου

text_en: The strangers are melted away, and shall be straitened in their distresses.
text_la: Filii alieni defluxerunt, et contrahentur in angustiis suis.
text_pt: Os filhos de estranhos desfaleceram; e, cingindo-se, saíram dos seus esconderijos.
text_el: υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἀπορριφήσονται καὶ σφαλοῦσιν ἐκ τῶν συγκλεισμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord lives, and my God is blessed : and the strong God of my salvation shall be exalted:
text_la: Vivit Dominus, et benedictus Deus meus, et exaltabitur Deus fortis salutis meæ.
text_pt: Vive o Senhor, e bendito seja o meu rochedo; e exaltado seja Deus, a rocha da minha salvação,
text_el: ζῇ κύριος καὶ εὐλογητὸς ὁ φύλαξ μου καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὁ θεός μου ὁ φύλαξ τῆς σωτηρίας μου

text_en: God who gives me revenge, and bring down people under me,
text_la: Deus qui das vindictas mihi, et dejicis populos sub me.
text_pt: O Deus que me dá inteira vingança, e sujeita os povos debaixo de mim.
text_el: ἰσχυρὸς κύριος ὁ διδοὺς ἐκδικήσεις ἐμοί παιδεύων λαοὺς ὑποκάτω μου

text_en: who bring me forth from my enemies, and lift me up from them that resist me: from the wicked man you shall deliver me.
text_la: Qui educis me ab inimicis meis, et a resistentibus mihi elevas me : a viro iniquo liberabis me.
text_pt: E o que me tira dentre os meus inimigos; e tu me exaltas sobre os que contra mim se levantam; do homem violento me livras.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάγων με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐπεγειρομένων μοι ὑψώσεις με ἐξ ἀνδρὸς ἀδικημάτων ῥύσῃ με

text_en: Therefore will I give thanks to you, O Lord , among the Gentiles , and will sing to your name .
text_la: Propterea confitebor tibi, Domine, in gentibus, et nomini tuo cantabo :
text_pt: Por isso, ó Senhor, te louvarei entre os gentios, e entoarei louvores ao teu nome.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ

text_en: Giving great salvation to his king, and showing mercy to David his anointed, and to his seed for ever.
text_la: magnificans salutes regis sui, et faciens misericordiam christo suo David, et semini ejus in sempiternum.
text_pt: Ele é a torre das salvações do seu rei, e usa de benignidade com o seu ungido, com Davi, e com a sua descendência para sempre.
text_el: μεγαλύνων σωτηρίας βασιλέως αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος τῷ χριστῷ αὐτοῦ τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Now these are David's last words. David the son of Isai said: The man to whom it was appointed concerning the Christ of the God of Jacob , the excellent psalmist of Israel said:
text_la: Hæc autem sunt verba David novissima. Dixit David filius Isai : Dixit vir, cui constitutum est de christo Dei Jacob, egregius psaltes Israël :
text_pt: E estas são as últimas palavras de Davi: Diz Davi, filho de Jessé, e diz o homem que foi levantado em altura, o ungido do Deus de Jacó, e o suave em salmos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι Δαυιδ οἱ ἔσχατοι πιστὸς Δαυιδ υἱὸς Ιεσσαι καὶ πιστὸς ἀνήρ ὃν ἀνέστησεν κύριος ἐπὶ χριστὸν θεοῦ Ιακωβ καὶ εὐπρεπεῖς ψαλμοὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: The spirit of the Lord has spoken by me and his word by my tongue.
text_la: Spiritus Domini locutus est per me, et sermo ejus per linguam meam.
text_pt: O Espírito do Senhor falou por mim, e a sua palavra está na minha boca.
text_el: πνεῦμα κυρίου ἐλάλησεν ἐν ἐμοί καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ γλώσσης μου

text_en: The God of Israel said to me, the strong one of Israel spoke, the ruler of men , the just ruler in the fear of God .
text_la: Dixit Deus Israël mihi, locutus est fortis Israël : Dominator hominum, justus dominator in timore Dei,
text_pt: Disse o Deus de Israel, a Rocha de Israel a mim me falou: Haverá um justo que domine sobre os homens, que domine no temor de Deus.
text_el: λέγει ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐμοὶ ἐλάλησεν φύλαξ Ισραηλ παραβολὴν εἰπόν ἐν ἀνθρώπῳ πῶς κραταιώσητε φόβον θεοῦ

text_en: As the light of the morning, when the sun rises, shines in the morning without clouds, and as the grass springs out of the earth by rain.
text_la: sicut lux auroræ, oriente sole, mane absque nubibus rutilat : et sicut pluviis germinat herba de terra.
text_pt: E será como a luz da manhã, quando sai o sol, da manhã sem nuvens, quando pelo seu resplendor e pela chuva a erva brota da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν θεῷ φωτὶ πρωίας ἀνατείλαι ἥλιος τὸ πρωὶ οὐ παρῆλθεν ἐκ φέγγους καὶ ὡς ἐξ ὑετοῦ χλόης ἀπὸ γῆς

text_en: Neither is my house so great with God , that he should make with me an eternal covenant, firm in all things and assured. For he is all my salvation , and all my will: neither is there ought thereof that springs not up.
text_la: Nec tanta est domus mea apud Deum, ut pactum æternum iniret mecum, firmum in omnibus atque munitum. Cuncta enim salus mea, et omnis voluntas, nec est quidquam ex ea quod non germinet.
text_pt: Ainda que a minha casa não seja tal para com Deus, contudo estabeleceu comigo uma aliança eterna, que em tudo será bem ordenado e guardado, pois toda a minha salvação e todo o meu prazer está nele, apesar de que ainda não o faz brotar.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ οὕτως ὁ οἶκός μου μετὰ ἰσχυροῦ διαθήκην γὰρ αἰώνιον ἔθετό μοι ἑτοίμην ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ πεφυλαγμένην ὅτι πᾶσα σωτηρία μου καὶ πᾶν θέλημα ὅτι οὐ μὴ βλαστήσῃ ὁ παράνομος

text_en: But transgressors shall all of them be plucked up as thorns: which are not taken away with hands.
text_la: Prævaricatores autem quasi spinæ evellentur universi, quæ non tolluntur manibus.
text_pt: Porém os filhos de Belial todos serão como os espinhos que se lançam fora, porque não podem ser tocados com a mão.
text_el: ὥσπερ ἄκανθα ἐξωσμένη πάντες αὐτοί ὅτι οὐ χειρὶ λημφθήσονται

text_en: And if a man will touch them, he must be armed with iron and with the staff of a lance: but they shall be set on fire and burnt to nothing.
text_la: Et si quis tangere voluerit eas, armabitur ferro et ligno lanceato, igneque succensæ comburentur usque ad nihilum.
text_pt: Mas qualquer que os tocar se armará de ferro e da haste de uma lança; e a fogo serão totalmente queimados no mesmo lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἀνὴρ οὐ κοπιάσει ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ πλῆρες σιδήρου καὶ ξύλον δόρατος καὶ ἐν πυρὶ καύσει καυθήσονται αἰσχύνῃ αὐτῶν

text_en: These are the names of the valiant men of David : Jesbaham sitting in the chair was the wisest chief among the three, he was like the most tender little worm of the wood, who killed eight hundred men at one onset.
text_la: Hæc nomina fortium David. Sedens in cathedra sapientissimus princeps inter tres, ipse est quasi tenerrimus ligni vermiculus, qui octingentos interfecit impetu uno.
text_pt: Estes são os nomes dos poderosos que Davi teve: Josebe-Bassebete, filho de Taquemoni, o principal dos capitães; este era Adino, o eznita, que se opusera a oitocentos, e os feriu de uma vez.
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν δυνατῶν Δαυιδ Ιεβοσθε ὁ Χαναναῖος ἄρχων τοῦ τρίτου ἐστίν Αδινων ὁ Ασωναῖος οὗτος ἐσπάσατο τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ ὀκτακοσίους τραυματίας εἰς ἅπαξ

text_en: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three valiant men that were with David when they defied the Philistines , and they were there gathered together to battle.
text_la: Post hunc, Eleazar filius patrui ejus Ahohites inter tres fortes, qui erant cum David quando exprobraverunt Philisthiim, et congregati sunt illuc in prælium.
text_pt: E depois dele Eleazar, filho de Dodó, filho de Aoí, entre os três valentes que estavam com Davi quando provocaram os filisteus que ali se ajuntaram à peleja, e quando se retiraram os homens de Israel.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς πατραδέλφου αὐτοῦ υἱὸς Σουσίτου ἐν τοῖς τρισὶν δυνατοῖς οὗτος ἦν μετὰ Δαυιδ ἐν Σερραν καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνειδίσαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις συνήχθησαν ἐκεῖ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ

text_en: And when the men of Israel had gone away, he stood and smote the Philistines till his hand was weary, and grew stiff with the sword: and the Lord wrought a great victory that day: and the people that were fled away, returned to take spoils of them that were slain.
text_la: Cumque ascendissent viri Israël, ipse stetit et percussit Philisthæos donec deficeret manus ejus, et obrigesceret cum gladio : fecitque Dominus salutem magnam in die illa : et populus qui fugerat, reversus est ad cæsorum spolia detrahenda.
text_pt: Este se levantou, e feriu os filisteus, até lhe cansar a mão e ficar a mão pegada à espada; e naquele dia o Senhor efetuou um grande livramento; e o povo voltou junto dele, somente a tomar o despojo.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἀνέστη καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις ἕως οὗ ἐκοπίασεν ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκολλήθη ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὴν μάχαιραν καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος σωτηρίαν μεγάλην ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἐκάθητο ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ πλὴν ἐκδιδύσκειν

text_en: And after him was Semma the son of Age of Arari. And the Philistines were gathered together in a troop: for there was a field full of lentils. And when the people were fled from the face of the Philistines ,
text_la: Et post hunc, Semma filius Age de Arari. Et congregati sunt Philisthiim in statione : erat quippe ibi ager lente plenus. Cumque fugisset populus a facie Philisthiim,
text_pt: E depois dele Samá, filho de Agé, o hararita, quando os filisteus se ajuntaram numa multidão, onde havia um pedaço de terra cheio de lentilhas, e o povo fugira de diante dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Σαμαια υἱὸς Ασα ὁ Αρουχαῖος καὶ συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι εἰς Θηρία καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ μερὶς τοῦ ἀγροῦ πλήρης φακοῦ καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἔφυγεν ἐκ προσώπου ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: he stood in the midst of the field, and defended it, and defeated the Philistines : and the Lord gave a great victory.
text_la: stetit ille in medio agri, et tuitus est eum, percussitque Philisthæos : et fecit Dominus salutem magnam.
text_pt: Este, pois, se pôs no meio daquele pedaço de terra, e o defendeu, e feriu os filisteus; e o Senhor efetuou um grande livramento.
text_el: καὶ ἐστηλώθη ἐν μέσῳ τῆς μερίδος καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος σωτηρίαν μεγάλην

text_en: Moreover also before this the three who were princes among the thirty, went down and came to David in the harvest time into the cave of Odollam : and the camp of the Philistines was in the valley of the giants.
text_la: Necnon et ante descenderant tres qui erant principes inter triginta, et venerant tempore messis ad David in speluncam Odollam : castra autem Philisthinorum erant posita in Valle gigantum.
text_pt: Também três dos trinta chefes desceram, e no tempo da sega foram a Davi, à caverna de Adulão; e a multidão dos filisteus acampara no vale de Refaim.
text_el: καὶ κατέβησαν τρεῖς ἀπὸ τῶν τριάκοντα καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Κασων πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον Οδολλαμ καὶ τάγμα τῶν ἀλλοφύλων παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι Ραφαϊμ

text_en: And David was then in a hold: and there was a garrison of the Philistines then in Bethlehem .
text_la: Et David erat in præsidio : porro statio Philisthinorum tunc erat in Bethlehem.
text_pt: Davi estava então num lugar forte, e a guarnição dos filisteus em Belém.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ τότε ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ καὶ τὸ ὑπόστημα τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τότε ἐν Βαιθλεεμ

text_en: And David longed, and said: O that some man would get me a drink of the water out of the cistern , that is in Bethlehem , by the gate.
text_la: Desideravit ergo David, et ait : O si quis mihi daret potum aquæ de cisterna quæ est in Bethlehem juxta portam!
text_pt: E teve Davi desejo, e disse: Quem me dera beber da água da cisterna de Belém, que está junto à porta!
text_el: καὶ ἐπεθύμησεν Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν τίς ποτιεῖ με ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου τοῦ ἐν Βαιθλεεμ τοῦ ἐν τῇ πύλῃ τὸ δὲ σύστημα τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τότε ἐν Βαιθλεεμ

text_en: And the three valiant men broke through the camp of the Philistines , and drew water out of the cistern of Bethlehem , that was by the gate, and brought it to David : but he would not drink, but offered it to the Lord ,
text_la: Irruperunt ergo tres fortes castra Philisthinorum, et hauserunt aquam de cisterna Bethlehem, quæ erat juxta portam, et attulerunt ad David : at ille noluit bibere, sed libavit eam Domino,
text_pt: Então aqueles três poderosos romperam pelo arraial dos filisteus, e tiraram água da cisterna de Belém, que está junto à porta, e a tomaram, e a trouxeram a Davi; porém ele não a quis beber, mas derramou-a perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ διέρρηξαν οἱ τρεῖς δυνατοὶ ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ὑδρεύσαντο ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου τοῦ ἐν Βαιθλεεμ τοῦ ἐν τῇ πύλῃ καὶ ἔλαβαν καὶ παρεγένοντο πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν πιεῖν αὐτὸ καὶ ἔσπεισεν αὐτὸ τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: saying: The Lord be merciful to me, that I may not do this: shall I drink the blood of these men that went, and the peril of their lives? Therefore he would not drink. These things did these three mighty men .
text_la: dicens : Propitius sit mihi Dominus, ne faciam hoc : num sanguinem hominum istorum qui profecti sunt, et animarum periculum bibam? Noluit ergo bibere. Hæc fecerunt tres robustissimi.
text_pt: E disse: Guarda-me, ó Senhor, de que tal faça; beberia eu o sangue dos homens que foram com risco da sua vida? De maneira que não a quis beber; isto fizeram aqueles três poderosos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἵλεώς μοι κύριε τοῦ ποιῆσαι τοῦτο εἰ αἷμα τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν πορευθέντων ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν πίομαι καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν πιεῖν αὐτό ταῦτα ἐποίησαν οἱ τρεῖς δυνατοί

text_en: Abisai also the brother of Joab, the son of Sarvia , was chief among three: and he lifted up his spear against three hundred whom he slew, and he was renowned among the three,
text_la: Abisai quoque frater Joab filius Sarviæ, princeps erat de tribus : ipse est qui levavit hastam suam contra trecentos, quos interfecit : nominatus in tribus,
text_pt: Também Abisai, irmão de Joabe, filho de Zeruia, era chefe de três; e este alçou a sua lança contra trezentos e os feriu; e tinha nome entre os três.
text_el: καὶ Αβεσσα ἀδελφὸς Ιωαβ υἱὸς Σαρουιας αὐτὸς ἄρχων ἐν τοῖς τρισίν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξήγειρεν τὸ δόρυ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τριακοσίους τραυματίας καὶ αὐτῷ ὄνομα ἐν τοῖς τρισίν

text_en: and the noblest of three, and was their chief, but to the three first he attained not.
text_la: et inter tres nobilior, eratque eorum princeps, sed usque ad tres primos non pervenerat.
text_pt: Porventura este não era o mais nobre dentre estes três? Pois era o primeiro deles; porém aos primeiros três não chegou.
text_el: ἐκ τῶν τριῶν ἐκείνων ἔνδοξος καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς εἰς ἄρχοντα καὶ ἕως τῶν τριῶν οὐκ ἦλθεν

text_en: And Banaias the son of Joiada a most valiant man , of great deeds, of Cabseel: he slew the two lions of Moab , and he went down, and slew a lion in the midst of a pit, in the time of snow.
text_la: Et Banaias filius Jojadæ viri fortissimi, magnorum operum, de Cabseel. Ipse percussit duos leones Moab, et ipse descendit, et percussit leonem in media cisterna in diebus nivis.
text_pt: Também Benaia, filho de Joiada, filho de um homem valoroso de Cabzeel, grande em obras, este feriu dois fortes heróis de Moabe; e desceu ele, e feriu um leão no meio duma cova, no tempo da neve.
text_el: καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε ἀνὴρ αὐτὸς πολλοστὸς ἔργοις ἀπὸ Καβεσεηλ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπάταξεν τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Αριηλ τοῦ Μωαβ καὶ αὐτὸς κατέβη καὶ ἐπάταξε τὸν λέοντα ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λάκκου ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς χιόνος

text_en: He also slew an Egyptian , a man worthy to be a sight, having a spear in his hand: but he went down to him with a rod, and forced the spear out of the hand of the Egyptian , and slew him with his own spear.
text_la: Ipse quoque interfecit virum ægyptium, virum dignum spectaculo, habentem in manu hastam : itaque cum descendisset ad eum in virga, vi extorsit hastam de manu Ægyptii, et interfecit eum hasta sua.
text_pt: Também este feriu um egípcio, homem de respeito; e na mão do egípcio havia uma lança, porém ele desceu a ele com um cajado, e arrancou a lança da mão do egípcio, e com ela o matou.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐπάταξεν τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν Αἰγύπτιον ἄνδρα ὁρατόν ἐν δὲ τῇ χειρὶ τοῦ Αἰγυπτίου δόρυ ὡς ξύλον διαβάθρας καὶ κατέβη πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν ῥάβδῳ καὶ ἥρπασεν τὸ δόρυ ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ Αἰγυπτίου καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ δόρατι αὐτοῦ

text_en: These things did Banaias the son of Joiada .
text_la: Hæc fecit Banaias filius Jojadæ.
text_pt: Estas coisas fez Benaia, filho de Joiada, pelo que teve nome entre três poderosos.
text_el: ταῦτα ἐποίησεν Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε καὶ αὐτῷ ὄνομα ἐν τοῖς τρισὶν τοῖς δυνατοῖς

text_en: And he was renowned among the three valiant men , who were the most honourable among the thirty: but he attained not to the first three: and David made him of his privy council.
text_la: Et ipse nominatus inter tres robustos, qui erant inter triginta nobiliores : verumtamen usque ad tres non pervenerat : fecitque eum sibi David auricularium, a secreto.
text_pt: Dentre os trinta ele era o mais nobre, porém aos três primeiros não chegou; e Davi o pôs sobre os seus guardas.
text_el: ἐκ τῶν τριῶν ἔνδοξος καὶ πρὸς τοὺς τρεῖς οὐκ ἦλθεν καὶ ἔταξεν αὐτὸν Δαυιδ εἰς τὰς ἀκοὰς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Asael the brother of Joab was one of the thirty, Elehanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem .
text_la: Asaël frater Joab inter triginta, Elehanan filius patrui ejus de Bethlehem,
text_pt: Asael, irmão de Joabe, estava entre os trinta; El-Hanã, filho de Dodó, de Belém;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν δυνατῶν Δαυιδ βασιλέως Ασαηλ ἀδελφὸς Ιωαβ οὗτος ἐν τοῖς τριάκοντα Ελεαναν υἱὸς Δουδι πατραδέλφου αὐτοῦ ἐν Βαιθλεεμ

text_en: Semma of Harodi, Elica of Harodi,
text_la: Semma de Harodi, Elica de Harodi,
text_pt: Samá, harodita; Elica, harodita;
text_el: Σαμαι ὁ Αρουδαῖος Ελικα ὁ Αρωδαῖος

text_en: Heles of Phalti, Hira the son of Acces of Thecua,
text_la: Heles de Phalti, Hira filius Acces de Thecua,
text_pt: Helez, paltita; Ira, filho de Iques, tecoíta;
text_el: Ελλης ὁ Φελωθι Ιρας υἱὸς Εκκας ὁ Θεκωίτης

text_en: Abiezer of Anathoth , Mobonnai of Husati,
text_la: Abiezer de Anathoth, Mobonnai de Husati,
text_pt: Abiezer, anatotita; Mebunai, husatita;
text_el: Αβιεζερ ὁ Αναθωθίτης ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ Ασωθίτου

text_en: Selmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
text_la: Selmon Ahohites, Maharai Netophathites,
text_pt: Zalmom, aoíta; Maarai, netofatita;
text_el: Σελμων ὁ Αωίτης Μοορε ὁ Νετωφαθίτης
