text_en: Heled the son of Baana, also a Netophathite, Ithai the son of Ribai of Gabaath of the children of Benjamin ,
text_la: Heled filius Baana, et ipse Netophathites, Ithai filius Ribai de Gabaath filiorum Benjamin,
text_pt: Elebe, filho de Baaná, netofatita; Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gibeá dos filhos de Benjamim;
text_el: Ελα υἱὸς Βαανα ὁ Νετωφαθίτης Εθθι υἱὸς Ριβα ἐκ Γαβαεθ υἱὸς Βενιαμιν

text_en: Banaia the Pharathonite, Heddai of the torrent Gaas,
text_la: Banaia Pharathonites, Heddai de torrente Gaas,
text_pt: Benaia, piratonita; Hidai, do ribeiro de Gaás;
text_el: Βαναιας ὁ Φαραθωνίτης Ουρι ἐκ Ναχαλιγαιας

text_en: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth of Beromi,
text_la: Abialbon Arbathites, Azmaveth de Beromi,
text_pt: Abi-Albom, arbatita; Azmavete, barumita;
text_el: Αβιηλ υἱὸς τοῦ Αραβωθίτου Αζμωθ ὁ Βαρσαμίτης

text_en: Eliaba of Salaboni. The sons of Jassen, Jonathan ,
text_la: Eliaba de Salaboni. Filii Jassen, Jonathan,
text_pt: Eliaba, saalbonita; os filhos de Jásen e Jônatas;
text_el: Ελιασου ὁ Σαλαβωνίτης υἱοὶ Ιασαν Ιωναθαν

text_en: Semma of Orori, Aliam the son of Sarar the Arorite,
text_la: Semma de Orori, Ajam filius Sarar Arorites,
text_pt: Samá, hararita, Aião, filho de Sarar, ararita;
text_el: Σαμμα ὁ Αρωδίτης Αχιαν υἱὸς Σαραδ ὁ Αραουρίτης

text_en: Eliphelet the son of Aasbai the son of Machati, Eliam the son of Achitophel the Gelonite ,
text_la: Eliphelet filius Aasbai filii Machati, Eliam filius Achitophel Gelonites,
text_pt: Elifelete, filho de Aasbai, filho de um maacatita; Eliã, filho de Aitofel, gilonita;
text_el: Αλιφαλεθ υἱὸς τοῦ Ασβίτου υἱὸς τοῦ Μααχατι Ελιαβ υἱὸς Αχιτοφελ τοῦ Γελωνίτου

text_en: Hesrai of Carmel , Pharai of Arbi,
text_la: Hesrai de Carmelo, Pharai de Arbi,
text_pt: Hesrai, carmelita; Paarai, arbita;
text_el: Ασαραι ὁ Καρμήλιος Φαραϊ ὁ Ερχι

text_en: Igaal the son of Nathan of Soba, Bonni of Gadi,
text_la: Igaal filius Nathan de Soba, Bonni de Gadi,
text_pt: Igal, filho de Natã, de Zobá; Bani, gadita;
text_el: Ιγααλ υἱὸς Ναθαν ἀπὸ δυνάμεως υἱὸς Γαδδι

text_en: Selec of Ammoni, Naharai the Berothite , armourbearer of Joab the son of Sarvia,
text_la: Selec de Ammoni, Naharai Berothites armiger Joab filii Sarviæ,
text_pt: Zeleque, amonita; Naarai, beerotita, o que trazia as armas de Joabe, filho de Zeruia;
text_el: Ελιε ὁ Αμμανίτης Γελωραι ὁ Βηρωθαῖος αἴρων τὰ σκεύη Ιωαβ υἱοῦ Σαρουιας

text_en: Ira the Jethrite, Gareb also a Jethrite;
text_la: Ira Jethrites, Gareb et ipse Jethrites,
text_pt: Ira, itrita; Garebe, itrita;
text_el: Ιρας ὁ Ιεθιραῖος Γαρηβ ὁ Ιεθιραῖος

text_en: Urias the Hethite , thirty and seven in all.
text_la: Urias Hethæus : omnes triginta septem.
text_pt: Urias, heteu; trinta e sete ao todo.
text_el: Ουριας ὁ Χετταῖος πάντες τριάκοντα καὶ ἑπτά

text_en: And the anger of the Lord was again kindled against Israel , and stirred up David among them, saying: Go, number Israel and Juda .
text_la: Et addidit furor Domini irasci contra Israël, commovitque David in eis dicentem : Vade, numera Israël et Judam.
text_pt: E a ira do SENHOR se tornou a acender contra Israel; e incitou a Davi contra eles, dizendo: Vai, numera a Israel e a Judá.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ὀργὴ κυρίου ἐκκαῆναι ἐν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπέσεισεν τὸν Δαυιδ ἐν αὐτοῖς λέγων βάδιζε ἀρίθμησον τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ τὸν Ιουδα

text_en: And the king said to Joab the general of his army: Go through all the tribes of Israel from Dan to Bersabee , and number the people that I may know the number of them.
text_la: Dixitque rex ad Joab principem exercitus sui : Perambula omnes tribus Israël a Dan usque Bersabee, et numerate populum, ut sciam numerum ejus.
text_pt: Disse, pois, o rei a Joabe, capitão do exército, o qual tinha consigo: Agora percorre todas as tribos de Israel, desde Dã até Berseba, e numera o povo, para que eu saiba o número do povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Ιωαβ ἄρχοντα τῆς ἰσχύος τὸν μετ' αὐτοῦ δίελθε δὴ πάσας φυλὰς Ισραηλ ἀπὸ Δαν καὶ ἕως Βηρσαβεε καὶ ἐπίσκεψαι τὸν λαόν καὶ γνώσομαι τὸν ἀριθμὸν τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And Joab said to the king: The Lord your God increase your people, and make them as many more as they are now, and again multiply them a hundredfold in the sight of my lord the king: but what means my lord the king by this kind of thing?
text_la: Dixitque Joab regi : Adaugeat Dominus Deus tuus ad populum tuum, quantus nunc est, iterumque centuplicet in conspectu domini mei regis : sed quid sibi dominus meus rex vult in re hujuscemodi?
text_pt: Então disse Joabe ao rei: Ora, multiplique o SENHOR teu Deus a este povo cem vezes tanto quanto agora é, e os olhos do rei meu senhor o vejam; mas, por que deseja o rei meu senhor este negócio?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ προσθείη κύριος ὁ θεός σου πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ὥσπερ αὐτοὺς καὶ ὥσπερ αὐτοὺς ἑκατονταπλασίονα καὶ ὀφθαλμοὶ τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως ὁρῶντες καὶ ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς ἵνα τί βούλεται ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ

text_en: But the king's words prevailed over the words of Joab, and of the captains of the army: and Joab, and the captains of the soldiers went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel .
text_la: Obtinuit autem sermo regis verba Joab et principum exercitus : egressusque est Joab et princeps militum a facie regis, ut numerarent populum Israël.
text_pt: Porém a palavra do rei prevaleceu contra Joabe, e contra os capitães do exército; Joabe, pois, saiu com os capitães do exército da presença do rei, para numerar o povo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ὑπερίσχυσεν ὁ λόγος τοῦ βασιλέως πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιωαβ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς ἰσχύος ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπισκέψασθαι τὸν λαὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And when they had passed the Jordan , they came to Aroer to the right side of the city, which is in the vale of Gad .
text_la: Cumque pertransissent Jordanem, venerunt in Aroër ad dexteram urbis, quæ est in valle Gad:
text_pt: E passaram o Jordão; e acamparam-se em Aroer, à direita da cidade que está no meio do ribeiro de Gade, junto a Jazer.
text_el: καὶ διέβησαν τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Αροηρ ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἐν μέσῳ τῆς φάραγγος Γαδ καὶ Ελιεζερ

text_en: And by Jazer they passed into Galaad, and to the lower land of Hodsi, and they came into the woodlands of Dan . And going about by Sidon ,
text_la: et per Jazer transierunt in Galaad, et in terram inferiorem Hodsi, et venerunt in Dan silvestria. Circumeuntesque juxta Sidonem,
text_pt: E foram a Gileade, e à terra baixa de Hodsi; também foram até Dã-Jaã, e ao redor de Sidom.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν Γαλααδ καὶ εἰς γῆν Θαβασων ἥ ἐστιν Αδασαι καὶ παρεγένοντο εἰς Δανιδαν καὶ Ουδαν καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν εἰς Σιδῶνα

text_en: they passed near the walls of Tyre , and all the land of the Hevite, and the Chanaanite , and they came to the south of Juda into Bersabee :
text_la: transierunt prope mœnia Tyri, et omnem terram Hevæi et Chananæi, veneruntque ad meridiem Juda in Bersabee:
text_pt: E foram à fortaleza de Tiro, e a todas as cidades dos heveus e dos cananeus; e saíram para o lado do sul de Judá, a Berseba.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθαν εἰς Μαψαρ Τύρου καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τοῦ Ευαίου καὶ τοῦ Χαναναίου καὶ ἦλθαν κατὰ νότον Ιουδα εἰς Βηρσαβεε

text_en: And having gone through the whole land, after nine months and twenty days, they came to Jerusalem .
text_la: et lustrata universa terra, affuerunt post novem menses et viginti dies in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Assim percorreram toda a terra; e ao cabo de nove meses e vinte dias voltaram a Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ περιώδευσαν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ καὶ παρεγένοντο ἀπὸ τέλους ἐννέα μηνῶν καὶ εἴκοσι ἡμερῶν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people to the king, and there were found of Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword: and of Juda five hundred thousand fighting men .
text_la: Dedit ergo Joab numerum descriptionis populi regi, et inventa sunt de Israël octingenta millia virorum fortium qui educerent gladium, et de Juda quingenta millia pugnatorum.
text_pt: E Joabe deu ao rei a soma do número do povo contado; e havia em Israel oitocentos mil homens de guerra, que arrancavam da espada; e os homens de Judá eram quinhentos mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Ιωαβ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῆς ἐπισκέψεως τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἐγένετο Ισραηλ ὀκτακόσιαι χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν δυνάμεως σπωμένων ῥομφαίαν καὶ ἀνὴρ Ιουδα πεντακόσιαι χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν μαχητῶν

text_en: But David's heart struck him, after the people were numbered: and David said to the Lord : I have sinned very much in what I have done: but I pray you, O Lord , to take away the iniquity of your servant, because I have done exceeding foolishly.
text_la: Percussit autem cor David eum, postquam numeratus est populus : et dixit David ad Dominum : Peccavi valde in hoc facto : sed precor, Domine, ut transferas iniquitatem servi tui, quia stulte egi nimis.
text_pt: E pesou o coração de Davi, depois de haver numerado o povo; e disse Davi ao Senhor: Muito pequei no que fiz; porém agora ó Senhor, peço-te que perdoes a iniqüidade do teu servo; porque tenho procedido mui loucamente.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν καρδία Δαυιδ αὐτὸν μετὰ τὸ ἀριθμῆσαι τὸν λαόν καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς κύριον ἥμαρτον σφόδρα ὃ ἐποίησα νῦν κύριε παραβίβασον δὴ τὴν ἀνομίαν τοῦ δούλου σου ὅτι ἐμωράνθην σφόδρα

text_en: And David arose in the morning, and the word of the Lord came to Gad the prophet and the seer of David , saying:
text_la: Surrexit itaque David mane, et sermo Domini factus est ad Gad prophetam et videntem David, dicens:
text_pt: Levantando-se, pois, Davi pela manhã, veio a palavra do Senhor ao profeta Gade, vidente de Davi, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Δαυιδ τὸ πρωί καὶ λόγος κυρίου ἐγένετο πρὸς Γαδ τὸν προφήτην τὸν ὁρῶντα Δαυιδ λέγων

text_en: Go, and say to David : Thus says the Lord : I give you your choice of three things, choose one of them which you will, that I may do it to you.
text_la: Vade, et loquere ad David : Hæc dicit Dominus : Trium tibi datur optio : elige unum quod volueris ex his, ut faciam tibi.
text_pt: Vai, e dize a Davi: Assim diz o Senhor: Três coisas te ofereço; escolhe uma delas, para que ta faça.
text_el: πορεύθητι καὶ λάλησον πρὸς Δαυιδ λέγων τάδε λέγει κύριος τρία ἐγώ εἰμι αἴρω ἐπὶ σέ καὶ ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ποιήσω σοι

text_en: And when Gad had come to David , he told him, saying: Either seven years of famine shall come to you in your land: or you shall flee three months before your adversaries, and they shall pursue you: or for three days there shall be a pestilence in your land. Now therefore deliberate, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
text_la: Cumque venisset Gad ad David, nuntiavit ei, dicens : Aut septem annis veniet tibi fames in terra tua : aut tribus mensibus fugies adversarios tuos, et ille te persequentur : aut certe tribus diebus erit pestilentia in terra tua. Nunc ergo delibera, et vide quem respondeam ei qui me misit sermonem.
text_pt: Foi, pois, Gade a Davi, e fez-lho saber; e disse-lhe: Queres que sete anos de fome te venham à tua terra; ou que por três meses fujas de teus inimigos, e eles te persigam; ou que por três dias haja peste na tua terra? Delibera agora, e vê que resposta hei de dar ao que me enviou.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Γαδ πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ γενέσθαι εἰ ἔλθῃ σοι τρία ἔτη λιμὸς ἐν τῇ γῇ σου ἢ τρεῖς μῆνας φεύγειν σε ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου καὶ ἔσονται διώκοντές σε ἢ γενέσθαι τρεῖς ἡμέρας θάνατον ἐν τῇ γῇ σου νῦν οὖν γνῶθι καὶ ἰδὲ τί ἀποκριθῶ τῷ ἀποστείλαντί με ῥῆμα

text_en: And David said to Gad : I am in a great strait: but it is better that I should fall into the hands of the Lord (for his mercies are many) than into the hands of men .
text_la: Dixit autem David ad Gad : Coarctor nimis : sed melius est ut incidam in manus Domini (multæ enim misericordiæ ejus sunt) quam in manus hominum.
text_pt: Então disse Davi a Gade: Estou em grande angústia; porém caiamos nas mãos do Senhor, porque muitas são as suas misericórdias; mas nas mãos dos homens não caia eu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Γαδ στενά μοι πάντοθεν σφόδρα ἐστίν ἐμπεσοῦμαι δὴ ἐν χειρὶ κυρίου ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ οἰκτιρμοὶ αὐτοῦ σφόδρα εἰς δὲ χεῖρας ἀνθρώπου οὐ μὴ ἐμπέσω καὶ ἐξελέξατο ἑαυτῷ Δαυιδ τὸν θάνατον

text_en: And the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel , from the morning unto the time appointed, and there died of the people from Dan to Bersabee seventy thousand men .
text_la: Immisitque Dominus pestilentiam in Israël, de mane usque ad tempus constitutum, et mortui sunt ex populo a Dan usque ad Bersabee septuaginta millia virorum.
text_pt: Então enviou o Senhor a peste a Israel, desde a manhã até ao tempo determinado; e desde Dã até Berseba, morreram setenta mil homens do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἡμέραι θερισμοῦ πυρῶν καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος ἐν Ισραηλ θάνατον ἀπὸ πρωίθεν ἕως ὥρας ἀρίστου καὶ ἤρξατο ἡ θραῦσις ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ ἀπὸ Δαν καὶ ἕως Βηρσαβεε ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And when the angel of the Lord had stretched out his hand over Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord had pity on the affliction, and said to the angel that slew the people: It is enough: now hold your hand. And the angel of the Lord was by the thrashingfloor of Areuna the Jebusite.
text_la: Cumque extendisset manum suam angelus Domini super Jerusalem ut disperderet eam, misertus est Dominus super afflictione, et ait angelo percutienti populum : Sufficit : nunc contine manum tuam. Erat autem angelus Domini juxta aream Areuna Jebusæi.
text_pt: Estendendo, pois, o anjo a sua mão sobre Jerusalém, para a destruir, o Senhor se arrependeu daquele mal; e disse ao anjo que fazia a destruição entre o povo: Basta, agora retira a tua mão. E o anjo do Senhor estava junto à eira de Araúna, o jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ διαφθεῖραι αὐτήν καὶ παρεκλήθη κύριος ἐπὶ τῇ κακίᾳ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῷ διαφθείροντι ἐν τῷ λαῷ πολὺ νῦν ἄνες τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἦν παρὰ τῷ ἅλῳ Ορνα τοῦ Ιεβουσαίου

text_en: And David said to the Lord , when he saw the angel striking the people: It is I; I am he that have sinned , I have done wickedly : these that are the sheep, what have they done? Let your hand, I beseech you, be turned against me, and against my father's house.
text_la: Dixitque David ad Dominum cum vidisset angelum cædentem populum : Ego sum qui peccavi, ego inique egi : isti qui oves sunt, quid fecerunt? vertatur, obsecro, manus tua contra me, et contra domum patris mei.
text_pt: E, vendo Davi ao anjo que feria o povo, falou ao Senhor, dizendo: Eis que eu sou o que pequei, e eu que iniquamente procedi; porém estas ovelhas que fizeram? Seja, pois, a tua mão contra mim, e contra a casa de meu pai.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς κύριον ἐν τῷ ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν τὸν ἄγγελον τύπτοντα ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐγώ εἰμι ἠδίκησα καὶ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ἐκακοποίησα καὶ οὗτοι τὰ πρόβατα τί ἐποίησαν γενέσθω δὴ ἡ χείρ σου ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: And Gad came to David that day, and said: Go up, and build an altar to the Lord in the thrashingfloor of Areuna the Jebusite.
text_la: Venit autem Gad ad David in die illa, et dixit ei : Ascende, et constitue altare Domino in area Areuna Jebusæi.
text_pt: E Gade veio naquele mesmo dia a Davi, e disse-lhe: Sobe, levanta ao Senhor um altar na eira de Araúna, o jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Γαδ πρὸς Δαυιδ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἀνάβηθι καὶ στῆσον τῷ κυρίῳ θυσιαστήριον ἐν τῷ ἅλωνι Ορνα τοῦ Ιεβουσαίου

text_en: And David went up according to the word of Gad which the Lord had commanded him.
text_la: Et ascendit David juxta sermonem Gad, quem præceperat ei Dominus.
text_pt: Davi subiu conforme à palavra de Gade, como o Senhor lhe tinha ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Δαυιδ κατὰ τὸν λόγον Γαδ καθ' ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος

text_en: And Areuna looked, and saw the king and his servants coming towards him:
text_la: Conspiciensque Areuna, animadvertit regem et servos ejus transire ad se:
text_pt: E olhou Araúna, e viu que vinham para ele o rei e os seus servos; saiu, pois, Araúna e inclinou-se diante do rei com o rosto em terra.
text_el: καὶ διέκυψεν Ορνα καὶ εἶδεν τὸν βασιλέα καὶ τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ παραπορευομένους ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ορνα καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ βασιλεῖ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And going out he worshipped the king, bowing with his face to the earth, and said: Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said to him: To buy the thrashingfloor of you, and build an altar to the Lord , that the plague, which rages among the people, may cease.
text_la: et egressus adoravit regem prono vultu in terram, et ait : Quid causæ est ut veniat dominus meus rex ad servum suum? Cui David ait : Ut emam a te aream, et ædificem altare Domino, et cesset interfectio quæ grassatur in populo.
text_pt: E disse Araúna: Por que vem o rei meu Senhor ao seu servo? E disse Davi: Para comprar de ti esta eira, a fim de edificar nela um altar ao Senhor, para que este castigo cesse de sobre o povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ορνα τί ὅτι ἦλθεν ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ κτήσασθαι παρὰ σοῦ τὸν ἅλωνα τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ συσχεθῇ ἡ θραῦσις ἐπάνω τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And Areuna said to David : Let my lord the king take, and offer, as it seems good to him: you have here oxen for a holocaust , and the wain, and the yokes of the oxen for wood.
text_la: Et ait Areuna ad David : Accipiat, et offerat dominus meus rex sicut placet ei : habes boves in holocaustum, et plaustrum, et juga boum in usum lignorum.
text_pt: Então disse Araúna a Davi: Tome, e ofereça o rei meu senhor o que bem parecer aos seus olhos; eis aí bois para o holocausto, e os trilhos, e o aparelho dos bois para a lenha.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ορνα πρὸς Δαυιδ λαβέτω καὶ ἀνενεγκέτω ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ ἰδοὺ οἱ βόες εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ οἱ τροχοὶ καὶ τὰ σκεύη τῶν βοῶν εἰς ξύλα

text_en: All these things Areuna as a king gave to the king: and Areuna said to the king: The Lord your God receive your vow .
text_la: Omnia dedit Areuna rex regi : dixitque Areuna ad regem : Dominus Deus tuus suscipiat votum tuum.
text_pt: Tudo isto deu Araúna ao rei; disse mais Araúna ao rei: O Senhor teu Deus tome prazer em ti.
text_el: τὰ πάντα ἔδωκεν Ορνα τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ εἶπεν Ορνα πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα κύριος ὁ θεός σου εὐλογήσαι σε

text_en: And the king answered him, and said: Nay, but I will buy it of you, at a price, and I will not offer to the Lord my God holocausts free cost. So David bought the floor, and the oxen, for fifty sicles of silver:
text_la: Cui respondens rex, ait : Nequaquam ut vis, sed emam pretio a te, et non offeram Domino Deo meo holocausta gratuita. Emit ergo David aream, et boves, argenti siclis quinquaginta:
text_pt: Porém o rei disse a Araúna: Não, mas por preço justo to comprarei, porque não oferecerei ao Senhor meu Deus holocaustos que não me custem nada. Assim Davi comprou a eira e os bois por cinqüenta siclos de prata.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Ορνα οὐχί ὅτι ἀλλὰ κτώμενος κτήσομαι παρὰ σοῦ ἐν ἀλλάγματι καὶ οὐκ ἀνοίσω τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ μου ὁλοκαύτωμα δωρεάν καὶ ἐκτήσατο Δαυιδ τὸν ἅλωνα καὶ τοὺς βόας ἐν ἀργυρίῳ σίκλων πεντήκοντα

text_en: And David built there an altar to the Lord , and offered holocausts and peace offerings : and the Lord became merciful to the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel .
text_la: et ædificavit ibi David altare Domino, et obtulit holocausta et pacifica : et propitiatus est Dominus terræ, et cohibita est plaga ab Israël.
text_pt: E edificou ali Davi ao Senhor um altar, e ofereceu holocaustos, e ofertas pacíficas. Assim o Senhor se aplacou para com a terra e cessou aquele castigo de sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ Δαυιδ θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ὁλοκαυτώσεις καὶ εἰρηνικάς καὶ προσέθηκεν Σαλωμων ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐπ' ἐσχάτῳ ὅτι μικρὸν ἦν ἐν πρώτοις καὶ ἐπήκουσεν κύριος τῇ γῇ καὶ συνεσχέθη ἡ θραῦσις ἐπάνωθεν Ισραηλ
